1.171.s:
.. śatānīka uvāca .. ..
magānāṃ brūhi me dharmaṃ samāsavyāsayogataḥ ..
phalaṃ ca kiṃ bhavedbrahmanmagadharmaniṣevaṇāt .. 1 ..
1.171.d:
॥ शतानीक उवाच ॥ ॥
मगानां ब्रूहि मे धर्मं समासव्यासयोगतः ॥
फलं च किं भवेद्ब्रह्मन्मगधर्मनिषेवणात् ॥ 1 ॥
1.171.m:
Śatānīka said:
Tell me, in brief and in detail, the duty of the Magas, / and what fruit there is, O brāhmaṇa, from observing the Maga duty.

1.171.s:
.. sumaṃturuvāca .. ..
ya eṣa dharmaḥ sūryeti tavākhyāto mayānagha ..
magadharmaḥ sa evoktaḥ sarvapāpabhayāpahaḥ .. 2 ..
1.171.d:
॥ सुमंतुरुवाच ॥ ॥
य एष धर्मः सूर्येति तवाख्यातो मयानघ ॥
मगधर्मः स एवोक्तः सर्वपापभयापहः ॥ 2 ॥
1.171.m:
Sumaṃtu said:
This duty of Sūrya that I have declared to you, O sinless one, / is indeed called the Maga duty, which removes all sin and fear.

1.171.s:
sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ magadharmaniṣevaṇam..
magadharmaśca saṃprokta eteṣāṃ bhavamuktaye ..3..
1.171.d:
सर्वेषामेव वर्णानां मगधर्मनिषेवणम्॥
मगधर्मश्च संप्रोक्त एतेषां भवमुक्तये ॥3॥
1.171.m: The observance of the Maga duty is for all castes, / and the Maga duty is proclaimed for their release from worldly existence.

1.171.s:
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ strī śūdro vā magāśramī ..
yaḥ pūjayati mārtaṃḍaṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim .. 4 ..
1.171.d:
ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्याः स्त्री शूद्रो वा मगाश्रमी ॥
यः पूजयति मार्तंडं स याति परमां गतिम् ॥ 4 ॥
1.171.m: Whether brāhmaṇas, kṣatriyas, vaiśyas, women, śūdras, or those living in the stage of a Maga, / whoever worships the sun attains the highest state.

1.171.s:
trisaṃdhyamarcayedbhānumagnikāryaṃ ca śaktitaḥ ..
kuryānmago mahābāho mukhamāvṛtya yatnataḥ ..5..
1.171.d:
त्रिसंध्यमर्चयेद्भानुमग्निकार्यं च शक्तितः ॥
कुर्यान्मगो महाबाहो मुखमावृत्य यत्नतः ॥5॥
1.171.m: He should worship the sun at the three twilights, and perform the fire-rite according to his ability; / a Maga, O mighty-armed one, should perform it carefully covering his mouth.

1.171.s:
trisaṃdhyamekakālaṃ vā pūjayecchaddhayā ravim ..
asaṃpūjya raviṃ mohānna bhuṃjīta kadācana .. 6 ..
1.171.d:
त्रिसंध्यमेककालं वा पूजयेच्छद्धया रविम् ॥
असंपूज्य रविं मोहान्न भुंजीत कदाचन ॥ 6 ॥
1.171.m: He should worship the sun with faith at the three twilights or once a day; / having not worshipped the sun, he must never eat out of delusion.

1.171.s:
eṣa dharmaḥ paro jñeyaḥ śeṣo bhavati mānavaḥ ..
apūjayitvā bhuṃjāno viṣṭhāṃ bhuṅkte ca vai magaḥ .. 7 ..
1.171.d:
एष धर्मः परो ज्ञेयः शेषो भवति मानवः ॥
अपूजयित्वा भुंजानो विष्ठां भुङ्क्ते च वै मगः ॥ 7 ॥
1.171.m: This should be known as the supreme duty; the rest belongs to [common] man. / A Maga who eats without having worshipped indeed eats excrement.

1.171.s:
devaṃ samāśritaiḥ pūjā kartavyeyaṃ tribhiḥ sadā ..
manasā pūjayedyogī puṣpaiścāraṇyasaṃbhavaiḥ .. 8 ..
1.171.d:
देवं समाश्रितैः पूजा कर्तव्येयं त्रिभिः सदा ॥
मनसा पूजयेद्योगी पुष्पैश्चारण्यसंभवैः ॥ 8 ॥
1.171.m: This worship must always be performed by those devoted to the god through three [means]: / a yogin should worship in his mind, and with wild flowers.

1.171.s:
devārthapuṣpahiṃsāyāṃ na bhavettasya hiṃsakaḥ ..
yadyalpamapi cātmārthaṃ nihanyāddhiṃsakastadā .. 9 ..
1.171.d:
देवार्थपुष्पहिंसायां न भवेत्तस्य हिंसकः ॥
यद्यल्पमपि चात्मार्थं निहन्याद्धिंसकस्तदा ॥ 9 ॥
1.171.m: In harming flowers for the sake of the god, one is not a slayer; / if he should destroy even a little for his own sake, he is then a slayer.

1.171.s:
magaścāgniparo nityaṃ tadbhakto'tithipūjakaḥ ..
magī maithunavarjyaḥ syācchrīmāngṛhamagāśramī .. 1.171.10 ..
1.171.d:
मगश्चाग्निपरो नित्यं तद्भक्तोऽतिथिपूजकः ॥
मगी मैथुनवर्ज्यः स्याच्छ्रीमान्गृहमगाश्रमी ॥ 1.171.10 ॥
1.171.m: A Maga is ever devoted to the fire, devoted to Him, and an honourer of guests; / a Maga, fortunate and living in the stage of a householder-Maga, should abstain from sexual intercourse [at forbidden times].

1.171.s:
devāgnisvatithau bhaktaṃ pacate cātmakāraṇāt ..
ātmārthe yaḥ pacenmohātsa mago narakaṃ vrajet .. 11 ..
1.171.d:
देवाग्निस्वतिथौ भक्तं पचते चात्मकारणात् ॥
आत्मार्थे यः पचेन्मोहात्स मगो नरकं व्रजेत् ॥ 11 ॥
1.171.m: Cooked food is for the god, the fire, and one's guest, not for one's own sake; / he who out of delusion cooks for himself, that Maga goes to hell.

1.171.s:
devārthe pacanaṃ yeṣāṃ saṃtānārthaṃ tu maithunam ..
artho dānārthaṃ uddiṣṭo narakaṃ hi viparyayāt.. .. 12 ..
1.171.d:
देवार्थे पचनं येषां संतानार्थं तु मैथुनम् ॥
अर्थो दानार्थं उद्दिष्टो नरकं हि विपर्ययात्॥ ॥ 12 ॥
1.171.m: For those whose cooking is for the god, whose sexual intercourse is for offspring, / and whose wealth is designated for gifts—the reverse leads indeed to hell.

1.171.s:
jīvatṛtīyabhāgepi na prakurvīta vārcanam ..
vittārjane tadardhena yato nityaṃ hi jīvitam .. 13 ..
1.171.d:
जीवतृतीयभागेपि न प्रकुर्वीत वार्चनम् ॥
वित्तार्जने तदर्धेन यतो नित्यं हि जीवितम् ॥ 13 ॥
1.171.m: One should not perform worship with the third part of one's livelihood; / for life is sustained daily by acquiring wealth with half of it.

1.171.s:
nyāyopārjitavittaḥ syādanyāyaṃ pari varjayet ..
anyāyārjitavittaistu kurvannarakamāpnuyāt .. 14 ..
1.171.d:
न्यायोपार्जितवित्तः स्यादन्यायं परि वर्जयेत् ॥
अन्यायार्जितवित्तैस्तु कुर्वन्नरकमाप्नुयात् ॥ 14 ॥
1.171.m: One should have wealth acquired justly, and should entirely avoid injustice; / performing [rites] with wealth acquired unjustly, one attains hell.

1.171.s:
vācorthe brahmacārī yaḥ sūryapūjāgnitatparaḥ ..
bhavejjiteṃdriyaḥ śāṃto naiṣṭhiko bhauti ko'pi vā .. 15 ..
1.171.d:
वाचोर्थे ब्रह्मचारी यः सूर्यपूजाग्नितत्परः ॥
भवेज्जितेंद्रियः शांतो नैष्ठिको भौति कोऽपि वा ॥ 15 ॥
1.171.m: A student of the Veda who speaks for the truth, intent on the fire and the worship of Sūrya, / should have conquered his senses, be tranquil, whether a lifelong student or a temporary one.

1.171.s:
sarvagaṃdhavinirmuktaḥ kaṃdamūlaphalāśanaḥ ..
mama vaikhānaso jñeyaḥ sūryapūjāgnitatparaḥ .. 16 ..
1.171.d:
सर्वगंधविनिर्मुक्तः कंदमूलफलाशनः ॥
मम वैखानसो ज्ञेयः सूर्यपूजाग्नितत्परः ॥ 16 ॥
1.171.m: Free from all perfumes, eating roots, bulbs, and fruits, / intent on the fire and the worship of Sūrya, he should be known as my forest-dwelling anchorite.

1.171.s:
nivṛttaḥ saṃgamebhyastu sūryadhyāna rataḥ sadā ..
jñeyaḥ saurayatīṃdrāya pūjāniṣṭho jiteṃdriyaḥ .. 17 ..
1.171.d:
निवृत्तः संगमेभ्यस्तु सूर्यध्यान रतः सदा ॥
ज्ञेयः सौरयतींद्राय पूजानिष्ठो जितेंद्रियः ॥ 17 ॥
1.171.m: Turned away from company, ever delighting in meditation on Sūrya, / steadfast in worship, with senses conquered, he should be known as a supreme solar ascetic.

1.171.s:
muṃḍopanayano vyaṃgī śuklavāsaḥ samanvitaḥ ..
jñeyaṃ tadarcanasthānametatkāryaṃ prayatnataḥ .. 18 ..
1.171.d:
मुंडोपनयनो व्यंगी शुक्लवासः समन्वितः ॥
ज्ञेयं तदर्चनस्थानमेतत्कार्यं प्रयत्नतः ॥ 18 ॥
1.171.m: Having a shaven head and the sacred thread, wearing an avyaṅga, clad in white garments— / that should be known as his place of worship; this must be performed with effort.

1.171.s:
athāvyaṃgo mahārāja dhārayedyastu bhojakaḥ ..
agamyaṃ sarvasattvānāṃ sūryalokaṃ sa gacchati .. 19 ..
1.171.d:
अथाव्यंगो महाराज धारयेद्यस्तु भोजकः ॥
अगम्यं सर्वसत्त्वानां सूर्यलोकं स गच्छति ॥ 19 ॥
1.171.m: Now, O great king, whatever Bhojaka wears an avyaṅga / goes to the realm of Sūrya, which is inaccessible to all living beings.

1.171.s:
dhvaṃsanaṃ sarvaduṣṭānāṃ sarvapāpa bhayāpaham ..
bhāvaśuddhena satatamarcanīyo divākaraḥ .. 1.171.20 ..
1.171.d:
ध्वंसनं सर्वदुष्टानां सर्वपाप भयापहम् ॥
भावशुद्धेन सततमर्चनीयो दिवाकरः ॥ 1.171.20 ॥
1.171.m: The Sun, the destroyer of all wicked ones, the remover of all sin and fear, / must constantly be worshipped by one whose mind is pure.

1.171.s:
gaṃdhalepavihīno'pi bhāvaśuddho na duṣyati ..
bhāveṣu ca carecchaucaṃ vastrapūtaṃ jalaṃ pibet .. 21 ..
1.171.d:
गंधलेपविहीनोऽपि भावशुद्धो न दुष्यति ॥
भावेषु च चरेच्छौचं वस्त्रपूतं जलं पिबेत् ॥ 21 ॥
1.171.m: Even if bereft of unguents and perfumes, one whose mind is pure is not defiled; / one should practice purity in his thoughts, and drink water purified by a cloth.

1.171.s:
dṛṣṭipūtaṃ nyasetpādaṃ satyapūtaṃ vaco vadet ..
sauradhyānaratāḥ śāṃtāḥ sauradharmaparāyaṇāḥ .. 22 ..
1.171.d:
दृष्टिपूतं न्यसेत्पादं सत्यपूतं वचो वदेत् ॥
सौरध्यानरताः शांताः सौरधर्मपरायणाः ॥ 22 ॥
1.171.m: One should place one's foot purified by sight, and speak words purified by truth; / those delighting in solar meditation, tranquil, devoted to the solar religion—

1.171.s:
sarva evāśramā jñeyā bhāskarāṃgasamudbhavāḥ ..
bhojakāṣṭavrataṃ dhāryaṃ raviṇoktamanaupamam ..23..
1.171.d:
सर्व एवाश्रमा ज्ञेया भास्करांगसमुद्भवाः ॥
भोजकाष्टव्रतं धार्यं रविणोक्तमनौपमम् ॥23॥
1.171.m: all these stages of life should be known as born from the limbs of the Sun. / The peerless eightfold vow of the Bhojakas, proclaimed by Ravi, must be maintained:

1.171.s:
sarvavratānāṃ paramaṃ dharmālayamanuttamam ..
saurabhakte sadā kṣāṃtirahiṃsā sarvadā śamaḥ ..24..
1.171.d:
सर्वव्रतानां परमं धर्मालयमनुत्तमम् ॥
सौरभक्ते सदा क्षांतिरहिंसा सर्वदा शमः ॥24॥
1.171.m: the highest of all vows, an abode of virtue, without superior. / In a devotee of Sūrya there is always forbearance, non-violence, and ever tranquility,

1.171.s:
saṃtoṣaḥ satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryaṃ tathāṣṭamam ..
yathāsaṃbhavapūjābhiḥ karmaṇā manasā girā .. 25 ..
1.171.d:
संतोषः सत्यमस्तेयं ब्रह्मचर्यं तथाष्टमम् ॥
यथासंभवपूजाभिः कर्मणा मनसा गिरा ॥ 25 ॥
1.171.m: contentment, truthfulness, non-stealing, and celibacy as the eighth. / Through worship according to one's means, in deed, thought, and speech,

1.171.s:
saurabhaktiḥ sadā kāryā bhojakeṣu viśeṣataḥ ..
svadehānnirviśeṣaṃ hi bhojakānpālayedbudhaḥ .. 26 ..
1.171.d:
सौरभक्तिः सदा कार्या भोजकेषु विशेषतः ॥
स्वदेहान्निर्विशेषं हि भोजकान्पालयेद्बुधः ॥ 26 ॥
1.171.m: devotion to the Sun must always be practiced, especially towards the Bhojakas; / for a wise man should protect the Bhojakas no differently from his own body.

1.171.s:
bhayadāridryarogebhyasteṣāṃ kuryātpriyāṇi vai ..
sūryasya paripūrṇasya kiṃ nāma kriyate naraiḥ .. 27 ..
1.171.d:
भयदारिद्र्यरोगेभ्यस्तेषां कुर्यात्प्रियाणि वै ॥
सूर्यस्य परिपूर्णस्य किं नाम क्रियते नरैः ॥ 27 ॥
1.171.m: He should do pleasant things for them against fear, poverty, and disease; / for what indeed can be done by men for Sūrya who is complete?

1.171.s:
yatkṛtaṃ bhojakānāṃ vai tatkṛtaṃ syādravernṛpa ..
sudūramapi gaṃtavyaṃ magānāṃ yatra vai gaṇaḥ .. 28 ..
1.171.d:
यत्कृतं भोजकानां वै तत्कृतं स्याद्रवेर्नृप ॥
सुदूरमपि गंतव्यं मगानां यत्र वै गणः ॥ 28 ॥
1.171.m: Whatever is done for the Bhojakas, O king, is done for Ravi. / One should go even very far to wherever there is a host of Magas,

1.171.s:
sa ca prayatnāddraṣṭavyastatra saṃnihito raviḥ ..
bhojakasya tu bhaktasya sūryapūjāratasya ca .. 29 ..
1.171.d:
स च प्रयत्नाद्द्रष्टव्यस्तत्र संनिहितो रविः ॥
भोजकस्य तु भक्तस्य सूर्यपूजारतस्य च ॥ 29 ॥
1.171.m: and it should be beheld with effort, for Ravi is present there. / And of a Bhojaka who is a devotee, intent on the worship of Sūrya,

1.171.s:
ājñāṃ kṛtvā yathānyāyamaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ..
devāśramagato bhaktyā devārcāṃ pūjayennṛpa .. 1.171.30 ..
1.171.d:
आज्ञां कृत्वा यथान्यायमश्वमेधफलं लभेत् ॥
देवाश्रमगतो भक्त्या देवार्चां पूजयेन्नृप ॥ 1.171.30 ॥
1.171.m: having carried out his command in accordance with rule, one obtains the fruit of a horse sacrifice. / Having approached the hermitage of the god with devotion, O king, he should worship the idol of the god.

1.171.s:
svāgatāsanapādyārghyamadhuparkādyanukramāt ..
bhojayitvā yathānyāyaṃ sūryaloke mahīyate ..31..
1.171.d:
स्वागतासनपाद्यार्घ्यमधुपर्काद्यनुक्रमात् ॥
भोजयित्वा यथान्यायं सूर्यलोके महीयते ॥31॥
1.171.m: Having fed [him] in due order with welcome, a seat, water for the feet, arghya, madhuparka, and the rest / according to rule, he is glorified in the world of Sūrya.

1.171.s:
pratiśrayapradānena rājā bhavati bhārata ..
dattvā sthānaṃ tathā śaucaṃ vāruṇaṃ lokamāpnuyāt .. 32 ..
1.171.d:
प्रतिश्रयप्रदानेन राजा भवति भारत ॥
दत्त्वा स्थानं तथा शौचं वारुणं लोकमाप्नुयात् ॥ 32 ॥
1.171.m: By granting shelter, O Bhārata, he becomes a king; / having given a dwelling and water for purification, he attains the world of Varuṇa.

1.171.s:
śvetabiṃduparītāṃgaṃ dhyānaśramavikarśitam ..
saṃvījya tālavṛṃttena vāyuloke mahīyate .. 33 ..
1.171.d:
श्वेतबिंदुपरीतांगं ध्यानश्रमविकर्शितम् ॥
संवीज्य तालवृंत्तेन वायुलोके महीयते ॥ 33 ॥
1.171.m: Having fanned with a palm-leaf fan one whose limbs are covered with white beads [of sweat], / exhausted from the exertion of meditation, he is glorified in the world of Vāyu.

1.171.s:
kṣutpipāsāturaṃ śrāṃtaṃ malinaṃ rogiṇaṃ tathā ..
pālayitvā yathā śaktyā sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt .. 34 ..
1.171.d:
क्षुत्पिपासातुरं श्रांतं मलिनं रोगिणं तथा ॥
पालयित्वा यथा शक्त्या सर्वान्कामानवाप्नुयात् ॥ 34 ॥
1.171.m: Having protected according to his ability one who is afflicted with hunger and thirst, weary, soiled, and diseased, / he obtains all his desires.

1.171.s:
patitāśastasaṃkīrṇacaṃḍālādīnāṃ pakṣiṇām ..
kāruṇyātsarvabhūtānāṃ deyamannaṃ svaśaktitaḥ .. 35 ..
1.171.d:
पतिताशस्तसंकीर्णचंडालादीनां पक्षिणाम् ॥
कारुण्यात्सर्वभूतानां देयमन्नं स्वशक्तितः ॥ 35 ॥
1.171.m: Food should be given according to one's ability out of compassion to all beings— / the fallen, the impure, the mixed, the caṇḍālas and others, and birds.

1.171.s:
atyalpamapi kāruṇyāddattaṃ bhavati cākṣayam ..
tasmātsarveṣu bhūteṣu devakāruṇyamucyate ..36..
1.171.d:
अत्यल्पमपि कारुण्याद्दत्तं भवति चाक्षयम् ॥
तस्मात्सर्वेषु भूतेषु देवकारुण्यमुच्यते ॥36॥
1.171.m: Given out of compassion, even very little becomes imperishable; / therefore, compassion like that of a god is prescribed towards all beings.

1.171.s:
abhāve tṛṇabhūmyannaṃ patraṃ dhanaphalāni ca ..
dattvā''gatāya praṇataḥ svargaṃ yāti priyeṇa vā ..37..
1.171.d:
अभावे तृणभूम्यन्नं पत्रं धनफलानि च ॥
दत्त्वा'ऽगताय प्रणतः स्वर्गं याति प्रियेण वा ॥37॥
1.171.m: In the absence [of food], having offered grass, ground, leaves, wealth, or fruits, / or with a kind [word], bowing down to one who has arrived, he goes to heaven.

1.171.s:
na hīdṛksvargayānāya yathā loke priyaṃ vacaḥ ..
ihāmutra sukhaṃ teṣāṃ vāgyeṣāṃ madhurā bhavet ..38..
1.171.d:
न हीदृक्स्वर्गयानाय यथा लोके प्रियं वचः ॥
इहामुत्र सुखं तेषां वाग्येषां मधुरा भवेत् ॥38॥
1.171.m: For there is nothing like a kind word in the world for ascending to heaven; / there is happiness here and in the hereafter for those whose speech is sweet.

1.171.s:
amṛtasyaṃdinī vācaṃ caṃdanasparśaśītalām ..
dharmāvirodhinīmuktvā sukhamakṣayyamāpnuyāt .. 39 ..
1.171.d:
अमृतस्यंदिनी वाचं चंदनस्पर्शशीतलाम् ॥
धर्माविरोधिनीमुक्त्वा सुखमक्षय्यमाप्नुयात् ॥ 39 ॥
1.171.m: Having spoken words flowing with nectar, cool as the touch of sandalwood, / and not conflicting with dharma, one attains imperishable bliss.

1.171.s:
alaṃ dānena rājeṃdra pūjayādhyāpanena vā ..
idaṃ svargasya sopānamacalaṃ yatpriyaṃ vacaḥ .. 1.171.40 ..
1.171.d:
अलं दानेन राजेंद्र पूजयाध्यापनेन वा ॥
इदं स्वर्गस्य सोपानमचलं यत्प्रियं वचः ॥ 1.171.40 ॥
1.171.m: Enough with giving, O lord of kings, or with worship, or teaching! / This kind word is an unshakeable stairway to heaven.

1.171.s:
pūjābhibhāṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭiḥ pratyekaṃ svargahetavaḥ ..
saṃpṛcchedā(pā)gataṃ bhaktyā kuśalaṃ praśnamādarāt .. 41 ..
1.171.d:
पूजाभिभाषणं दृष्टिः प्रत्येकं स्वर्गहेतवः ॥
संपृच्छेदा(पा)गतं भक्त्या कुशलं प्रश्नमादरात् ॥ 41 ॥
1.171.m: Worship, conversation, and sight—each is a cause of heaven. / One should respectfully ask one who has arrived about his welfare with devotion.

1.171.s:
gamane tasya vaktavyaṃ paṃthānaḥ saṃtu te śivāḥ ..
sukhaṃ bhavatu te nityaṃ sarvakāryakaraṃ bhṛśam .. 42 ..
1.171.d:
गमने तस्य वक्तव्यं पंथानः संतु ते शिवाः ॥
सुखं भवतु ते नित्यं सर्वकार्यकरं भृशम् ॥ 42 ॥
1.171.m: Upon his departure one should say: "May your paths be auspicious! / May you always have happiness that intensely accomplishes all your tasks!"

1.171.s:
āśīrvādamidaṃ vākyaṃ sarvakāleṣu sarvadā ..
namaskārādivākyeṣu svasti maṃgalavādane .. 43 ..
1.171.d:
आशीर्वादमिदं वाक्यं सर्वकालेषु सर्वदा ॥
नमस्कारादिवाक्येषु स्वस्ति मंगलवादने ॥ 43 ॥
1.171.m: This statement is a blessing at all times and always, / in words of greeting and the like, in auspicious utterances of "Hail!"

1.171.s:
śivaṃ bhavatu te nityaṃ taṃ brūyātsarvakarmasu ..
evamādi ca vācāramanuṣṭhāya sadāśramī .. 44 ..
1.171.d:
शिवं भवतु ते नित्यं तं ब्रूयात्सर्वकर्मसु ॥
एवमादि च वाचारमनुष्ठाय सदाश्रमी ॥ 44 ॥
1.171.m: "May it always be well with you!"—he should say that to him in all undertakings. / Having carried out such verbal conduct, one in a good stage of life […]

1.171.s:
aśeṣapāpa nirmuktaḥ sūryaloke mahīyate ..
sūryabhakte tu yā bhaktiḥ sadbhaktaiḥ kriyate naraiḥ ..
sūrye bhaktisamā nityaṃ bhakte bhaktiranuṣṭhitā .. 45 ..
1.171.d:
अशेषपाप निर्मुक्तः सूर्यलोके महीयते ॥
सूर्यभक्ते तु या भक्तिः सद्भक्तैः क्रियते नरैः ॥
सूर्ये भक्तिसमा नित्यं भक्ते भक्तिरनुष्ठिता ॥ 45 ॥
1.171.m: Freed from all sins, he is honoured in the world of the sun. / The devotion that is offered by righteous men to a devotee of the sun / is ever equal to devotion to the sun; devotion performed toward a devotee [is devotion to him].

1.171.s:
ākruṣṭe tāḍite vāpi yo nākrośenna tāḍayet ..
vākyādadhikṛtaḥ svasthaḥ sa duḥkhātparimucyate .. 46 ..
1.171.d:
आक्रुष्टे ताडिते वापि यो नाक्रोशेन्न ताडयेत् ॥
वाक्यादधिकृतः स्वस्थः स दुःखात्परिमुच्यते ॥ 46 ॥
1.171.m: Even when insulted or struck, he who neither insults nor strikes back, / master of his speech and tranquil in mind, is liberated from suffering.

1.171.s:
sarveṣāmeva tīrthānāṃ kṣāṃtiḥ paramapūjitā ..
tasmātpūrva prayatnena kṣāṃtiḥ kāryā kriyāsu vai .. 47 ..
1.171.d:
सर्वेषामेव तीर्थानां क्षांतिः परमपूजिता ॥
तस्मात्पूर्व प्रयत्नेन क्षांतिः कार्या क्रियासु वै ॥ 47 ॥
1.171.m: Forbearance is revered as supreme above all pilgrimage places; / therefore, with foremost effort, one must cultivate forbearance in every action.

1.171.s:
jñānayogatapo yasya yajñadānāni satkriyā ..
krodhanasya vṛthā yasmāttasmātkrodhaṃ vivarjayet .. .. 48 ..
1.171.d:
ज्ञानयोगतपो यस्य यज्ञदानानि सत्क्रिया ॥
क्रोधनस्य वृथा यस्मात्तस्मात्क्रोधं विवर्जयेत् ॥ ॥ 48 ॥
1.171.m: Because the knowledge, yoga, austerity, sacrifices, gifts, and good deeds / of an angry man are in vain, one must thoroughly renounce anger.

1.171.s:
marmāsthiprāṇahṛdayaṃ nirdahedapriyaṃvacaḥ ..
na vaco hyapriyaṃ tasmādbhojakeṣu viśeṣataḥ .. 49 ..
1.171.d:
मर्मास्थिप्राणहृदयं निर्दहेदप्रियंवचः ॥
न वचो ह्यप्रियं तस्माद्भोजकेषु विशेषतः ॥ 49 ॥
1.171.m: Unpleasant speech burns the vitals, bones, breath, and heart; / therefore one should never speak unpleasantly, especially toward Bhojakas.

1.171.s:
kṣamā dānaṃ tviṣaḥ satyaṃ kṣamāhiṃsārkasaṃbhavāḥ ..
na śakyā vistarādvaktumapi varṣaśatairapi .. 1.171.50 ..
sauradharmavarṇanam
1.171.d:
क्षमा दानं त्विषः सत्यं क्षमाहिंसार्कसंभवाः ॥
न शक्या विस्तराद्वक्तुमपि वर्षशतैरपि ॥ 1.171.50 ॥
सौरधर्मवर्णनम्
1.171.m:
Patience, giving, splendour, truth, forbearance, and non-violence born of the sun / cannot be described in full, even in hundreds of years.
Description of the Saura-dharma

1.172.s:
.. sumaṃturuvāca .. ..
punaḥ śṛṇu mahārāja dharmamādityasaṃmatam ..
saurapriyaṃ sadā sauraṃ pavitraṃ pāpanāśanam .. 1 ..
1.172.d:
॥ सुमंतुरुवाच ॥ ॥
पुनः शृणु महाराज धर्ममादित्यसंमतम् ॥
सौरप्रियं सदा सौरं पवित्रं पापनाशनम् ॥ 1 ॥
1.172.m: Sumantu said: / Hear again, O great king, the dharma approved by the sun, / dear to the sun-worshippers, ever solar, pure, and destroying all sin.

1.172.s:
kvacidgacchanyadā paśyetsūryārcāsaṃprapūjanam ..
yatra pūjā tato gacchantsa sūryo nātra saṃśayaḥ ..2 ..
1.172.d:
क्वचिद्गच्छन्यदा पश्येत्सूर्यार्चासंप्रपूजनम् ॥
यत्र पूजा ततो गच्छन्त्स सूर्यो नात्र संशयः ॥2 ॥
1.172.m: When going anywhere one should see the worship of an image of the sun, / going to where the worship takes place, he is the sun itself; of this there is no doubt.

1.172.s:
snānanaivedyavastraiśca nānālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ ..
yathāvibhavamāśritya namaskārādisaṃstavaiḥ .. 3 ..
1.172.d:
स्नाननैवेद्यवस्त्रैश्च नानालंकारभूषणैः ॥
यथाविभवमाश्रित्य नमस्कारादिसंस्तवैः ॥ 3 ॥
1.172.m: With baths, food-offerings, and garments, and various ornaments and decorations, / according to one's wealth, with salutations and hymns of praise,

1.172.s:
dṛṣṭvāyatanamākramya namaskṛtya raviṃ vrajet ..
kvacitpathi nadīṃ śailaṃ gacchamānaṃ ca bhojakam .. 4 ..
1.172.d:
दृष्ट्वायतनमाक्रम्य नमस्कृत्य रविं व्रजेत् ॥
क्वचित्पथि नदीं शैलं गच्छमानं च भोजकम् ॥ 4 ॥
1.172.m: having seen [it], entering the sanctuary, and bowing to the sun, he should proceed. / Or [if he sees] anywhere on the road a Bhojaka going to a river or a mountain,

1.172.s:
upaśrutyāvaniṃ gatvā bhojakaṃ pūjayedbudhaḥ ..
rathāśvagajayānebhyo hyavatīrya magānnṛpa ..
magānāṃ bhojanaṃ bhaktyā śaktyā dānaṃ prakalpayet .. 5 ..
1.172.d:
उपश्रुत्यावनिं गत्वा भोजकं पूजयेद्बुधः ॥
रथाश्वगजयानेभ्यो ह्यवतीर्य मगान्नृप ॥
मगानां भोजनं भक्त्या शक्त्या दानं प्रकल्पयेत् ॥ 5 ॥
1.172.m: hearing [of him] and stepping down onto the ground, the wise man should honour the Bhojaka. / Having dismounted from chariots, horses, elephants, or carriages for the Magas, O king, / he should provide food with devotion and gifts according to his means for the Magas.

1.172.s:
daśapūrvāndaśa parānātmanā saha bhārata ..
samādāya vrajetsthānaṃ raveramitatejasaḥ .. 6 ..
1.172.d:
दशपूर्वान्दश परानात्मना सह भारत ॥
समादाय व्रजेत्स्थानं रवेरमिततेजसः ॥ 6 ॥
1.172.m: Together with ten ancestors and ten descendants, and himself, O Bhārata, / taking them along, he goes to the abode of the sun of boundless splendour.

1.172.s:
daivaparvotsave śrāddhe puṇyeṣu divaseṣu ca ..
bhānuṃ saṃpūjya vidhivadbhojakānbhojayettataḥ .. 7 ..
1.172.d:
दैवपर्वोत्सवे श्राद्धे पुण्येषु दिवसेषु च ॥
भानुं संपूज्य विधिवद्भोजकान्भोजयेत्ततः ॥ 7 ॥
1.172.m: On festivals for gods, seasonal observances, ancestral rites, and auspicious days, / having worshipped the sun according to the rules, he should then feed the Bhojakas.

1.172.s:
pitaraḥ sarvadevānāṃ sūryamāśritya saṃsthitāḥ ..
prīte sūrye tu te sarve prītāḥ syurnātra saṃśayaḥ .. 8 ..
1.172.d:
पितरः सर्वदेवानां सूर्यमाश्रित्य संस्थिताः ॥
प्रीते सूर्ये तु ते सर्वे प्रीताः स्युर्नात्र संशयः ॥ 8 ॥
1.172.m: The ancestors of all the gods dwell relying upon the sun; / when the sun is pleased, they all are pleased; of this there is no doubt.

1.172.s:
yadā ca śraddhayā yuktaṃ prasaktaṃ ravipūjanam ..
bhojayedbhojakaṃ bhaktyā śrāddheṣu vidhivannṛpa .. 9 ..
1.172.d:
यदा च श्रद्धया युक्तं प्रसक्तं रविपूजनम् ॥
भोजयेद्भोजकं भक्त्या श्राद्धेषु विधिवन्नृप ॥ 9 ॥
1.172.m: And whenever the worship of the sun is constantly undertaken with faith, / he should feed the Bhojaka with devotion in ancestral rites according to the rules, O king.

1.172.s:
bhojakasya mahārāja divasenāpi yatphalam ..
na tacchakyamidaṃ tena prāptuṃ varṣaśatairapi .. 1.172.10 ..
1.172.d:
भोजकस्य महाराज दिवसेनापि यत्फलम् ॥
न तच्छक्यमिदं तेन प्राप्तुं वर्षशतैरपि ॥ 1.172.10 ॥
1.172.m: The fruit [obtained from feeding] a Bhojaka even for a single day, O great king, / cannot be attained by him even in hundreds of years.

1.172.s:
yaḥ paśyati prasannātmā yo na dveṣṭi na kāṃkṣati ..
śabdādīnāṃ tu saṃbhogaṃ sa vijñeyo jiteṃdriyaḥ .. 11 ..
1.172.d:
यः पश्यति प्रसन्नात्मा यो न द्वेष्टि न कांक्षति ॥
शब्दादीनां तु संभोगं स विज्ञेयो जितेंद्रियः ॥ 11 ॥
1.172.m: He who sees with a serene mind, who neither hates nor desires / the enjoyment of sound and the other [sense-objects], he is to be known as one of subdued senses.

1.172.s:
jñānavijñānasampannaḥ sūryabhaktyā samanvitaḥ ..
pāṣaṃḍayogamuktaśca sa vai bhojaka ucyate.. 12 ..
1.172.d:
ज्ञानविज्ञानसम्पन्नः सूर्यभक्त्या समन्वितः ॥
पाषंडयोगमुक्तश्च स वै भोजक उच्यते॥ 12 ॥
1.172.m: Endowed with knowledge and discernment, devoted to the sun, / and free from heretical practices—he alone is called a Bhojaka.

1.172.s:
sūryadharmādbhavejjñānaṃ jñānādvairāgyasaṃbhavaḥ ..
jñānavairāgyayuktasya sūryayogaḥ pravartate .. 13 ..
1.172.d:
सूर्यधर्माद्भवेज्ज्ञानं ज्ञानाद्वैराग्यसंभवः ॥
ज्ञानवैराग्ययुक्तस्य सूर्ययोगः प्रवर्तते ॥ 13 ॥
1.172.m: From the solar dharma arises knowledge; from knowledge arises detachment; / for one endowed with knowledge and detachment, the yoga of the sun begins.

1.172.s:
sūryayogācca sarvajñaḥ paripūrṇaḥ sunirvṛtaḥ ..
ātmanyavasthitaḥ śuddhaḥ sūryavaddi vi modate ..14..
1.172.d:
सूर्ययोगाच्च सर्वज्ञः परिपूर्णः सुनिर्वृतः ॥
आत्मन्यवस्थितः शुद्धः सूर्यवद्दि वि मोदते ॥14॥
1.172.m: And from the yoga of the sun, [becoming] omniscient, fulfilled, and deeply peaceful, / established in the self and pure, he rejoices in heaven like the sun.

1.172.s:
sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāmuttamaḥ puruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
puruṣebhyo dvijaḥ śreṣṭho dvijebhyo graṃthapāragaḥ .. 15 ..
1.172.d:
सर्वेषामेव भूतानामुत्तमः पुरुषः स्मृतः ॥
पुरुषेभ्यो द्विजः श्रेष्ठो द्विजेभ्यो ग्रंथपारगः ॥ 15 ॥
1.172.m: Among all beings, man is said to be the highest; / higher than men is the twice-born; higher than the twice-born is one who has mastered texts.

1.172.s:
granthibhyo vedavidvāṃsastebhyasta ttvārthaciṃtakāḥ ..
arthavidbhyaśca jñānārthapratibuddho viśiṣyate .. 16 ..
1.172.d:
ग्रन्थिभ्यो वेदविद्वांसस्तेभ्यस्त त्त्वार्थचिंतकाः ॥
अर्थविद्भ्यश्च ज्ञानार्थप्रतिबुद्धो विशिष्यते ॥ 16 ॥
1.172.m: Higher than students of texts are the knowers of the Veda; higher than them are those who contemplate ultimate truth; / and higher than those who know the meaning is one awakened to the knowledge of reality.

1.172.s:
jñānārthakoṭikoṭibhyo variṣṭhā yogino matāḥ ..
yogināṃ koṭikoṭibhyo bhojakaścottamo bhavet .. 17 ..
1.172.d:
ज्ञानार्थकोटिकोटिभ्यो वरिष्ठा योगिनो मताः ॥
योगिनां कोटिकोटिभ्यो भोजकश्चोत्तमो भवेत् ॥ 17 ॥
1.172.m: Yogins are considered superior to millions of knowers of reality; / and higher than millions of yogins is the Bhojaka.

1.172.s:
yogajñā yoganiṣṭhāśca pitaro yogasaṃbhavāḥ ..
bhojite bhojake sarve prītāḥ syuste na saṃśayaḥ .. 18 ..
1.172.d:
योगज्ञा योगनिष्ठाश्च पितरो योगसंभवाः ॥
भोजिते भोजके सर्वे प्रीताः स्युस्ते न संशयः ॥ 18 ॥
1.172.m: The ancestors are knowers of yoga, established in yoga, and born of yoga; / when a Bhojaka is fed, they all are pleased; there is no doubt.

1.172.s:
sarvajñānatapodānaiḥ kṛtairdattaiśca yatphalam ..
tatphalaṃ labhate sarvaṃ vidhivadbhojyabhojakam .. 19 ..
1.172.d:
सर्वज्ञानतपोदानैः कृतैर्दत्तैश्च यत्फलम् ॥
तत्फलं लभते सर्वं विधिवद्भोज्यभोजकम् ॥ 19 ॥
1.172.m: Whatever fruit is attained by all knowledge, austerities, and gifts performed and bestowed, / all that fruit he obtains who feeds a Bhojaka according to the rules.

1.172.s:
yaśca dravyakalāpātmā dakṣiṇā havirṛtvijaḥ ..
ṛgyajuḥsāma yogaiśca devayajñaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..1.172.20..
1.172.d:
यश्च द्रव्यकलापात्मा दक्षिणा हविरृत्विजः ॥
ऋग्यजुःसाम योगैश्च देवयज्ञः प्रकीर्तितः ॥1.172.20॥
1.172.m: And that which consists of sacrificial materials, gifts to priests, oblations, officiating priests, / and the yoga of the Ṛg, Yajur, and Sāma Vedas, is proclaimed as the sacrifice to the gods.

1.172.s:
brahmacaryaṃ tapo maunaṃ kṣāṃtirāhāralāghavam ..
ityetattapasāṃ rūpaṃ sudhīraṃ paṃcalakṣaṇam ..21..
1.172.d:
ब्रह्मचर्यं तपो मौनं क्षांतिराहारलाघवम् ॥
इत्येतत्तपसां रूपं सुधीरं पंचलक्षणम् ॥21॥
1.172.m: Chastity, austerity, silence, forbearance, and lightness of diet— / this very steadfast nature of austerities has five characteristics.

1.172.s:
yacca diṣṭaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ ca nyāyaprāptaṃ ca yadbhaveta..
tattadguṇavate deyamityetaddānalakṣaṇam..22..
1.172.d:
यच्च दिष्टं विशिष्टं च न्यायप्राप्तं च यद्भवेत॥
तत्तद्गुणवते देयमित्येतद्दानलक्षणम्॥22॥
1.172.m: Whatever is apportioned, distinguished, and lawfully acquired, / that should be given to a worthy person; this is the characteristic of giving.

1.172.s:
vivardhanīṃ sahasrāṇāṃ sarvasasyaprarohiṇīm..
dadyādbhūmiṃ jalopetāṃ bhūmidānaṃ taducyate ..23..
1.172.d:
विवर्धनीं सहस्राणां सर्वसस्यप्ररोहिणीम्॥
दद्याद्भूमिं जलोपेतां भूमिदानं तदुच्यते ॥23॥
1.172.m: Land that yields a thousandfold, that causes all crops to sprout, / supplied with water, one should give; that is called the gift of land.

1.172.s:
ekacchatrāṃ mahīṃ kṛtvā dvijebhyaḥ pratipādayet ..
saṃpūrṇāṃ parvatāraṇyairbhūmidānaṃ taducyate..24..
1.172.d:
एकच्छत्रां महीं कृत्वा द्विजेभ्यः प्रतिपादयेत् ॥
संपूर्णां पर्वतारण्यैर्भूमिदानं तदुच्यते॥24॥
1.172.m: Having brought the earth under a single royal parasol, one should bestow it on twice-born men, / complete with mountains and forests; that is called the gift of land.

1.172.s:
kanyāmalaṃkṛtāṃ dadyādadhanāya narādhipā.
dvijāya vedaviduṣe kanyādānaṃ taducyate ..25..
1.172.d:
कन्यामलंकृतां दद्यादधनाय नराधिपा।
द्विजाय वेदविदुषे कन्यादानं तदुच्यते ॥25॥
1.172.m: One should give an adorned maiden to an impoverished / twice-born man learned in the Veda, O ruler of men; that is called the gift of a maiden.

1.172.s:
sarvadoṣavinirmuktāṃ kulayogyāmalaṃkṛtām ..
madhyamottamavastrāṇāṃ yo dadyādahatāni ca ..26..
1.172.d:
सर्वदोषविनिर्मुक्तां कुलयोग्यामलंकृताम् ॥
मध्यमोत्तमवस्त्राणां यो दद्यादहतानि च ॥26॥
1.172.m: He who gives [garments] freed from all flaws, suitable for a noble family, adorned, / of middling and superior quality, and unwashed [new ones]—

1.172.s:
etatsamāsato jñeyaṃ vastradānasya lakṣaṇam..
brahmaviṣṇusamādhikyakāṃtiśīlaparāyaṇaḥ..
ahorātraṃ na bhuñjīta hyupavāsasya lakṣaṇam ..27..
1.172.d:
एतत्समासतो ज्ञेयं वस्त्रदानस्य लक्षणम्॥
ब्रह्मविष्णुसमाधिक्यकांतिशीलपरायणः॥
अहोरात्रं न भुञ्जीत ह्युपवासस्य लक्षणम् ॥27॥
1.172.m: this briefly is to be known as the characteristic of the gift of garments. / Devoted to surpassing radiance and good conduct, equal to Brahmā and Viṣṇu, / he should not eat for a day and night; this is the characteristic of fasting.

1.172.s:
catvāriṃśatsamāyuktaṃ piṃḍānāṃ hi śatadvayam ..
māse hyadyāyathākāmamidaṃ cādrāyaṇaṃ smṛtam..28..
1.172.d:
चत्वारिंशत्समायुक्तं पिंडानां हि शतद्वयम् ॥
मासे ह्यद्यायथाकाममिदं चाद्रायणं स्मृतम्॥28॥
1.172.m: Two hundred and forty mouthfuls [of food], / eaten as desired over a month—this is known as the cāndrāyaṇa fast.

1.172.s:
ṛṣibhiḥ sarvaśāstrajñaistaponiṣṭhairjiteṃdriyaiḥ ..
devaiśca sevitaṃ toyaṃ kṣitau tattīrthamu cyate .. 29 ..
1.172.d:
ऋषिभिः सर्वशास्त्रज्ञैस्तपोनिष्ठैर्जितेंद्रियैः ॥
देवैश्च सेवितं तोयं क्षितौ तत्तीर्थमु च्यते ॥ 29 ॥
1.172.m: Water frequented on earth by sages knowing all sacred texts, / devoted to austerity, of subdued senses, and by the gods, is called a pilgrimage place.

1.172.s:
sūryāvāṃtarasthānāni puṇyakṣetrāṇi nirdiśet..
mṛtānāṃ teṣu sūryatvaṃ saurakṣetreṣu dehinām .. 1.172.30 ..
1.172.d:
सूर्यावांतरस्थानानि पुण्यक्षेत्राणि निर्दिशेत्॥
मृतानां तेषु सूर्यत्वं सौरक्षेत्रेषु देहिनाम् ॥ 1.172.30 ॥
1.172.m: The intermediate sacred places of the sun are pointed out as holy fields; / those who die in these solar fields attain the nature of the sun.

1.172.s:
dānānyāvasathaṃ kuryādudyānaṃ deva tāgṛham .. āvasatha
tīrtheṣvetāni yaḥ kuryātso'kṣayaṃ labhate phalam .. 31 ..
1.172.d:
दानान्यावसथं कुर्यादुद्यानं देव तागृहम् ॥ आवसथ
तीर्थेष्वेतानि यः कुर्यात्सोऽक्षयं लभते फलम् ॥ 31 ॥
1.172.m: One should make gifts, build a rest-house, a park, and a temple to a deity; / he who makes these at pilgrimage places obtains imperishable fruit.

1.172.s:
kṣāntiḥ spṛhā tathā satyaṃ dānaṃ śīlaṃ tapaḥ śrutam..
etadaṣṭāṃgamuddiṣṭaṃ paraṃ pātrasya lakṣaṇam .. 32 ..
1.172.d:
क्षान्तिः स्पृहा तथा सत्यं दानं शीलं तपः श्रुतम्॥
एतदष्टांगमुद्दिष्टं परं पात्रस्य लक्षणम् ॥ 32 ॥
1.172.m: Forbearance, absence of desire, truth, giving, good conduct, austerity, and Vedic learning— / this eightfold characteristic is declared to be the mark of a supreme recipient.

1.172.s:
yajñopavāsadānāni tapastīrtharphalāni ca ..
saṃpūrṇaṃ labhate bhaktyā bhojayitvā tu bhojakān .. 33 ..
1.172.d:
यज्ञोपवासदानानि तपस्तीर्थर्फलानि च ॥
संपूर्णं लभते भक्त्या भोजयित्वा तु भोजकान् ॥ 33 ॥
1.172.m: The complete fruits of sacrifice, fasting, gifts, / austerity, and pilgrimage places he obtains by feeding the Bhojakas with devotion.

1.172.s:
sūre bhaktiḥ kṣamā satyaṃ daśeṃdriyavinigrahaḥ ..
sukhiteṣu ca maitrī ca sūryadharmasya lakṣaṇam .. 34 ..
1.172.d:
सूरे भक्तिः क्षमा सत्यं दशेंद्रियविनिग्रहः ॥
सुखितेषु च मैत्री च सूर्यधर्मस्य लक्षणम् ॥ 34 ॥
1.172.m: Devotion to the sun, patience, truth, restraint of the ten senses, / and friendliness toward the happy are the characteristic of the solar dharma.

1.172.s:
sūryabhaktaṃ dvijaṃ bhaktyā yaḥ śrāddheṣu ca bhojayet ..
kulasaptakamuddhṛtya sūryaloke mahīyate .. 35 ..
1.172.d:
सूर्यभक्तं द्विजं भक्त्या यः श्राद्धेषु च भोजयेत् ॥
कुलसप्तकमुद्धृत्य सूर्यलोके महीयते ॥ 35 ॥
1.172.m: He who feeds with devotion a twice-born devotee of the sun at ancestral rites, / having delivered seven generations of his family, is honoured in the world of the sun.

1.172.s:
bahunātra kimuktena sūryabhaktaṃ tu bhojayet ..
sūryabhaktena yadbhuktaṃ bhānunāmāśrayaṃ nṛpa .. 36 ..
1.172.d:
बहुनात्र किमुक्तेन सूर्यभक्तं तु भोजयेत् ॥
सूर्यभक्तेन यद्भुक्तं भानुनामाश्रयं नृप ॥ 36 ॥
1.172.m: What need is there of saying much here? One should feed a devotee of Sūrya. / What is consumed by a devotee of Sūrya is an offering dedicated to the Sun, O king.

1.172.s:
na vedaviduṣāṃ koṭyā labhyate ceha tatphalam ..
tatphalaṃ labhate rājanbhojaṃ bhājya vidhānataḥ .. 37 ..
1.172.d:
न वेदविदुषां कोट्या लभ्यते चेह तत्फलम् ॥
तत्फलं लभते राजन्भोजं भाज्य विधानतः ॥ 37 ॥
1.172.m: That fruit cannot be obtained in this world even by ten million scholars of the Vedas; / one attains that fruit, O king, by feeding a Bhojaka according to rule.

1.172.s:
tasmācchrāddhe viśeṣeṇa puṇyeṣu divaseṣu ca ..
sūryamuddiśya vipreṃdra bhojaṃ saṃbhojayennṛpa .. 38 ..
1.172.d:
तस्माच्छ्राद्धे विशेषेण पुण्येषु दिवसेषु च ॥
सूर्यमुद्दिश्य विप्रेंद्र भोजं संभोजयेन्नृप ॥ 38 ॥
1.172.m: Therefore, especially in śrāddhas and on auspicious days, / one should feed a Bhojaka in honour of Sūrya, O chief of brahmins, O king.

1.172.s:
asaṃyataḥ saṃyato vā sarvāvasthāṃ gatopi vā ..
yaścāsau ravibhaktaḥ syātsūryavatpūjya eva hi .. 39 ..
1.172.d:
असंयतः संयतो वा सर्वावस्थां गतोपि वा ॥
यश्चासौ रविभक्तः स्यात्सूर्यवत्पूज्य एव हि ॥ 39 ॥
1.172.m: Whether uncontrolled or self-controlled, or in whatever state he may be, / whoever is a devotee of the Sun is indeed to be worshipped like Sūrya himself.

1.172.s:
saṃsargādvāpi vā lobhādbhojakaṃ yastu bhojayet ..
so'pi yāṃ gatimāpnoti na tāṃ yajñaśatairapi .. 1.172.40 ..
1.172.d:
संसर्गाद्वापि वा लोभाद्भोजकं यस्तु भोजयेत् ॥
सोऽपि यां गतिमाप्नोति न तां यज्ञशतैरपि ॥ 1.172.40 ॥
1.172.m: Even if one feeds a Bhojaka out of mere association or even greed, / he too attains a state that cannot be reached even by hundreds of sacrifices.

1.172.s:
tasmānmānyaśca pūjyaśca rakṣaṇīyaśca sarvadā ..
bhojakaḥ kuruśārdūla saureṇa gatimicchatā .. 41 ..
1.172.d:
तस्मान्मान्यश्च पूज्यश्च रक्षणीयश्च सर्वदा ॥
भोजकः कुरुशार्दूल सौरेण गतिमिच्छता ॥ 41 ॥
1.172.m: Therefore, a Bhojaka is always to be honoured, worshipped, and protected, / O tiger among the Kurus, by a worshipper of the Sun who desires salvation.

1.172.s:
nāmamātraprayatno'pi yadi syādbhojako raveḥ ..
sūryavatsa hi draṣṭavyaḥ pūjanīyaśca bhārata .. 42 ..
1.172.d:
नाममात्रप्रयत्नोऽपि यदि स्याद्भोजको रवेः ॥
सूर्यवत्स हि द्रष्टव्यः पूजनीयश्च भारत ॥ 42 ॥
1.172.m: Even if one is a Bhojaka of the Sun in name alone, / he should be viewed as Sūrya himself and worshipped, O Bhārata.

1.172.s:
gṛhe śrāddhasya yatpuṇyamaraṇye tacchatādhikam ..
saurāśrameṣu vijñeyaṃ tatpuṇyamayutādhikam .. 43 ..
1.172.d:
गृहे श्राद्धस्य यत्पुण्यमरण्ये तच्छताधिकम् ॥
सौराश्रमेषु विज्ञेयं तत्पुण्यमयुताधिकम् ॥ 43 ॥
1.172.m: The merit of a śrāddha [performed] at home is multiplied a hundredfold in the wilderness; / in hermitage grounds dedicated to Sūrya, that merit should be known to be multiplied ten thousandfold.

1.172.s:
dattvā tu bhojake saumyaṃ hyāsanaṃ saparicchadam ..
dhātudaṃtamayaṃ cāpi rājā bhavati bhūtale .. 44 ..
1.172.d:
दत्त्वा तु भोजके सौम्यं ह्यासनं सपरिच्छदम् ॥
धातुदंतमयं चापि राजा भवति भूतले ॥ 44 ॥
1.172.m: Having given to a Bhojaka a pleasant seat furnished with accessories, / even one made of metal or ivory, a man becomes a king upon the earth.

1.172.s:
vimale vāsasī dattvā bhojakāya mahīpate ..
uddhṛtya śatasāhasraṃ sūryaloke mahīyate .. 45 ..
1.172.d:
विमले वाससी दत्त्वा भोजकाय महीपते ॥
उद्धृत्य शतसाहस्रं सूर्यलोके महीयते ॥ 45 ॥
1.172.m: Having given two spotless garments to a Bhojaka, O lord of the earth, / having delivered a hundred thousand [ancestors], he is glorified in the world of Sūrya.

1.172.s:
dattvā tu lomaśāṃ rājanbhojakāya śubhāṃ bṛhat ..
romṇiromṇi suvarṇasya dattasya phalamāpnuyāt .. 46 ..
1.172.d:
दत्त्वा तु लोमशां राजन्भोजकाय शुभां बृहत् ॥
रोम्णिरोम्णि सुवर्णस्य दत्तस्य फलमाप्नुयात् ॥ 46 ॥
1.172.m: Having given a large, fine woolen garment to a Bhojaka, O king, / he obtains the fruit of giving gold for every single hair [of it].

1.172.s:
śaṃkhaṃ dadāti yo bhaktyā tathā divye ca pāduke ..
sūryalokamavāpnoti tejasā ravisannibhaḥ .. 47 ..
1.172.d:
शंखं ददाति यो भक्त्या तथा दिव्ये च पादुके ॥
सूर्यलोकमवाप्नोति तेजसा रविसन्निभः ॥ 47 ॥
1.172.m: He who with devotion gives a conch and two divine sandals / attains the world of Sūrya, equalling the Sun in splendour.

1.172.s:
likhāpayati yo bhaktyā purāṇena tu pustakam ..
yugakoṭiśataṃ divyaṃ sūryaloke mahīyate .. 48 ..
1.172.d:
लिखापयति यो भक्त्या पुराणेन तु पुस्तकम् ॥
युगकोटिशतं दिव्यं सूर्यलोके महीयते ॥ 48 ॥
1.172.m: He who with devotion has a book of the Purāṇa written down / is glorified in the world of Sūrya for a hundred times ten million divine yugas.

1.172.s:
bhavedihāgataḥ śrīmānsukhāḍhyo vedapāragaḥ..
yaḥ karoti gṛhaṃ bhānostatsthānaṃ cottamaṃ bhavet .. 49 ..
1.172.d:
भवेदिहागतः श्रीमान्सुखाढ्यो वेदपारगः॥
यः करोति गृहं भानोस्तत्स्थानं चोत्तमं भवेत् ॥ 49 ॥
1.172.m: Returning here, he becomes wealthy, filled with happiness, and a master of the Vedas. / If one builds a house for the Sun, his abode becomes supreme.

1.172.s:
tatsūryo bhojakaḥ sotra bhojakaḥ sūrya eva hi ..
tena bhojakavipreṣu dānamakṣayyamityapi .. 1.172.50 ..
1.172.d:
तत्सूर्यो भोजकः सोत्र भोजकः सूर्य एव हि ॥
तेन भोजकविप्रेषु दानमक्षय्यमित्यपि ॥ 1.172.50 ॥
1.172.m: Sūrya is that Bhojaka, and the Bhojaka here is indeed Sūrya. / Therefore, a gift given to Bhojaka brahmins is imperishable.

1.172.s:
yadyadyasyopayujyeta deyaṃ tattasya yatnataḥ ..
upayogaparo nityaṃ sūryastadubhayorapi ..51..
1.172.d:
यद्यद्यस्योपयुज्येत देयं तत्तस्य यत्नतः ॥
उपयोगपरो नित्यं सूर्यस्तदुभयोरपि ॥51॥
1.172.m: Whatever may be useful to him should be given to him with effort; / Sūrya is ever devoted to being of benefit to both of them.

1.172.s:
vyākhyāne sauradharmasya kṛtvā āmalakaṃ mahat ..
śobhitaṃ puṣpapatrādyairnyasettatrāsane surāḥ .. 52 ..
1.172.d:
व्याख्याने सौरधर्मस्य कृत्वा आमलकं महत् ॥
शोभितं पुष्पपत्राद्यैर्न्यसेत्तत्रासने सुराः ॥ 52 ॥
1.172.m: At the exposition of the Saura doctrine, having made a great āmalaka fruit, / adorned with flowers, leaves, and the like, gods, one should place it there upon the seat.

1.172.s:
śobhitaṃ mālyagandhaistu sūryasya sādhanaṃ mahat ..
purastāttasya saṃsthāpya ācāryaṃ pūjayetsadā ..
sūryavatsauradharme ca tulyametaddvayaṃ vacaḥ .. 53 ..
1.172.d:
शोभितं माल्यगन्धैस्तु सूर्यस्य साधनं महत् ॥
पुरस्तात्तस्य संस्थाप्य आचार्यं पूजयेत्सदा ॥
सूर्यवत्सौरधर्मे च तुल्यमेतद्द्वयं वचः ॥ 53 ॥
1.172.m: It should be adorned with garlands and scents, a great means of worship for Sūrya; / setting it in front of him, one should always worship the teacher. / Both statements are equal: as Sūrya is, so is the Saura doctrine.

1.172.s:
ya evaṃ nyāyato vakti sauradharmaṃ śṛṇoti ca ..
āyurvidyāṃ yaśaḥ kīrtimupalabhya raviṃ japet ..
vadaṃtyanye pibaṃtyanye sarve te phalabhāginaḥ .. 54 ..
1.172.d:
य एवं न्यायतो वक्ति सौरधर्मं शृणोति च ॥
आयुर्विद्यां यशः कीर्तिमुपलभ्य रविं जपेत् ॥
वदंत्यन्ये पिबंत्यन्ये सर्वे ते फलभागिनः ॥ 54 ॥
1.172.m: He who correctly recites or hears this Saura doctrine, / having attained long life, learning, fame, and renown, should whisper the names of the Sun. / Some speak and others drink; they all share in the fruit.

1.172.s:
tasmādevaṃvidho dharmo vācakaiśca vidurbudhāḥ ..
tasyānte pūjayedbhaktyā ya icchedvipulaṃ yaśaḥ .. 55 ..
sauradharmavarṇanam
1.172.d:
तस्मादेवंविधो धर्मो वाचकैश्च विदुर्बुधाः ॥
तस्यान्ते पूजयेद्भक्त्या य इच्छेद्विपुलं यशः ॥ 55 ॥
सौरधर्मवर्णनम्
1.172.m:
Therefore, the wise know such to be the doctrine [expounded] by the reciters; / at its conclusion, he who desires vast renown should worship him with devotion.
Description of the Saura Doctrine

1.173.s:
.. śatānīka uvāca .. ..
punarme brūhi viprendra sauraṃ dharmamanuttamam ..
samāsātkathitaṃ brahmanvistareṇa prakīrtaya .. 1 ..
1.173.d:
॥ शतानीक उवाच ॥ ॥
पुनर्मे ब्रूहि विप्रेन्द्र सौरं धर्ममनुत्तमम् ॥
समासात्कथितं ब्रह्मन्विस्तरेण प्रकीर्तय ॥ 1 ॥
1.173.m: Śatānīka said: / Speak to me again, O chief of brahmins, of the unsurpassed Saura doctrine. / It has been spoken by you in brief, O holy one; proclaim it in detail.

1.173.s:
.. sumanturuvāca .. ..
sādhusādhu mahābāho sādhu pṛṣṭo'smi bhārata ..
tvatsamo nāsti loke'sminsauraḥ pārthivasattama .. 2 ..
1.173.d:
॥ सुमन्तुरुवाच ॥ ॥
साधुसाधु महाबाहो साधु पृष्टोऽस्मि भारत ॥
त्वत्समो नास्ति लोकेऽस्मिन्सौरः पार्थिवसत्तम ॥ 2 ॥
1.173.m: Sumantu said: / Well, well, O mighty-armed one! I have been questioned well, O Bhārata! / There is no devotee of the Sun equal to you in this world, O best of kings.

1.173.s:
kīrtayāmyatha taṃ puṇyaṃ saṃvādaṃ pāpanāśanam ..
garuḍāruṇayo rājanpurāvṛttaṃ narādhipa .. 3 ..
1.173.d:
कीर्तयाम्यथ तं पुण्यं संवादं पापनाशनम् ॥
गरुडारुणयो राजन्पुरावृत्तं नराधिप ॥ 3 ॥
1.173.m: I shall now proclaim that holy, sin-destroying dialogue / of Garuḍa and Aruṇa, O king, an ancient event, O ruler of men.

1.173.s:
sukhāsīnaṃ purā rājannaruṇaṃ sūryasārathim ..
upagamya mahābāho garuḍo vākyamavravīt .. 4 ..
1.173.d:
सुखासीनं पुरा राजन्नरुणं सूर्यसारथिम् ॥
उपगम्य महाबाहो गरुडो वाक्यमव्रवीत् ॥ 4 ॥
1.173.m: Formerly, O king, approaching Aruṇa, the charioteer of the Sun, / who was seated at ease, O mighty-armed one, Garuḍa spoke [these] words:

1.173.s:
dharmāṇāmuttamaṃ dharmaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ..
sauradharmaṃ khagaśreṣṭha brūhi me kṛtsnaśonagha .. 5 ..
1.173.d:
धर्माणामुत्तमं धर्मं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ॥
सौरधर्मं खगश्रेष्ठ ब्रूहि मे कृत्स्नशोनघ ॥ 5 ॥
1.173.m: "Declare to me entirely, O faultless one, O best of birds, / the supreme religious practice among all practices, destroying all sins, the Saura doctrine."

1.173.s:
.. aruṇa uvāca .. ..
sādhu vatsa mahātmāsi dhanyastvaṃ pāpavarjitaḥ ..
śrotukāmo'si yatputra sauradharmamanuttamam .. 6 ..
1.173.d:
॥ अरुण उवाच ॥ ॥
साधु वत्स महात्मासि धन्यस्त्वं पापवर्जितः ॥
श्रोतुकामोऽसि यत्पुत्र सौरधर्ममनुत्तमम् ॥ 6 ॥
1.173.m: Aruṇa said: / "Well done, my child! You are a great soul, blessed and free from sin, / since you desire to hear the unsurpassed Saura doctrine, O son.

1.173.s:
śṛṇu tvaṃ kīrtayāmyeṣa sukhopāyaṃ mahatphalam ..
paramaṃ sarvadharmāṇāṃ sauradharmamanuttamam .. 7 ..
1.173.d:
शृणु त्वं कीर्तयाम्येष सुखोपायं महत्फलम् ॥
परमं सर्वधर्माणां सौरधर्ममनुत्तमम् ॥ 7 ॥
1.173.m: Listen, I shall proclaim this easy means of great reward, / the highest of all doctrines, the unsurpassed Saura doctrine.

1.173.s:
ajñānārṇavamagnānāṃ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināmayam ..
sauradharmo hyayaṃ śrīmānparatīraprado yataḥ .. 8 ..
1.173.d:
अज्ञानार्णवमग्नानां सर्वेषां प्राणिनामयम् ॥
सौरधर्मो ह्ययं श्रीमान्परतीरप्रदो यतः ॥ 8 ॥
1.173.m: For all living beings sunk in the ocean of ignorance, / this glorious Saura doctrine grants the opposite shore.

1.173.s:
ye smaraṃti raviṃ bhaktyā kīrtayaṃti ca ye khaga ..
pūjayanti ca ye nityaṃ te gatāḥ paramaṃ padam .. 9 ..
1.173.d:
ये स्मरंति रविं भक्त्या कीर्तयंति च ये खग ॥
पूजयन्ति च ये नित्यं ते गताः परमं पदम् ॥ 9 ॥
1.173.m: Those who remember the Sun with devotion, and those who praise him, O bird, / and those who worship him daily, they have attained the supreme state.

1.173.s:
ātmadrohaḥ kṛtastena jāteneha khagādhipa ..
nārcito yena deveśaḥ sahasrakiraṇo raviḥ .. 1.173.10 ..
1.173.d:
आत्मद्रोहः कृतस्तेन जातेनेह खगाधिप ॥
नार्चितो येन देवेशः सहस्रकिरणो रविः ॥ 1.173.10 ॥
1.173.m: Treason against oneself has been committed by him who is born here, O lord of birds, / if he has not worshipped the lord of the gods, the thousand-rayed Sun.

1.173.s:
suciraṃ saṃbhramatyasminduḥkhade ca bhavārṇave ..
jarābhūtamahāgrāhe tṛṣṇāvelākulāpare .. 11 ..
1.173.d:
सुचिरं संभ्रमत्यस्मिन्दुःखदे च भवार्णवे ॥
जराभूतमहाग्राहे तृष्णावेलाकुलापरे ॥ 11 ॥
1.173.m: He wanders for a very long time in this sorrowful ocean of worldly existence, / where old age is the great crocodile and intense thirst forms the turbulent shore.

1.173.s:
mānuṣyaṃ durlabhaṃ prāpya ye'rcayaṃti divākaram..
teṣāṃ hi saphalaṃ janma kṛtārthāste narottamāḥ .. 12 ..
1.173.d:
मानुष्यं दुर्लभं प्राप्य येऽर्चयंति दिवाकरम्॥
तेषां हि सफलं जन्म कृतार्थास्ते नरोत्तमाः ॥ 12 ॥
1.173.m: Having obtained a human birth, which is hard to attain, those who worship the Maker of Day, / their birth is indeed fruitful, and those best of men have accomplished their purpose.

1.173.s:
sūryabhaktiparā ye ca ye ca tadgatamānasāḥ ..
ye smaraṃti sadā sūryaṃ na te duḥkhasya bhāginaḥ .. 13 ..
1.173.d:
सूर्यभक्तिपरा ये च ये च तद्गतमानसाः ॥
ये स्मरंति सदा सूर्यं न ते दुःखस्य भागिनः ॥ 13 ॥
1.173.m: Those who are devoted to the worship of Sūrya, and those whose minds are fixed upon him, / who always remember Sūrya, they do not share in sorrow.

1.173.s:
vividhāni manojñāni vividhābharaṇāḥ striyaḥ ..
dhanaṃ vā dṛṣṭaparyaṃtaṃ sūryapūjāvidheḥ phalam .. 14 ..
1.173.d:
विविधानि मनोज्ञानि विविधाभरणाः स्त्रियः ॥
धनं वा दृष्टपर्यंतं सूर्यपूजाविधेः फलम् ॥ 14 ॥
1.173.m: Delightful objects of various kinds, women adorned with varied ornaments, / or wealth as far as the eye can see, is the fruit of the rite of Sūrya's worship.

1.173.s:
ye vāṃchanti mahābhogānrājyaṃ vā tridaśā laye ..
saubhāgyaṃ kāṃtimatulāṃ bhogaṃ tyāgaṃ yaśaḥ śriyam .. 15 ..
1.173.d:
ये वांछन्ति महाभोगान्राज्यं वा त्रिदशा लये ॥
सौभाग्यं कांतिमतुलां भोगं त्यागं यशः श्रियम् ॥ 15 ॥
1.173.m: Those who desire great pleasures, or kingship in the abode of the gods, / good fortune, incomparable splendour, enjoyment, generosity, fame, and prosperity,

1.173.s:
saundaryaṃ jagataḥ khyātiḥ kīrtirdharmādayaḥ smṛtāḥ ..
phalānyetāni vai putra sūrya bhaktividherbudha .. 16 ..
1.173.d:
सौन्दर्यं जगतः ख्यातिः कीर्तिर्धर्मादयः स्मृताः ॥
फलान्येतानि वै पुत्र सूर्य भक्तिविधेर्बुध ॥ 16 ॥
1.173.m: beauty, renown in the world, glory, righteousness, and the rest— / these are declared to be the fruits of the practice of devotion to Sūrya, O wise son.

1.173.s:
tasmātsaṃpūjayetsūryaṃ sarvadevagaṇārcitam ..
durlabhā bhāskare bhaktirdurlabhaṃ ca tadarcanam .. 17 ..
1.173.d:
तस्मात्संपूजयेत्सूर्यं सर्वदेवगणार्चितम् ॥
दुर्लभा भास्करे भक्तिर्दुर्लभं च तदर्चनम् ॥ 17 ॥
1.173.m: Therefore, one should worship Sūrya, who is adored by all the hosts of gods. / Rare is devotion to the Creator of Light, and rare is his worship.

1.173.s:
dānaṃ ca durlabhaṃ tasmai taddhomaśca sudurlabhaḥ ..
durlabhaṃ tasya vijñānaṃ tadabhyāso'pi durlabhaḥ .. 18 ..
1.173.d:
दानं च दुर्लभं तस्मै तद्धोमश्च सुदुर्लभः ॥
दुर्लभं तस्य विज्ञानं तदभ्यासोऽपि दुर्लभः ॥ 18 ॥
1.173.m: Rare is a gift given to him, and very rare is a burnt offering made to him; / rare is profound knowledge of him, and rare is constant practice toward him.

1.173.s:
sudurlabhataraṃ jñeyaṃ tadārādhanamuttamam ..
lobhasteṣāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ ye raviṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ .. 19 ..
1.173.d:
सुदुर्लभतरं ज्ञेयं तदाराधनमुत्तमम् ॥
लोभस्तेषां मनुष्याणां ये रविं शरणं गताः ॥ 19 ॥
1.173.m: His supreme adoration is to be known as even more exceedingly rare; / longing belongs to those men who have gone to the Sun for refuge,

1.173.s:
yeṣāmiheśvare bhānau nityaṃ sūrye gataṃ manaḥ ..
namaskārādisaṃyuktaṃ ravirityakṣaradvayam .. 1.173.20 ..
1.173.d:
येषामिहेश्वरे भानौ नित्यं सूर्ये गतं मनः ॥
नमस्कारादिसंयुक्तं रविरित्यक्षरद्वयम् ॥ 1.173.20 ॥
1.173.m: whose mind in this world is always directed to Sūrya, the lord, the Sun. / The two syllables 'Ra-vi,' accompanied by salutation and the like,

1.173.s:
jihvāgre vartate yasya sakalaṃ tasya jīvitam ..
ya evaṃ pūjayedbhānuṃ śraddhayā parayānvitaḥ.
mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ sa naro nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 21 ..
1.173.d:
जिह्वाग्रे वर्तते यस्य सकलं तस्य जीवितम् ॥
य एवं पूजयेद्भानुं श्रद्धया परयान्वितः।
मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यः स नरो नात्र संशयः ॥ 21 ॥
1.173.m: he on the tip of whose tongue these abide, his life is complete. / He who worships the Sun in this manner, endowed with supreme faith, / is freed from all sins; there is no doubt of this."

1.173.s:
ḍākinyo vividhākārā rākṣasāḥ sapiśācakāḥ ..
na tasya pīḍāṃ kurvaṃti tathānyāśca vibhīṣaṇāḥ .. 22 ..
1.173.d:
डाकिन्यो विविधाकारा राक्षसाः सपिशाचकाः ॥
न तस्य पीडां कुर्वंति तथान्याश्च विभीषणाः ॥ 22 ॥
1.173.m: Ḍākinīs of various shapes, rākṣasas together with piśācas, / and other terrifying beings do not afflict him.

1.173.s:
śatravo nāśamāyāṃti saṃgrāme jayamāpnuyāt ..
na rogaiḥ pīḍyate vīra āpado na spṛśaṃti tam .. 23 ..
1.173.d:
शत्रवो नाशमायांति संग्रामे जयमाप्नुयात् ॥
न रोगैः पीड्यते वीर आपदो न स्पृशंति तम् ॥ 23 ॥
1.173.m: His enemies perish; he achieves victory in battle; / he is not tormented by diseases, O hero, and misfortunes do not touch him.

1.173.s:
dhanamāyuryaśo vidyā prabhāvo hyatulaṃ tathā ..
śubhenopacayaṃ yāṃti nityaṃ pūrṇamanorathāḥ ...24 .. ..
sūryastutivarṇanam
1.173.d:
धनमायुर्यशो विद्या प्रभावो ह्यतुलं तथा ॥
शुभेनोपचयं यांति नित्यं पूर्णमनोरथाः ॥.24 ॥ ॥
सूर्यस्तुतिवर्णनम्
1.173.m:
Wealth, longevity, fame, learning, and matchless power / increase auspiciously for those whose desires are constantly fulfilled.
Description of the Praise of Sūrya

1.174.s:
.. .. aruṇa uvāca .. ..
pūjayitvā raviṃ bhaktyā brahmā bahmatvamāgataḥ ..
viṣṇutvaṃ cāpi deveśo viṣṣurāpa tadarcanāt .. 1 ..
1.174.d:
॥ ॥ अरुण उवाच ॥ ॥
पूजयित्वा रविं भक्त्या ब्रह्मा बह्मत्वमागतः ॥
विष्णुत्वं चापि देवेशो विष्षुराप तदर्चनात् ॥ 1 ॥
1.174.m: Aruṇa said: / Having worshipped Ravi with devotion, Brahmā attained the state of Brahmā; / and Viṣṇu, lord of the gods, attained the state of Viṣṇu from his worship.

1.174.s:
śaṃkaro'pi jagannāthaḥ pūjayitvā divākaram ..
mahādevatvamagamattatprasādātkhagādhipa .. 2 ..
1.174.d:
शंकरोऽपि जगन्नाथः पूजयित्वा दिवाकरम् ॥
महादेवत्वमगमत्तत्प्रसादात्खगाधिप ॥ 2 ॥
1.174.m: Even Śaṅkara, lord of the world, having worshipped the maker of day, / attained the state of Mahādeva through his grace, O king of birds!

1.174.s:
sahasrākṣopi deveśa indro bhānuṃ tamopaham ..
indratvamagamaddevaṃ pūjayitvā divākaram .. 3 ..
1.174.d:
सहस्राक्षोपि देवेश इन्द्रो भानुं तमोपहम् ॥
इन्द्रत्वमगमद्देवं पूजयित्वा दिवाकरम् ॥ 3 ॥
1.174.m: Even the thousand-eyed Indra, lord of the gods, worshipped the maker of day, / the radiant dispeller of darkness, and attained the state of Indra.

1.174.s:
mātaro devagaṃdharvāḥ piśācoragarākṣasāḥ ..
pūjayaṃti sadā bhānumīśānaṃ suranāyakam .. 4 ..
1.174.d:
मातरो देवगंधर्वाः पिशाचोरगराक्षसाः ॥
पूजयंति सदा भानुमीशानं सुरनायकम् ॥ 4 ॥
1.174.m: The Mothers, gods, gandharvas, piśācas, uragas, and rākṣasas / perpetually worship the radiant lord, the leader of the gods.

1.174.s:
sarvametajjagannityaṃ bhānau deve pratiṣṭhitam ..
tasmātsaṃpūjayedbhānuṃ ya icchetsvargamakṣayam .. 5 ..
1.174.d:
सर्वमेतज्जगन्नित्यं भानौ देवे प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥
तस्मात्संपूजयेद्भानुं य इच्छेत्स्वर्गमक्षयम् ॥ 5 ॥
1.174.m: All this world is eternally established in the radiant god; / therefore whoever desires imperishable heaven should fully worship the sun.

1.174.s:
yo na pūjayate sūryaṃ bhāskaraṃ tamasūdanam ..
dharmārthakāmamokṣāṇāṃ na naro bhājanaṃ bhavet .. 6 ..
1.174.d:
यो न पूजयते सूर्यं भास्करं तमसूदनम् ॥
धर्मार्थकाममोक्षाणां न नरो भाजनं भवेत् ॥ 6 ॥
1.174.m: A man who does not worship Sūrya, the luminous destroyer of darkness, / does not become a receptacle of dharma, wealth, pleasure, and liberation.

1.174.s:
tasmātkāryaṃ hi taddhyānaṃ yāvajjīvaṃ pratijñayā ..
arcayeta sadā bhānumāpanno'pi sadā khaga .. .. 7 ..
1.174.d:
तस्मात्कार्यं हि तद्ध्यानं यावज्जीवं प्रतिज्ञया ॥
अर्चयेत सदा भानुमापन्नोऽपि सदा खग ॥ ॥ 7 ॥
1.174.m: Therefore, meditation upon him must be performed for life by vow; / even in distress, one should always worship the sun, O bird.

1.174.s:
yastu saṃtiṣṭhate nityaṃ vinā sūryasya pūjanāt ..
varaṃ prāṇaparityāgaḥ śiraso vātha cchedanam .. 8 ..
1.174.d:
यस्तु संतिष्ठते नित्यं विना सूर्यस्य पूजनात् ॥
वरं प्राणपरित्यागः शिरसो वाथ च्छेदनम् ॥ 8 ॥
1.174.m: For one who remains continually without the worship of Sūrya, / relinquishment of life or the severing of his head is better.

1.174.s:
sūryaṃ saṃpūjya bhuñjīta tridaśeśaṃ divākaram ..
itthaṃ nirvahate yasya yāvajjīvaṃ tadarcanam ..
manuṣyacarmaṇā naddhaḥ sa ravirnātra saṃśayaḥ .. 9 ..
1.174.d:
सूर्यं संपूज्य भुञ्जीत त्रिदशेशं दिवाकरम् ॥
इत्थं निर्वहते यस्य यावज्जीवं तदर्चनम् ॥
मनुष्यचर्मणा नद्धः स रविर्नात्र संशयः ॥ 9 ॥
1.174.m: Having worshipped Sūrya, the maker of day, lord of the thirty [gods], one should eat; / he whose worship of him is maintained thus for his whole life / is Ravi clothed in human skin, of this there is no doubt.

1.174.s:
na hi arkārcanādanyatpuṇyamapyadhikaṃ bhavet ..
iti vijñāya yatnena pūjayasva divākaram .. 1.174.10 ..
1.174.d:
न हि अर्कार्चनादन्यत्पुण्यमप्यधिकं भवेत् ॥
इति विज्ञाय यत्नेन पूजयस्व दिवाकरम् ॥ 1.174.10 ॥
1.174.m: There is no merit greater than the worship of Arka; / knowing this, worship the maker of day with diligence.

1.174.s:
sūryabhaktāgamāścaiva sūryārcanaparāyaṇāḥ ..
saṃyatā dharmasaṃpannā dharmādīnsādhayanti te .. 11 ..
1.174.d:
सूर्यभक्तागमाश्चैव सूर्यार्चनपरायणाः ॥
संयता धर्मसंपन्ना धर्मादीन्साधयन्ति ते ॥ 11 ॥
1.174.m: Those who adhere to the traditions of devotion to Sūrya, intent on Sūrya's worship, / self-controlled and endowed with righteousness, accomplish dharma and the other [ends of life].

1.174.s:
sarvadvandvasahā vīrā nītividhyuktacetasaḥ ..
paropakāraniratā guruśuśrūṣaṇe ratāḥ .. 12 ..
1.174.d:
सर्वद्वन्द्वसहा वीरा नीतिविध्युक्तचेतसः ॥
परोपकारनिरता गुरुशुश्रूषणे रताः ॥ 12 ॥
1.174.m: They endure all pairs of opposites, heroes whose minds are fixed on what is taught by moral precepts and injunctions, / devoted to the welfare of others, intent on serving their guru,

1.174.s:
amānino buddhimanto'vyaktaspardhā gataspṛhāḥ ..
śāṃtā svāṃtagatā bhadrā nityaṃ svāgatavādinaḥ .. 13 ..
1.174.d:
अमानिनो बुद्धिमन्तोऽव्यक्तस्पर्धा गतस्पृहाः ॥
शांता स्वांतगता भद्रा नित्यं स्वागतवादिनः ॥ 13 ॥
1.174.m: free from pride, intelligent, devoid of outward rivalry, free from longing, / tranquil, inward-focused, auspicious, ever speaking words of welcome,

1.174.s:
svalpavācaḥ sumanasaḥ śūrāḥ śāstraviśāradāḥ ..
śaucācārasusaṃpannā dayādākṣiṇyagocarāḥ .. 14 .. daṃbhamatsaranirmuktāstṛṣṇālobhavivarjitāḥ ..
1.174.d:
स्वल्पवाचः सुमनसः शूराः शास्त्रविशारदाः ॥
शौचाचारसुसंपन्ना दयादाक्षिण्यगोचराः ॥ 14 ॥ दंभमत्सरनिर्मुक्तास्तृष्णालोभविवर्जिताः ॥
1.174.m: speaking little, well-disposed, courageous, skilled in the sacred treatises, / fully endowed with purity and right conduct, abiding in compassion and courtesy, freed from deceit and envy, devoid of thirst and greed,

1.174.s: saṃvibhāgaparāḥ proktā na śaṭhāścāpyakutsitāḥ .. 15 ..
1.174.d: संविभागपराः प्रोक्ता न शठाश्चाप्यकुत्सिताः ॥ 15 ॥
1.174.m: devoted to sharing, not deceitful, and uncensured.

1.174.s:
viṣayeṣvapi nirlepāḥ padmapatramivāṃbhasā ..
na dīnā māninaścaiva na ca rogavaśānugāḥ .. 16 ..
1.174.d:
विषयेष्वपि निर्लेपाः पद्मपत्रमिवांभसा ॥
न दीना मानिनश्चैव न च रोगवशानुगाः ॥ 16 ॥
1.174.m: Unstained even amid sensory objects like a lotus leaf by water, / not wretched, respectful, and not subject to disease,

1.174.s:
bhavaṃti bhāvitātmānaḥ susnigdhāḥ sādhusevitāḥ ..
na pāṇipādavākcakṣuḥśrotraśiśnodare ratāḥ .. 17 ..
1.174.d:
भवंति भावितात्मानः सुस्निग्धाः साधुसेविताः ॥
न पाणिपादवाक्चक्षुःश्रोत्रशिश्नोदरे रताः ॥ 17 ॥
1.174.m: their souls are cultivated, deeply affectionate, resorted to by the virtuous, / not indulging hand, foot, speech, eye, ear, penis, or belly.

1.174.s:
capalāni na kurvaṃti sarvavyāsaṃgavarjitāḥ ..
sūryāsanaratāḥ śāṃtāḥ ṣaḍakṣaramanogatāḥ .. 18 ..
1.174.d:
चपलानि न कुर्वंति सर्वव्यासंगवर्जिताः ॥
सूर्यासनरताः शांताः षडक्षरमनोगताः ॥ 18 ॥
1.174.m: They commit no fickle acts, freed from all attachments, / taking joy in Sūrya's seat, tranquil, their minds dwelling on the six syllables.

1.174.s:
ityācārasamāyuktā bhavaṃti bhuvi mānavāḥ ..
ekāṃtabhaktimāsthāya dharmakāmārthasiddhaye .. 19 ..
1.174.d:
इत्याचारसमायुक्ता भवंति भुवि मानवाः ॥
एकांतभक्तिमास्थाय धर्मकामार्थसिद्धये ॥ 19 ॥
1.174.m: Such men exist on earth endowed with this conduct, / relying on one-pointed devotion for the attainment of dharma, pleasure, and wealth.

1.174.s:
pūjanīyo ravirnityaṃ guṇeṣveteṣu vartate ..
sarveṣāmeva pātrāṇāmatipātraṃ divākaraḥ ..
patantaṃ trāyate yasmādatīva narakārṇavāt .. 1.174.20 ..
1.174.d:
पूजनीयो रविर्नित्यं गुणेष्वेतेषु वर्तते ॥
सर्वेषामेव पात्राणामतिपात्रं दिवाकरः ॥
पतन्तं त्रायते यस्मादतीव नरकार्णवात् ॥ 1.174.20 ॥
1.174.m: Ravi must be worshipped constantly by one who abides in these virtues; / the maker of day is the foremost recipient among all worthy recipients, / because he rescues one who is falling from the dreadful ocean of hell.

1.174.s:
tasya pātrātipātrasya māhātmyaṃ dānamaṇvapi ..
anena phalamādiṣṭamihaloke paratra ca .. 21 ..
1.174.d:
तस्य पात्रातिपात्रस्य माहात्म्यं दानमण्वपि ॥
अनेन फलमादिष्टमिहलोके परत्र च ॥ 21 ॥
1.174.m: Even a minute gift given to him, the supreme recipient, possesses great majesty; / through this, reward is proclaimed in this world and the next.

1.174.s:
dravyeṇāpi hi yaḥ kuryānnaraḥ karma tadālaye ..
so'pi dehakṣaye jñānaṃ prāpya śāṃtimavāpnuyāt ..22..
1.174.d:
द्रव्येणापि हि यः कुर्यान्नरः कर्म तदालये ॥
सोऽपि देहक्षये ज्ञानं प्राप्य शांतिमवाप्नुयात् ॥22॥
1.174.m: A man who performs service in his temple, even with wealth, / also obtains knowledge at the dissolution of the body and attains peace.

1.174.s:
sarvadvijakadaṃbeṣu kaścijjñānamavāpnuyāt ..
kaścidetattu me divyaṃ labdhvā jñānaṃ vimuñcati .. 23 ..
1.174.d:
सर्वद्विजकदंबेषु कश्चिज्ज्ञानमवाप्नुयात् ॥
कश्चिदेतत्तु मे दिव्यं लब्ध्वा ज्ञानं विमुञ्चति ॥ 23 ॥
1.174.m: Among all assemblages of the twice-born, someone may obtain knowledge; / yet someone, having attained this divine knowledge of mine, abandons it.

1.174.s:
tāvadbhramaṃti saṃsāre duḥkhaśokapariplutāḥ ..
na bhavaṃti raverbhaktā yāvatsarvepi dehinaḥ .. 24 ..
1.174.d:
तावद्भ्रमंति संसारे दुःखशोकपरिप्लुताः ॥
न भवंति रवेर्भक्ता यावत्सर्वेपि देहिनः ॥ 24 ॥
1.174.m: All embodied beings wander in saṃsāra overcome by sorrow and grief / only so long as they do not become devotees of Ravi.

1.174.s:
sūryasyālepanaṃ puṇyaṃ dviguṇaṃ candanasya tu ..
candanādagurau jñeyaṃ puṇyamaṣṭaguṇottaram .. 25 ..
1.174.d:
सूर्यस्यालेपनं पुण्यं द्विगुणं चन्दनस्य तु ॥
चन्दनादगुरौ ज्ञेयं पुण्यमष्टगुणोत्तरम् ॥ 25 ॥
1.174.m: Anointment of Sūrya brings merit, and sandalwood double that; / beyond sandalwood, [anointment with] agallochum should be known as eight times greater in merit.

1.174.s:
kṛṣṇāgurau viśeṣeṇa dviguṇaṃ phalamiṣyate ..
tasmācchataguṇa puṇyaṃ kuṃkumasya vidhīyate .. 26 ..
1.174.d:
कृष्णागुरौ विशेषेण द्विगुणं फलमिष्यते ॥
तस्माच्छतगुण पुण्यं कुंकुमस्य विधीयते ॥ 26 ॥
1.174.m: In the case of black agallochum, twice that fruit is especially sought; / beyond that, a hundredfold merit of saffron is ordained.

1.174.s:
sūryayajñopakaraṇaṃ kṛtvālpaṃ yadi vā bahu ..
bhāvādvittānusāreṇa sūryaloke mahīyate .. 27 ..
1.174.d:
सूर्ययज्ञोपकरणं कृत्वाल्पं यदि वा बहु ॥
भावाद्वित्तानुसारेण सूर्यलोके महीयते ॥ 27 ॥
1.174.m: Having provided equipment for Sūrya's sacrifice, whether little or much, / with devotion according to one's wealth, one is exalted in Sūrya's realm.

1.174.s:
yadapīṣṭamaniṣṭaṃ ca nyāyenobhayamāgatam ..
tatsūryāya nivedyaṃ sadbhaktyānantaphalārthinā .. 28 ..
1.174.d:
यदपीष्टमनिष्टं च न्यायेनोभयमागतम् ॥
तत्सूर्याय निवेद्यं सद्भक्त्यानन्तफलार्थिना ॥ 28 ॥
1.174.m: Whatever has been obtained lawfully, whether pleasant or unpleasant, / should be offered to Sūrya by one who desires infinite reward with true devotion.

1.174.s:
karmaśāṭhyena yaḥ kuryādduḥkhenāpi tadarcanam ..
so'pi dvijo divaṃ yāti karmaṇā pāpavarjitaḥ .. 29 ..
1.174.d:
कर्मशाठ्येन यः कुर्याद्दुःखेनापि तदर्चनम् ॥
सोऽपि द्विजो दिवं याति कर्मणा पापवर्जितः ॥ 29 ॥
1.174.m: Even one who performs his worship with flawed action or with difficulty, / even that twice-born goes to heaven, freed from sin through that deed.

1.174.s:
sarvamanyatparityajya sūrye caikamanā sadā ..
sūryapūjāvidhiṃ kuryādya icchecchreya ātmanaḥ .. 1.174.30 ..
1.174.d:
सर्वमन्यत्परित्यज्य सूर्ये चैकमना सदा ॥
सूर्यपूजाविधिं कुर्याद्य इच्छेच्छ्रेय आत्मनः ॥ 1.174.30 ॥
1.174.m: Abandoning everything else and always single-minded toward Sūrya, / one who desires his own highest good should perform the rite of Sūrya's worship.

1.174.s:
tvaritaṃ jīvitaṃ yāti tvaritaṃ yauvanaṃ tathā ..
tvaritaṃ vyādhirapyeti tasmānnityaṃ raviṃ vrajet .. 31 ..
1.174.d:
त्वरितं जीवितं याति त्वरितं यौवनं तथा ॥
त्वरितं व्याधिरप्येति तस्मान्नित्यं रविं व्रजेत् ॥ 31 ॥
1.174.m: Life passes swiftly, and youth passes swiftly; / disease also comes swiftly: therefore, one should continually take refuge in Ravi.

1.174.s:
yāvannābhyeti maraṇaṃ yāvannākramate jarā !..
yāvanneṃdriya vaikalyaṃ tāvadarceddivākaram .. 32 ..
1.174.d:
यावन्नाभ्येति मरणं यावन्नाक्रमते जरा !॥
यावन्नेंद्रिय वैकल्यं तावदर्चेद्दिवाकरम् ॥ 32 ॥
1.174.m: As long as death does not arrive, as long as old age does not overpower, / as long as the senses are not impaired, one should worship the maker of day.

1.174.s:
na sūryārcanatulyopi na dharmonyo jagattraye ..
itthaṃ vijñāya deveśaṃ pūjayasva divākaram .. 33 ..
1.174.d:
न सूर्यार्चनतुल्योपि न धर्मोन्यो जगत्त्रये ॥
इत्थं विज्ञाय देवेशं पूजयस्व दिवाकरम् ॥ 33 ॥
1.174.m: There is no other duty in the three worlds equal to worshipping Sūrya; / knowing this, worship the lord of the gods, the maker of day.

1.174.s:
ye bhaktyā devadeveśaṃ sūryaṃ śāṃtamajaṃ prabhum..
iha loke sukhaṃ prāpya te gatāḥ paramaṃ padam .. 34 ..
1.174.d:
ये भक्त्या देवदेवेशं सूर्यं शांतमजं प्रभुम्॥
इह लोके सुखं प्राप्य ते गताः परमं पदम् ॥ 34 ॥
1.174.m: Those who with devotion [worship] the lord of gods, Sūrya, the tranquil, unborn lord, / have attained happiness in this world and gone to the supreme state.

1.174.s:
gopatiṃ pūjayitvā tu prahṛṣṭenāṃtarātmanā ..
kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā purā brahmābravīdidam .. 35 ..
1.174.d:
गोपतिं पूजयित्वा तु प्रहृष्टेनांतरात्मना ॥
कृतांजलिपुटो भूत्वा पुरा ब्रह्माब्रवीदिदम् ॥ 35 ॥
1.174.m: Having worshipped the lord of rays with a joyful inner self / and having folded his hands in reverence, Brahmā spoke this of old:

1.174.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
bhagavantaṃ bhagakaraṃ śāṃtacittamanuttamam ..
devamārgapraṇetāraṃ praṇato'smi raviṃ sadā .. .. 36 ..
1.174.d:
॥ ब्रह्मोवाच ॥ ॥
भगवन्तं भगकरं शांतचित्तमनुत्तमम् ॥
देवमार्गप्रणेतारं प्रणतोऽस्मि रविं सदा ॥ ॥ 36 ॥
1.174.m: Brahmā said: / I ever bow to Ravi, the lord, creator of fortune, tranquil-minded, supreme, / the guide along the path of the gods;

1.174.s:
śāśvataṃ śobhanaṃ śuddhaṃ citrabhānuṃ divaspatim ..
devadeveśamīśeśaṃ praṇato'smi divākaram .. 37 ..
1.174.d:
शाश्वतं शोभनं शुद्धं चित्रभानुं दिवस्पतिम् ॥
देवदेवेशमीशेशं प्रणतोऽस्मि दिवाकरम् ॥ 37 ॥
1.174.m: to the eternal, handsome, pure, brightly radiant lord of day, / the lord of gods, the supreme ruler, maker of day, I bow;

1.174.s:
sarvaduḥkhaharaṃ devaṃ sarvaduḥkhaharaṃ ravim ..
varānanaṃ varāṃgaṃ ca varasthānaṃ varapradam.. 38 ..
1.174.d:
सर्वदुःखहरं देवं सर्वदुःखहरं रविम् ॥
वराननं वरांगं च वरस्थानं वरप्रदम्॥ 38 ॥
1.174.m: to the god who removes all suffering, to Ravi who takes away every affliction, / of noble countenance, of noble limbs, the excellent abode, giver of boons;

1.174.s:
vareṇyaṃ varadaṃ nityaṃ praṇato'smi vibhāvasum ..
arkamaryamaṇaṃ cendraṃ viṣṇumīśaṃ divākaram .. 39 ..
1.174.d:
वरेण्यं वरदं नित्यं प्रणतोऽस्मि विभावसुम् ॥
अर्कमर्यमणं चेन्द्रं विष्णुमीशं दिवाकरम् ॥ 39 ॥
1.174.m: to the choicest, boon-granting light-maker, I continually bow: / to Arka, Aryaman, Indra, Viṣṇu, Īśa, the maker of day.

1.174.s:
deveśvaraṃ devarataṃ praṇato'smi vibhāvasum ..
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ brahmaṇoktaṃ stavaṃ param ..
sa hi kīrtiṃ parāṃ prāpya punaḥ sūryapuraṃ vrajet .. 1.174.40 ..
sūryāgnikarmavarṇanam
1.174.d:
देवेश्वरं देवरतं प्रणतोऽस्मि विभावसुम् ॥
य इदं शृणुयान्नित्यं ब्रह्मणोक्तं स्तवं परम् ॥
स हि कीर्तिं परां प्राप्य पुनः सूर्यपुरं व्रजेत् ॥ 1.174.40 ॥
सूर्याग्निकर्मवर्णनम्
1.174.m:
I bow down to Vibhāvasu, the lord of the gods, who delights in the gods.
Whoever should constantly hear this supreme praise spoken by Brahmā,
having attained supreme renown, would indeed go again to the realm of the Sun.
Description of the Rite of Fire for the Sun

1.175.s:
.. garuḍa uvāca.. ..
sarvarogahatā ye tu ādhivyādhisamanvitāḥ ..
grahopaghātairvividhairarditā ye ca mānavāḥ .. 1 ..
1.175.d:
॥ गरुड उवाच॥ ॥
सर्वरोगहता ये तु आधिव्याधिसमन्विताः ॥
ग्रहोपघातैर्विविधैरर्दिता ये च मानवाः ॥ 1 ॥

1.175.s:
aribhiḥ pīḍitā ye ca vināyakahatāśca ye ..
kartavyaṃ kiṃ bhavetteṣāmātmanaḥ śreyase'nagha .. 2 ..
1.175.d:
अरिभिः पीडिता ये च विनायकहताश्च ये ॥
कर्तव्यं किं भवेत्तेषामात्मनः श्रेयसेऽनघ ॥ 2 ॥
1.175.m:
and those who are oppressed by enemies, and who are stricken by vināyakas—
what should be done by them, O sinless one, for their own welfare?

1.175.s:
.. aruṇa uvāca .. ..
nānārogahatānāṃ tu arditānāṃ tathāribhiḥ ..
ādityārādhanaṃ muktvā nānyacchreyaskaraṃ param .. 3 ..
1.175.d:
॥ अरुण उवाच ॥ ॥
नानारोगहतानां तु अर्दितानां तथारिभिः ॥
आदित्याराधनं मुक्त्वा नान्यच्छ्रेयस्करं परम् ॥ 3 ॥
1.175.m:
Aruṇa said:
For those stricken by various diseases, and likewise tormented by enemies,
except for the worship of Āditya, there is no other superior source of welfare.

1.175.s:
tasmādārādhayennityaṃ sarvarogavināśanam ..
grahopaghātahaṃtāraṃ rājopadravanāśanam .. 4 ..
1.175.d:
तस्मादाराधयेन्नित्यं सर्वरोगविनाशनम् ॥
ग्रहोपघातहंतारं राजोपद्रवनाशनम् ॥ 4 ॥
1.175.m:
Therefore, one should constantly worship [him] who destroys all diseases,
who slays planetary afflictions, and who removes distress caused by kings.

1.175.s:
.. garuḍa uvāca .. ..
sarvapatravihīnaṃ me sarvarogavivarjitam ..
śāpena brahmavādinyāḥ paśyāṃgaṃ dvijasattama .. 5 ..
1.175.d:
॥ गरुड उवाच ॥ ॥
सर्वपत्रविहीनं मे सर्वरोगविवर्जितम् ॥
शापेन ब्रह्मवादिन्याः पश्यांगं द्विजसत्तम ॥ 5 ॥
1.175.m:
Garuḍa said:
Look at my body, O best of the twice-born, bereft of all feathers,
[though] free from all diseases, by the curse of a woman who expounded the Veda.

1.175.s:
evaṃ mattasya me tāta kiṃ kāryamavaśiṣyate ..
yenāhaṃ karmaṇā kalpo bhaveyaṃ patravānpunaḥ .. 6 ..
1.175.d:
एवं मत्तस्य मे तात किं कार्यमवशिष्यते ॥
येनाहं कर्मणा कल्पो भवेयं पत्रवान्पुनः ॥ 6 ॥
1.175.m:
For me, having thus become arrogant, O father, what duty remains
by which action I might become capable and possessed of feathers again?

1.175.s:
tanme brūhi khagaśreṣṭha prapannasya khagādhipa ..
yatkṛtvā kalpatāṃ prāpya pūjayāmi divākaram ..7..
1.175.d:
तन्मे ब्रूहि खगश्रेष्ठ प्रपन्नस्य खगाधिप ॥
यत्कृत्वा कल्पतां प्राप्य पूजयामि दिवाकरम् ॥7॥
1.175.m:
Tell that to me, O best of birds, O lord of birds, as I have taken refuge [in you],
by performing which, having attained capability, I may worship Divākara.

1.175.s:
.. aruṇa uvāca .. ..
pūjayasva jagannāthaṃ bhāskaraṃ timirāpaham ..
sūryāgnikāryaṃ satataṃ śuddhacittaḥ samācara .. 8 ..
1.175.d:
॥ अरुण उवाच ॥ ॥
पूजयस्व जगन्नाथं भास्करं तिमिरापहम् ॥
सूर्याग्निकार्यं सततं शुद्धचित्तः समाचर ॥ 8 ॥

1.175.s:
mahāśāṃtikaraṃ khyātaṃ sarvopadravanāśanam ..
grahopaghātahaṃtāraṃ śubhakāryaṃkaraṃ param .. 9 ..
1.175.d:
महाशांतिकरं ख्यातं सर्वोपद्रवनाशनम् ॥
ग्रहोपघातहंतारं शुभकार्यंकरं परम् ॥ 9 ॥
1.175.m:
It is renowned as causing great appeasement, destroying all calamities,
slaying planetary afflictions, and effecting supreme auspiciousness.

1.175.s:
.. garuḍa uvāca .. ..
nāhaṃ śaktosmi vai kartuṃ pūjāṃ dinakarasya ca ..
na cāgnikāryaṃ śaknomi kartuṃ vikalatāṃ gataḥ ..1.175.1 0..
1.175.d:
॥ गरुड उवाच ॥ ॥
नाहं शक्तोस्मि वै कर्तुं पूजां दिनकरस्य च ॥
न चाग्निकार्यं शक्नोमि कर्तुं विकलतां गतः ॥1.175.1 0॥
1.175.m:
Garuḍa said:
I am indeed not able to perform the worship of the Maker of Day,
nor am I able to perform the fire rite, having fallen into infirmity.

1.175.s:
tasmānme kuru śāṃtyarthamagnikāryaṃ khagādhipa ..
mahāśāṃtiriti khyātaṃ śāṃtaye mama suvrata .. 11 ..
1.175.d:
तस्मान्मे कुरु शांत्यर्थमग्निकार्यं खगाधिप ॥
महाशांतिरिति ख्यातं शांतये मम सुव्रत ॥ 11 ॥
1.175.m:
Therefore, perform the fire rite for my peace, O lord of birds,
which is celebrated as the Great Appeasement, for my peace, O you of noble vows.

1.175.s:
.. aruṇa uvāca ... ..
evameva yadāttha tvaṃ vainateya khagādhipa ..
akalpastvaṃ na śaknoṣi mahāvyādhiprapīḍitaḥ .. 12 ..
1.175.d:
॥ अरुण उवाच ॥॥।
एवमेव यदात्थ त्वं वैनतेय खगाधिप ॥
अकल्पस्त्वं न शक्नोषि महाव्याधिप्रपीडितः ॥ 12 ॥

1.175.s:
ahaṃ karomi te putra śāṃtaye pāvakārcanam ..
yatkṛtaṃ mama cārkeṇa purā śāṃtidamādarāt ..13..
1.175.d:
अहं करोमि ते पुत्र शांतये पावकार्चनम् ॥
यत्कृतं मम चार्केण पुरा शांतिदमादरात् ॥13॥
1.175.m:
I shall perform for you, my son, the worship of the fire for [your] peace,
which was of old performed for me with reverence by Arka, granting peace.

1.175.s:
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ mahāvipravināśanam ..
mahodayaṃ śātikaraṃ lakṣahomavidhi smṛtam .. 14 ..
1.175.d:
सर्वपापहरं पुण्यं महाविप्रविनाशनम् ॥
महोदयं शातिकरं लक्षहोमविधि स्मृतम् ॥ 14 ॥
1.175.m:
It destroys all sins, is meritorious, destroys great adversities,
brings great prosperity, causes peace, and is taught as the rule of the hundred-thousand oblation.

1.175.s:
apamṛtyuharaṃ vīra sarvavyādhiharaṃ param ..
paracakrapramathanaṃ sadāvijayavardhanam .. 15 ..
1.175.d:
अपमृत्युहरं वीर सर्वव्याधिहरं परम् ॥
परचक्रप्रमथनं सदाविजयवर्धनम् ॥ 15 ॥
1.175.m:
It removes untimely death, O hero, removes all diseases, is supreme,
crushes hostile armies, and always increases victory.

1.175.s:
tṛptidaṃ sarvadevānāṃ bhāskarapriyamuttam..
āgneyyāṃ diśi lipyātha sthaḍilaṃ gomayena tu ..16..
1.175.d:
तृप्तिदं सर्वदेवानां भास्करप्रियमुत्तम्॥
आग्नेय्यां दिशि लिप्याथ स्थडिलं गोमयेन तु ॥16॥
1.175.m:
It gives satisfaction to all the gods, and is most dear to Bhāskara.
Having smeared a raised ground with cow dung in the south-eastern direction,

1.175.s:
devālayasya vidhivatkuryādagniprabodhanam ..
mahāvyāhṛtibhirvīra lakṣahomaṃ samācaret ..17..
1.175.d:
देवालयस्य विधिवत्कुर्यादग्निप्रबोधनम् ॥
महाव्याहृतिभिर्वीर लक्षहोमं समाचरेत् ॥17॥
1.175.m:
one should properly kindle the fire in the temple of the deity.
With the great sacred utterances, O hero, one should perform the hundred-thousand oblation:

1.175.s:
bhūrbhuvaḥsvariti svāhā praṇavena samanvitam..
āraktadeharūpāya raktākṣāya mahātmane..18..
1.175.d:
भूर्भुवःस्वरिति स्वाहा प्रणवेन समन्वितम्॥
आरक्तदेहरूपाय रक्ताक्षाय महात्मने॥18॥
1.175.m:
'Bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ svāhā', accompanied by the Praṇava.
'To the great-souled one whose form has a reddish body, with red eyes,

1.175.s: dharādharāya śāntāya sahasrākṣiśirāya ca..19..
1.175.d: धराधराय शान्ताय सहस्राक्षिशिराय च॥19॥
1.175.m: who supports the earth, who is tranquil, and who has a thousand eyes and heads,

1.175.s:
adhomukhāya śvetāya svāhā pūrvāhutiṃ sṛjet ...
caturmukhāya śāṃtāya padmāsanagatāya ca ..1.175.20..
1.175.d:
अधोमुखाय श्वेताय स्वाहा पूर्वाहुतिं सृजेत् ॥।
चतुर्मुखाय शांताय पद्मासनगताय च ॥1.175.20॥
1.175.m:
who faces downward, and is white, svāhā'—one should offer the first oblation.
'To the four-faced, tranquil one, seated on a lotus,

1.175.s:
padmavarṇāya vedhāya kamaṇḍaludharāya ca ..
dvitīyordhvamukhāyeha svāhākārāhutiṃ sṛjet..21..
1.175.d:
पद्मवर्णाय वेधाय कमण्डलुधराय च ॥
द्वितीयोर्ध्वमुखायेह स्वाहाकाराहुतिं सृजेत्॥21॥
1.175.m:
lotus-coloured, the creator, who holds a water pot,
to the second one facing upward here, svāhā'—one should offer the oblation.

1.175.s:
hemavarṇāya dehāya airāvatagatāya ca ..
sahasrākṣaśarīrāya pūrvadiśyunmukhāya ca .. 22 ..
1.175.d:
हेमवर्णाय देहाय ऐरावतगताय च ॥
सहस्राक्षशरीराय पूर्वदिश्युन्मुखाय च ॥ 22 ॥
1.175.m:
'To him whose body is gold-coloured, who is mounted on Airāvata,
whose body has a thousand eyes, and who faces toward the eastern direction,

1.175.s:
devādhipāya cendrāya vihastāya śubhāya ca ..
svāhākāraṃ cotsṛjedeva tṛtīyavadanāya ca .. 23 ..
1.175.d:
देवाधिपाय चेन्द्राय विहस्ताय शुभाय च ॥
स्वाहाकारं चोत्सृजेदेव तृतीयवदनाय च ॥ 23 ॥
1.175.m:
to Indra, the lord of the gods, who has outstretched hands, and is auspicious,
and to the third face, svāhā'—thus one should offer.

1.175.s:
dīptāya vyaktadehāya jvālāmālākulāya ca ..
indranīlābhadehāya sarvārogyakarāya ca.. 24 ..
1.175.d:
दीप्ताय व्यक्तदेहाय ज्वालामालाकुलाय च ॥
इन्द्रनीलाभदेहाय सर्वारोग्यकराय च॥ 24 ॥
1.175.m:
'To the radiant one, whose body is manifest, covered with garlands of flames,
whose body has the splendour of sapphire, and who causes all health,

1.175.s:
yamāya dharmarājāya dakṣiṇāśāmukhāya ca ..
kṛṣṇāṃbaradharāyeha svāhāhutimanutsṛjet ..25..
1.175.d:
यमाय धर्मराजाय दक्षिणाशामुखाय च ॥
कृष्णांबरधरायेह स्वाहाहुतिमनुत्सृजेत् ॥25॥
1.175.m:
to Yama, the king of dharma, who faces toward the southern direction,
and wears black garments here, svāhā'—one should offer the oblation.

1.175.s:
nīlajīmūtavarṇāya raktāṃbaradharāya ca ..
muktāphalaśarīrāya piṃgākṣāya mahātmane .. 26..
1.175.d:
नीलजीमूतवर्णाय रक्तांबरधराय च ॥
मुक्ताफलशरीराय पिंगाक्षाय महात्मने ॥ 26॥
1.175.m:
'To him who has the colour of a blue cloud, wears red garments,
whose body is [white as] a pearl, who has tawny eyes, the great-souled one,

1.175.s:
śuklavastrāya pītāya divyapāśadharāya ca ..
svāhākārāya ca tathā paścimābhimukhāya ca .. 27 ..
1.175.d:
शुक्लवस्त्राय पीताय दिव्यपाशधराय च ॥
स्वाहाकाराय च तथा पश्चिमाभिमुखाय च ॥ 27 ॥
1.175.m:
who has white clothes, is yellow, holds a divine noose,
and who faces the west, svāhā'—and likewise

1.175.s:
kṛṣṇapiṃgalanetrāya vāyavyābhimukhāya ca..
nīladhvajāya vīrāya tathā cendrāya vedhase ..28..
1.175.d:
कृष्णपिंगलनेत्राय वायव्याभिमुखाय च॥
नीलध्वजाय वीराय तथा चेन्द्राय वेधसे ॥28॥
1.175.m:
'to him who has dark-tawny eyes and faces the north-west,
who has a blue banner, the heroic one, and likewise to Indra, the creator,

1.175.s:
svāheti pavanāyeha āhutiṃ cotsṛjedbudhaḥ..
gadāhastāya sūryāya citrasragbhūṣaṇāya ca..29..
1.175.d:
स्वाहेति पवनायेह आहुतिं चोत्सृजेद्बुधः॥
गदाहस्ताय सूर्याय चित्रस्रग्भूषणाय च॥29॥
1.175.m:
to Pavana here, svāhā'—the wise one should offer the oblation.
'To the Sun who has a mace in his hand, adorned with variegated garlands,

1.175.s:
mahodarāya śāṃtāya svāhādhipataye tathā ..
uttarābhimukhāyeha mahādevapriyāya ca .. 1.175.30 ..
1.175.d:
महोदराय शांताय स्वाहाधिपतये तथा ॥
उत्तराभिमुखायेह महादेवप्रियाय च ॥ 1.175.30 ॥
1.175.m:
who has a large belly, is tranquil, likewise the lord of Svāhā,
facing north here, and dear to Mahādeva,

1.175.s:
śvetāya śvetavarṇāya citrākṣāya mahātmane ..
śāṃtāya śāṃtarūpāya pinākavaradhāriṇe .. 31 ..
1.175.d:
श्वेताय श्वेतवर्णाय चित्राक्षाय महात्मने ॥
शांताय शांतरूपाय पिनाकवरधारिणे ॥ 31 ॥
1.175.m:
to the white one, white-coloured, with variegated eyes, the great-souled one,
who is tranquil, of tranquil form, and holds the excellent Pināka bow,

1.175.s:
īśānābhimukhāyeha dadyādīśāya cāhutim ..
visṛjetkhagaśārdūla vidhivacchreyasenagha .. 32 ..
1.175.d:
ईशानाभिमुखायेह दद्यादीशाय चाहुतिम् ॥
विसृजेत्खगशार्दूल विधिवच्छ्रेयसेनघ ॥ 32 ॥
1.175.m:
facing north-east here, to Īśa'—one should give the oblation.
One should offer [it] according to rule, O tiger among birds, for [your] welfare, O sinless one.

1.175.s:
evaṃ devaṃ mahātmānaṃ pāvakaṃ vidhivatkhaga ..
arhediti tu yatkāryaṃ tatsauraṃ khagasattama .. 33 ..
1.175.d:
एवं देवं महात्मानं पावकं विधिवत्खग ॥
अर्हेदिति तु यत्कार्यं तत्सौरं खगसत्तम ॥ 33 ॥
1.175.m:
Thus to the great-souled god, the fire, according to rule, O bird,
one should pay worship; this duty is indeed Saura, O best of birds.

1.175.s:
lakṣahomaṃ ca vidhivatkṛtvā śāṃtikamācaret ..
bhūrbhuvaḥsvariti svā hā lakṣahomavidhiḥ smṛtaḥ .. 34 ..
1.175.d:
लक्षहोमं च विधिवत्कृत्वा शांतिकमाचरेत् ॥
भूर्भुवःस्वरिति स्वा हा लक्षहोमविधिः स्मृतः ॥ 34 ॥
1.175.m:
And having performed the hundred-thousand oblation according to rule, one should perform the rite of appeasement.
'Bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ svāhā'—this is recorded as the rule of the hundred-thousand oblation.

1.175.s:
mahāhome ca vai saura eṣa eva vidhiḥ paraḥ ..
kṛtvaivamagnikāryaṃ tu bhojako bhāskarāya vai .. 35 ..
1.175.d:
महाहोमे च वै सौर एष एव विधिः परः ॥
कृत्वैवमग्निकार्यं तु भोजको भास्कराय वै ॥ 35 ॥
1.175.m:
And in the great Saura fire sacrifice, this very rule is supreme.
Having thus performed the fire rite for Bhāskara, the Bhojaka,

1.175.s:
śāṃtyarthaṃ sarvalokānāṃ tataḥ śāṃtikamācaret ..
sindūrāsanaraktābhaḥ raktapadmābhalocanaḥ .. 36 ..
1.175.d:
शांत्यर्थं सर्वलोकानां ततः शांतिकमाचरेत् ॥
सिन्दूरासनरक्ताभः रक्तपद्माभलोचनः ॥ 36 ॥
1.175.m:
for the sake of the peace of all the worlds, should then perform the rite of appeasement.
Having the red glow of a vermilion seat, with eyes like red lotuses,

1.175.s:
sahasrakiraṇo devaḥ saptāśvarathavāhanaḥ ..
gabhastimālī bhagavānsarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ .. 37 ..
1.175.d:
सहस्रकिरणो देवः सप्ताश्वरथवाहनः ॥
गभस्तिमाली भगवान्सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः ॥ 37 ॥
1.175.m:
the thousand-rayed god, borne upon a chariot of seven horses,
garlanded with rays, the blessed one, bowed to by all the gods—

1.175.s:
karotu te mahāśāṃtiṃ grahapīḍānivāriṇīm ..
tricakrarathamārūḍha apāṃ sāramayaṃ tu yaḥ ..38..
1.175.d:
करोतु ते महाशांतिं ग्रहपीडानिवारिणीम् ॥
त्रिचक्ररथमारूढ अपां सारमयं तु यः ॥38॥
1.175.m:
may he effect your great appeasement, removing the affliction of the planets!
He who is mounted on a three-wheeled chariot, and consists of the essence of water,

1.175.s:
daśāśvavāhano deva ātreya ścāmṛtasravaḥ ..
śītāṃśuramṛtātmā ca kṣayavṛddhisamanvitaḥ ..
somaḥ saumyena bhāvena grahapīḍāṃ vyapohatu .. 39 ..
1.175.d:
दशाश्ववाहनो देव आत्रेय श्चामृतस्रवः ॥
शीतांशुरमृतात्मा च क्षयवृद्धिसमन्वितः ॥
सोमः सौम्येन भावेन ग्रहपीडां व्यपोहतु ॥ 39 ॥
1.175.m:
the god borne by ten horses, the son of Atri, flowing with nectar,
having cool rays, consisting of nectar, endowed with waning and waxing—
may Soma dispel the affliction of the planets with a benevolent disposition!

1.175.s:
padmarāganibho bhaumo madhupiṃgala locanaḥ ..
aṃgārako'gnisadṛśo grahapīḍāṃ vyapohatu .. 1.175.40 ..
1.175.d:
पद्मरागनिभो भौमो मधुपिंगल लोचनः ॥
अंगारकोऽग्निसदृशो ग्रहपीडां व्यपोहतु ॥ 1.175.40 ॥
1.175.m:
Resembling a ruby, Bhauma, with eyes honey-tawny,
Aṅgāraka, resembling fire—may he dispel the affliction of the planets!

1.175.s:
puṣparāganibheneha dehena paripiṃgalaḥ ..
pītamālyāṃbaradharo budhaḥ pīḍāṃ vyapohatu .. .. 41 ..
1.175.d:
पुष्परागनिभेनेह देहेन परिपिंगलः ॥
पीतमाल्यांबरधरो बुधः पीडां व्यपोहतु ॥ ॥ 41 ॥
1.175.m:
All-tawny here with a body resembling a topaz,
wearing yellow garlands and garments—may Budha dispel the affliction!

1.175.s:
taptagairikasaṃkāśaḥ sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ ..
sarvadevagururvipro hyatharvaṇavaro muniḥ .. 42 ..
1.175.d:
तप्तगैरिकसंकाशः सर्वशास्त्रविशारदः ॥
सर्वदेवगुरुर्विप्रो ह्यथर्वणवरो मुनिः ॥ 42 ॥
1.175.m:
Resembling heated red chalk, skilled in all scriptures,
the guru of all the gods, a learned brāhmaṇa, and an excellent Atharvan sage—

1.175.s:
bṛhaspatiriti khyāta arthaśāstraparaśca yaḥ ..
śāṃtena cetasā sopi pareṇa susamāhitaḥ .. 43 ..
1.175.d:
बृहस्पतिरिति ख्यात अर्थशास्त्रपरश्च यः ॥
शांतेन चेतसा सोपि परेण सुसमाहितः ॥ 43 ॥
1.175.m: he who is renowned as Bṛhaspati, devoted to the science of polity, / he too, with a tranquil mind, deeply concentrated with supreme [focus],

1.175.s:
grahapīḍāṃ vinirjitya karotu tava śāṃtikam ..
sūryārcanaparo nityaṃ prasādādbhāskarasya tu .. 44 ..
1.175.d:
ग्रहपीडां विनिर्जित्य करोतु तव शांतिकम् ॥
सूर्यार्चनपरो नित्यं प्रसादाद्भास्करस्य तु ॥ 44 ॥
1.175.m: having overcome the affliction of the planets, may he bring about peace for you, / ever devoted to the worship of Sūrya through the grace of Bhāskara.

1.175.s:
himakuṃdeṃduvarṇābho daityadānavapūjitaḥ ..
maheśvarastato dhīmānmahāsauro mahāmatiḥ .. 45 ..
1.175.d:
हिमकुंदेंदुवर्णाभो दैत्यदानवपूजितः ॥
महेश्वरस्ततो धीमान्महासौरो महामतिः ॥ 45 ॥
1.175.m: He who possesses a lustre like the colour of snow, jasmine, and the moon, worshipped by Daityas and Dānavas, / a great lord, wise, a great worshipper of the Sun, possessed of vast intellect,

1.175.s:
sūryārcanaparo nityaṃ śukraḥ śuklanibhastadā ..
nītiśāstraparo nityaṃ grahapīḍāṃ vyapohatu .. 46 ..
1.175.d:
सूर्यार्चनपरो नित्यं शुक्रः शुक्लनिभस्तदा ॥
नीतिशास्त्रपरो नित्यं ग्रहपीडां व्यपोहतु ॥ 46 ॥
1.175.m: ever devoted to the worship of Sūrya, Śukra resembling the white [planet], / ever intent on the science of conduct, may he remove the affliction of the planets.

1.175.s:
nānārūpadharovyakta avijñātagatiśca yaḥ ..
