notpattirjāyate yasya nodayapīḍitairapi .. 47 ..
1.175.d:
नानारूपधरोव्यक्त अविज्ञातगतिश्च यः ॥
नोत्पत्तिर्जायते यस्य नोदयपीडितैरपि ॥ 47 ॥
1.175.m: He who assumes various forms, unmanifest, whose course is unknown, / whose birth does not occur even through those afflicted by his rising,

1.175.s:
ekacūlo dvicūlaśca triśikhaḥ paṃcacūlakaḥ ..
sahasraśirarūpastu candraketuriva sthitaḥ ..48..
1.175.d:
एकचूलो द्विचूलश्च त्रिशिखः पंचचूलकः ॥
सहस्रशिररूपस्तु चन्द्रकेतुरिव स्थितः ॥48॥
1.175.m: single-crested, double-crested, three-crested, and five-crested, / of thousand-headed form, abiding like Candraketu,

1.175.s:
sūryaputrogniputrastu brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakaḥ ..
anekaśikharaḥ ketuḥ sa te pīḍāṃ vyapohatu .. 49 .
1.175.d:
सूर्यपुत्रोग्निपुत्रस्तु ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवात्मकः ॥
अनेकशिखरः केतुः स ते पीडां व्यपोहतु ॥ 49 ।
1.175.m: son of Sūrya and son of Agni, having the nature of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva, / possessing many peaks, may that Ketu remove your affliction.

1.175.s:
ete grahā mahātmānaḥ sūryārcanaparāḥ sadā ..
śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te hṛṣṭāḥ sadā kālaṃ hitekṣaṇāḥ .. 1.175.50 ..
sauradharmavarṇanam
1.175.d:
एते ग्रहा महात्मानः सूर्यार्चनपराः सदा ॥
शांतिं कुर्वंतु ते हृष्टाः सदा कालं हितेक्षणाः ॥ 1.175.50 ॥
सौरधर्मवर्णनम्
1.175.m:
May these great-souled planets, ever devoted to the worship of Sūrya, / gladdened and always casting auspicious glances, bring about your peace at all times.
Description of the duties pertaining to the Sun

1.176.s:
.. sumaṃturuvāca .. ..
padmāsanaḥ padmavarṇaḥ padmapatranibhekṣaṇaḥ ..
kamaṇḍaludharaḥ śrīmāndevagaṃdharvapūjitaḥ .. 1 ..
1.176.d:
॥ सुमंतुरुवाच ॥ ॥
पद्मासनः पद्मवर्णः पद्मपत्रनिभेक्षणः ॥
कमण्डलुधरः श्रीमान्देवगंधर्वपूजितः ॥ 1 ॥
1.176.m: Sumantu said: / Seated on a lotus, lotus-coloured, with eyes resembling lotus petals, / holding a water pot, glorious, worshipped by gods and gandharvas,

1.176.s:
caturmukho devapatiḥ sūryārcanaparaḥ sadā ..
surajyeṣṭho mahātejāḥ sarva lokaprajāpatiḥ ..
brahmaśabdena divyena brahmā śāṃtiṃ karotu te .. 2 ..
1.176.d:
चतुर्मुखो देवपतिः सूर्यार्चनपरः सदा ॥
सुरज्येष्ठो महातेजाः सर्व लोकप्रजापतिः ॥
ब्रह्मशब्देन दिव्येन ब्रह्मा शांतिं करोतु ते ॥ 2 ॥
1.176.m: four-faced, lord of the gods, ever devoted to the worship of Sūrya, / eldest among the gods, of great splendour, the Prajāpati of all worlds, / through the divine word ‘Brahman’, may Brahmā bring about peace for you.

1.176.s:
pītāṃbaradharo deva ātreyīdayitaḥ sadā ..
śaṃkhacakragadāpāṇiḥ śyāmavarṇaścaturbhujaḥ .. 3 ..
1.176.d:
पीतांबरधरो देव आत्रेयीदयितः सदा ॥
शंखचक्रगदापाणिः श्यामवर्णश्चतुर्भुजः ॥ 3 ॥
1.176.m: The god clad in yellow garments, ever dear to Ātreyī, / bearing conch, discus, and mace in hand, dark-hued and four-armed,

1.176.s:
yajñadehaḥ kramo deva ātreyīdayitaḥ sadā ..
śaṃkhacakragadāpāṇirmādhavo madhusūdanaḥ .. 4 ..
1.176.d:
यज्ञदेहः क्रमो देव आत्रेयीदयितः सदा ॥
शंखचक्रगदापाणिर्माधवो मधुसूदनः ॥ 4 ॥
1.176.m: having sacrificial performance as his body, step-taking, the god ever dear to Ātreyī, / bearing conch, discus, and mace in hand, Mādhava, the slayer of Madhu,

1.176.s:
sūryabhaktānvito nityaṃ vigatirvigatatrayaḥ ..
sūryadhyānaparo nityaṃ viṣṇuḥ śāṃtiṃ karotu te .. 5 ..
1.176.d:
सूर्यभक्तान्वितो नित्यं विगतिर्विगतत्रयः ॥
सूर्यध्यानपरो नित्यं विष्णुः शांतिं करोतु ते ॥ 5 ॥
1.176.m: ever accompanied by Sūrya's devotees, unmoving, free of the threefold [suffering], / ever devoted to meditating on Sūrya, may Viṣṇu bring about peace for you.
Resembling the hare-marked moon and jasmine, with celebrated ornaments here, / four-armed, of great splendour, crested with a crescent moon,

1.176.s:
caturmukho bhasmadharaḥ smaśānanilayaḥ sadā ..
gotrārirviśvanilayastathā ca kratudūṣaṇaḥ .. 7 ..
1.176.d:
चतुर्मुखो भस्मधरः स्मशाननिलयः सदा ॥
गोत्रारिर्विश्वनिलयस्तथा च क्रतुदूषणः ॥ 7 ॥
1.176.m: four-faced, smeared with ashes, ever abiding in the cremation ground, / enemy of Gotra, abode of the universe, and destroyer of the sacrifice,

1.176.s:
varo vareṇyo varado devadevo maheśvaraḥ ..
ādityadehasaṃbhūtaḥ sa te śāṃtiṃ karotu vai .. 8 ..
agnikāryavidhivarṇanam
1.176.d:
वरो वरेण्यो वरदो देवदेवो महेश्वरः ॥
आदित्यदेहसंभूतः स ते शांतिं करोतु वै ॥ 8 ॥
अग्निकार्यविधिवर्णनम्
1.176.m:
excellent, choice, boon-bestowing, god of gods, Maheśvara, / sprung from the body of Āditya, may he indeed bring about peace for you.
Description of the ritual procedure of the fire sacrifice

1.177.s:
.. aruṇa uvāca .. ..
padmarāgaprabhā devī caturvadanapaṃkajā ..
akṣamālārpitakarā kamaṃḍaludharā śubhā .. 1 ..
1.177.d:
॥ अरुण उवाच ॥ ॥
पद्मरागप्रभा देवी चतुर्वदनपंकजा ॥
अक्षमालार्पितकरा कमंडलुधरा शुभा ॥ 1 ॥
1.177.m: Aruṇa said: / The goddess with the radiance of a ruby, having four lotus-faces, / with a rosary in her hand, holding a water pot, auspicious,

1.177.s:
brahmāṇī saumyavadanā ādityārādhane ratā ..
śāṃtiṃ karotu suprītā āśīrvādaparā khaga .. 2 ..
1.177.d:
ब्रह्माणी सौम्यवदना आदित्याराधने रता ॥
शांतिं करोतु सुप्रीता आशीर्वादपरा खग ॥ 2 ॥
1.177.m: Brahmāṇī of gentle countenance, engaged in the adoration of Āditya, / may she, exceedingly pleased and intent on blessings, bring about peace, O bird.

1.177.s:
mahāśveteti vikhyātā ādi tyadayitā sadā ..
himakuṃdeṃdusadṛśā mahāvṛṣabhavāhinī .. 3 ..
1.177.d:
महाश्वेतेति विख्याता आदि त्यदयिता सदा ॥
हिमकुंदेंदुसदृशा महावृषभवाहिनी ॥ 3 ॥
1.177.m: Renowned as Mahāśvetā, ever beloved of Āditya, / resembling snow, jasmine, and the moon, riding a great bull,

1.177.s:
triśūlahastāvaraṇā viśrutābharaṇā satī ..
caturbhujā caturvaktrā trinetrā pāpanāśinī..
vṛṣadhvajārcanaratā rudrāṇī śāṃtidā bhavet .. 4 ..
1.177.d:
त्रिशूलहस्तावरणा विश्रुताभरणा सती ॥
चतुर्भुजा चतुर्वक्त्रा त्रिनेत्रा पापनाशिनी॥
वृषध्वजार्चनरता रुद्राणी शांतिदा भवेत् ॥ 4 ॥
1.177.m: holding a trident in hand as her weapon, having celebrated ornaments, faithful, / four-armed, four-faced, three-eyed, destroyer of sins, / devoted to worshipping the bull-bannered god, may Rudrāṇī be the bestower of peace.

1.177.s:
mayūravāhanā devī siṃdūrāruṇavigrahā ..
śaktihastā mahākāyā sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitā ..5..
1.177.d:
मयूरवाहना देवी सिंदूरारुणविग्रहा ॥
शक्तिहस्ता महाकाया सर्वालंकारभूषिता ॥5॥
1.177.m: The goddess whose mount is a peacock, whose form is reddish like vermilion, / holding a spear in hand, of large frame, adorned with all ornaments,

1.177.s:
sūryabhaktā mahāvīryā sūryārcanaratā sadā ..
kaumārī varadā devī śāṃtimāśu karotu te .. 6 ..
1.177.d:
सूर्यभक्ता महावीर्या सूर्यार्चनरता सदा ॥
कौमारी वरदा देवी शांतिमाशु करोतु ते ॥ 6 ॥
1.177.m: devoted to Sūrya, of great valour, ever engaged in worshipping Sūrya, / the goddess Kaumārī, giver of boons, may she quickly bring about peace for you.

1.177.s:
gadācakradharā śyāmā pītāṃbaradharā khaga ..
caturbhujā hi sā devī vaiṣṇavī surapūjitā ..7..
1.177.d:
गदाचक्रधरा श्यामा पीतांबरधरा खग ॥
चतुर्भुजा हि सा देवी वैष्णवी सुरपूजिता ॥7॥
1.177.m: Bearing a mace and a discus, dark-hued, clad in yellow garments, O bird, / four-armed indeed is that goddess Vaiṣṇavī, worshipped by the gods;

1.177.s:
sūryārcanaparā nityaṃ sūryaikagatamānasā ..
śāṃtiṃ karotu te nityaṃ sarvāsuravimardinī ..8..
1.177.d:
सूर्यार्चनपरा नित्यं सूर्यैकगतमानसा ॥
शांतिं करोतु ते नित्यं सर्वासुरविमर्दिनी ॥8॥
1.177.m: ever devoted to worshipping Sūrya, her mind focused solely on Sūrya, / may she who crushes all asuras ever bring about peace for you.

1.177.s:
airāvatagajārūḍhā vajrahastā mahā balā ..
sarvatralocanā devī varṇataḥ karburāruṇā .. 9 ..
1.177.d:
ऐरावतगजारूढा वज्रहस्ता महा बला ॥
सर्वत्रलोचना देवी वर्णतः कर्बुरारुणा ॥ 9 ॥
1.177.m: Mounted upon the elephant Airāvata, thunderbolt in hand, of great strength, / the goddess with eyes everywhere, variegated and red in colour,

1.177.s:
siddhagaṃdharvanamitā sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitā ..
iṃdrāṇī te sadā devī śāṃtimāśu karotu vai .. 1.177.10 ..
1.177.d:
सिद्धगंधर्वनमिता सर्वालंकारभूषिता ॥
इंद्राणी ते सदा देवी शांतिमाशु करोतु वै ॥ 1.177.10 ॥
1.177.m: bowed to by siddhas and gandharvas, adorned with all ornaments, / may the goddess Indrāṇī ever quickly bring about peace for you.

1.177.s:
varāhaghoṇā vikaṭā varāhavaravāhinī ..
śyāmāvadātā yā devī śaṃkhacakragadādharā .. 11 ..
1.177.d:
वराहघोणा विकटा वराहवरवाहिनी ॥
श्यामावदाता या देवी शंखचक्रगदाधरा ॥ 11 ॥
1.177.m: Having the snout of a boar, formidable, riding upon an excellent boar, / the goddess dark and fair, bearing conch, discus, and mace,

1.177.s:
tejayaṃtīti nimiṣānpūjayaṃtī sadā ravim ..
vārāhī varadā devī tava śāṃtiṃ karotu vai .. 12 ..
1.177.d:
तेजयंतीति निमिषान्पूजयंती सदा रविम् ॥
वाराही वरदा देवी तव शांतिं करोतु वै ॥ 12 ॥
1.177.m: illuminating the twilights, ever worshipping the sun, / may the goddess Vārāhī, bestower of boons, indeed bring about peace for you.

1.177.s:
ardhakośā kaṭīkṣāmā nirmāṃsā snāyubaṃdhanāt ..
karālavanā ghorā khaḍgaghaṃṭodgatā satī .. 13 ..
1.177.d:
अर्धकोशा कटीक्षामा निर्मांसा स्नायुबंधनात् ॥
करालवना घोरा खड्गघंटोद्गता सती ॥ 13 ॥
1.177.m: Half-sheathed, emaciated at the waist, fleshless through the binding of tendons, / of dreadful mouth, terrifying, brandishing sword and bell, virtuous,

1.177.s:
kapālamālinī krūrā khaṭvāṃgavaradhāriṇī ..
āraktā piṃganayanā gajacarmāvaguṃṭhitā .. 14 ..
1.177.d:
कपालमालिनी क्रूरा खट्वांगवरधारिणी ॥
आरक्ता पिंगनयना गजचर्मावगुंठिता ॥ 14 ॥
1.177.m: wearing a garland of skulls, cruel, bearing an excellent skull-staff, / reddish, with tawny eyes, wrapped in an elephant-hide,

1.177.s:
gośrutābharaṇā devī pretasthānanivāsinī ..
śivārūpeṇa ghoreṇa śivarūpabhayaṃkarī ..
cāmuṃḍā caṃḍarūpeṇa sadā śāṃtiṃ karotu te .. 15 ..
1.177.d:
गोश्रुताभरणा देवी प्रेतस्थाननिवासिनी ॥
शिवारूपेण घोरेण शिवरूपभयंकरी ॥
चामुंडा चंडरूपेण सदा शांतिं करोतु ते ॥ 15 ॥
1.177.m: the goddess with renowned ornaments, dwelling in the abode of pretas, / having a terrible form with jackals, frightening in the form of Śiva, / in her fierce form, may Cāmuṇḍā ever bring about peace for you.

1.177.s:
caṃḍamuṃḍakarā devī muṃḍadehagatā satī ..
kapālamālinī krūrā khaṭvāṃgavaradhāriṇī .. 16 ..
1.177.d:
चंडमुंडकरा देवी मुंडदेहगता सती ॥
कपालमालिनी क्रूरा खट्वांगवरधारिणी ॥ 16 ॥
1.177.m: The goddess holding the heads of Caṇḍa and Muṇḍa, standing on headless bodies, virtuous, / wearing a garland of skulls, cruel, bearing an excellent skull-staff,

1.177.s:
ākāśamātaro devyastathānyā lokamātaraḥ ..
bhūtānāṃ mātaraḥ sarvāstathānyāḥ pitṛmātaraḥ .. 17 ..
1.177.d:
आकाशमातरो देव्यस्तथान्या लोकमातरः ॥
भूतानां मातरः सर्वास्तथान्याः पितृमातरः ॥ 17 ॥
1.177.m: the celestial Mothers, the goddesses, and likewise the other world-mothers, / all the Mothers of living beings, and likewise other ancestral Mothers,

1.177.s:
vṛddhiśrāddheṣu pūjyaṃte yāstu devyo manīṣibhiḥ ..
mātre pramātre tanmātre iti mātṛmukhāstathā .. 18 ..
1.177.d:
वृद्धिश्राद्धेषु पूज्यंते यास्तु देव्यो मनीषिभिः ॥
मात्रे प्रमात्रे तन्मात्रे इति मातृमुखास्तथा ॥ 18 ॥
1.177.m: the goddesses who are worshipped by the wise in Vṛddhi-śrāddha rites, / heading the Mothers with the formulas ‘to the mother’, ‘to the maternal grandmother’, and ‘to her mother’,

1.177.s:
pitāmahī tu tanmātā vṛddhā yā ca pitāmahī ..
ityetāstu pitāmahyaḥ śāṃtiṃ te pitṛmātaraḥ .. 19 ..
1.177.d:
पितामही तु तन्माता वृद्धा या च पितामही ॥
इत्येतास्तु पितामह्यः शांतिं ते पितृमातरः ॥ 19 ॥
1.177.m: the paternal grandmother, her mother, and the paternal great-great-grandmother— / may these paternal grandmothers and ancestral Mothers [bring about] peace for you.

1.177.s:
sarvā mātṛmahādevyaḥ svāyudhāvyagrapāṇayaḥ ..
jagadvyāpya pratiṣṭhaṃtyo balikāmā mahodayāḥ .. 1.177.20 ..
1.177.d:
सर्वा मातृमहादेव्यः स्वायुधाव्यग्रपाणयः ॥
जगद्व्याप्य प्रतिष्ठंत्यो बलिकामा महोदयाः ॥ 1.177.20 ॥
1.177.m: May all the great goddess Mothers, their hands occupied with their own weapons, / remaining pervasive throughout the universe, desiring offerings, of great fortune,

1.177.s:
śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu tā nityamādityārādhane ratāḥ ..
śāṃtena cetasā śāṃtyaḥ śāṃtaye tava śāṃtidā .. 21 ..
1.177.d:
शांतिं कुर्वंतु ता नित्यमादित्याराधने रताः ॥
शांतेन चेतसा शांत्यः शांतये तव शांतिदा ॥ 21 ॥
1.177.m: ever bring about peace, engaged in the adoration of Āditya; / tranquil with peaceful minds, bestowing peace for the sake of your tranquility.

1.177.s:
sarvāvayavamukhyena gātreṇa ca sumadhyamā !.
pītaśyāmāti saumyena snigdhavarṇena śobhanā .. 22 ..
1.177.d:
सर्वावयवमुख्येन गात्रेण च सुमध्यमा !।
पीतश्यामाति सौम्येन स्निग्धवर्णेन शोभना ॥ 22 ॥
1.177.m: Slender-waisted, her body foremost in all its limbs, / lovely with an exceedingly gentle and glossy complexion of yellowish-dark hue,

1.177.s:
lalāṭatilakopetā caṃdrarekhārdhadhāriṇī ..
citrāṃbaradharā devī sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā .. 23 ..
1.177.d:
ललाटतिलकोपेता चंद्ररेखार्धधारिणी ॥
चित्रांबरधरा देवी सर्वाभरणभूषिता ॥ 23 ॥
1.177.m: bearing a forehead mark, wearing the crescent of the moon, / the goddess clad in variegated robes, adorned with all ornaments,

1.177.s:
varā strīmayarūpāṇāṃ śobhā guṇasusampadā ..
bhāvanāmātrasaṃtuṣṭā umā devī varapradā ..24..
1.177.d:
वरा स्त्रीमयरूपाणां शोभा गुणसुसम्पदा ॥
भावनामात्रसंतुष्टा उमा देवी वरप्रदा ॥24॥
1.177.m: the finest of female forms, beauty itself through the excellence of her virtues, / contented merely by devotion, the boon-giving goddess Umā,

1.177.s:
sākṣādāgatya rūpeṇa śāṃtenāmitatejasā ..
śāṃtiṃ karotu te prītā ādityā rādhane ratā .. 25 .. ..
1.177.d:
साक्षादागत्य रूपेण शांतेनामिततेजसा ॥
शांतिं करोतु ते प्रीता आदित्या राधने रता ॥ 25 ॥ ॥
1.177.m: having arrived directly in her peaceful form of boundless splendour, / may she, delighted and engaged in the adoration of Āditya, bring about peace for you.

1.177.s:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe sauradharmeṣu daśamukhe agnikāryavidhau saptasaptatyuttaraśatatamodhyāyaḥ .. .. 177 ..
sauradharmavarṇanam
1.177.d:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे ब्राह्मे पर्वणि सप्तमीकल्पे सौरधर्मेषु दशमुखे अग्निकार्यविधौ सप्तसप्तत्युत्तरशततमोध्यायः ॥ ॥ 177 ॥
सौरधर्मवर्णनम्
1.177.m:
Thus ends the one hundred and seventy-seventh chapter, on the procedure of the fire sacrifice in the Daśamukha section, in the duties pertaining to the Sun in the Saptamīkalpa of the Brāhmaparvan in the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
Description of the duties pertaining to the Sun

1.178.s:
.. aruṇa uvāca .. ..
abalo bālarūpeṇa khaṭvāṃgaśikhivāhanaḥ ..
pūrveṇa vadanaḥ śrīmāṃstriśikhaḥ śaktisaṃyutaḥ .. 1 ..
1.178.d:
॥ अरुण उवाच ॥ ॥
अबलो बालरूपेण खट्वांगशिखिवाहनः ॥
पूर्वेण वदनः श्रीमांस्त्रिशिखः शक्तिसंयुतः ॥ 1 ॥
1.178.m: Aruṇa said: / The powerless one who took the form of a child, who carries a staff and rides a peacock, / whose face is turned toward the east, the glorious one with three tufts, equipped with the spear,

1.178.s:
kṛttikāyāśca rudrasya cāṃgodbhūtaḥ surārcitaḥ ..
kārtikeyo mahātejā ādityavaradarpitaḥ ..
śāṃtiṃ karotu te nityaṃ balaṃ saukhyaṃ ca tejasā .. 2 ..
1.178.d:
कृत्तिकायाश्च रुद्रस्य चांगोद्भूतः सुरार्चितः ॥
कार्तिकेयो महातेजा आदित्यवरदर्पितः ॥
शांतिं करोतु ते नित्यं बलं सौख्यं च तेजसा ॥ 2 ॥
1.178.m: born from Kṛttikā and the body of Rudra, worshipped by the gods, / Kārtikeya of great splendor, proud through the boons of the sun: / may he continually grant you peace, strength, and happiness through his brilliance.

1.178.s:
ātreyībalavāndeva ārogyaṃ ca khagādhipa ..
śvetavastraparīdhānastryakṣaḥ kanakasuprabhaḥ .. 3 ..
1.178.d:
आत्रेयीबलवान्देव आरोग्यं च खगाधिप ॥
श्वेतवस्त्रपरीधानस्त्र्यक्षः कनकसुप्रभः ॥ 3 ॥
1.178.m: The god endowed with the strength of the daughter of Atri, [grantor of] freedom from disease, O king of birds, / clad in white garments, three-eyed, having the fine radiance of gold,

1.178.s:
śūlahasto mahāprājño nadīśo ravibhāvitaḥ ..
śāṃtiṃ karotu te śānto dharme ca matimuttamām .. 4 ..
1.178.d:
शूलहस्तो महाप्राज्ञो नदीशो रविभावितः ॥
शांतिं करोतु ते शान्तो धर्मे च मतिमुत्तमाम् ॥ 4 ॥
1.178.m: with a spear in his hand, of great wisdom, the lord of rivers devoted to the sun: / may he, tranquil, grant you peace and an excellent mind set on righteousness.

1.178.s:
dharmetarāvubhau nityamacalaḥ saṃprayacchatu ..
mahodaro mahākāyaḥ snigdhāṃjanasamaprabhaḥ .. 5 ..
1.178.d:
धर्मेतरावुभौ नित्यमचलः संप्रयच्छतु ॥
महोदरो महाकायः स्निग्धांजनसमप्रभः ॥ 5 ॥
1.178.m: May the immovable one continually bestow both the right and its opposite. / The large-bellied one, huge-bodied, shining like smooth black collyrium,

1.178.s:
ekadaṃṣṭrotkaṭo devo gajavaktro mahābalaḥ ..
nāgayajñopavītena nānābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ ..6..
1.178.d:
एकदंष्ट्रोत्कटो देवो गजवक्त्रो महाबलः ॥
नागयज्ञोपवीतेन नानाभरणभूषितः ॥6॥
1.178.m: the fierce god with a single tusk, elephant-faced, of great strength, / adorned with a serpent sacred thread and various ornaments,

1.178.s:
sarvārthasaṃpadoddhāro gaṇādhyakṣo varapradaḥ ..
bhīmasya tanayo devo nāyakotha vināyakaḥ ..
karotu te mahāśāṃtiṃ bhāskarārcanatatparaḥ .. 7 ..
1.178.d:
सर्वार्थसंपदोद्धारो गणाध्यक्षो वरप्रदः ॥
भीमस्य तनयो देवो नायकोथ विनायकः ॥
करोतु ते महाशांतिं भास्करार्चनतत्परः ॥ 7 ॥
1.178.m: the rescuer through the attainment of all goals, the leader of the hosts, the giver of boons, / the god who is the son of Bhīma, the guide, and the vināyaka: / intent on worshipping the sun, may he bring you great peace.

1.178.s:
iṃdranīlanibhastryakṣo dīptaśūlāyudhodyataḥ ..
raktāṃbaradharaḥ śrīmānkṛṣṇāṃgo nāgabhūṣaṇaḥ .. 8 ..
1.178.d:
इंद्रनीलनिभस्त्र्यक्षो दीप्तशूलायुधोद्यतः ॥
रक्तांबरधरः श्रीमान्कृष्णांगो नागभूषणः ॥ 8 ॥
1.178.m: Resembling sapphire, three-eyed, raising a blazing spear as his weapon, / wearing red garments, glorious, black-bodied, adorned with snakes,

1.178.s:
pāpāpanodamatulamalakṣyo malanāśanaḥ ..
karotu te mahāśāṃtiṃ prītaḥ prītena cetasā .. 9 ..
1.178.d:
पापापनोदमतुलमलक्ष्यो मलनाशनः ॥
करोतु ते महाशांतिं प्रीतः प्रीतेन चेतसा ॥ 9 ॥
1.178.m: incomparable in dispelling sins, invisible, destroyer of impurities: / pleased, may he grant you great peace with a pleased heart.

1.178.s:
varāṃbaradharā kanyā nānālaṃkārabhūṣitā ..
tridaśānāṃ ca jananī puṇyā lokanamaskṛtā .. 1.178.10 ..
1.178.d:
वरांबरधरा कन्या नानालंकारभूषिता ॥
त्रिदशानां च जननी पुण्या लोकनमस्कृता ॥ 1.178.10 ॥
1.178.m: Clad in choice garments, a maiden adorned with various ornaments, / the mother of the gods, holy, revered by all the worlds,

1.178.s:
sarvasiddhikarā devī prasādaparamāspadā ..
śāṃtiṃ karotu te mātā bhuvanasya khagādhipa .. 11 ..
1.178.d:
सर्वसिद्धिकरा देवी प्रसादपरमास्पदा ॥
शांतिं करोतु ते माता भुवनस्य खगाधिप ॥ 11 ॥
1.178.m: the goddess who brings about all accomplishments, the supreme abode of grace: / may the mother of the universe grant you peace, O king of birds.

1.178.s:
snigdhaśyāmena varṇena mahāmahiṣamardanī ..
dhanuścakrapraharaṇā khaṅgapaṭṭiśadhāriṇī .. 12 ..
1.178.d:
स्निग्धश्यामेन वर्णेन महामहिषमर्दनी ॥
धनुश्चक्रप्रहरणा खङ्गपट्टिशधारिणी ॥ 12 ॥
1.178.m: With a glossy dark complexion, the crusher of the great buffalo, / wielding a bow and a discus as weapons, carrying a sword and a paṭṭiśa,

1.178.s:
ātarjanyāyatakarā sarvopadravanāśinī ..
śāṃtiṃ karotu te durgā bhavānī ca śivā tathā .. 13 ..
1.178.d:
आतर्जन्यायतकरा सर्वोपद्रवनाशिनी ॥
शांतिं करोतु ते दुर्गा भवानी च शिवा तथा ॥ 13 ॥
1.178.m: with hands outstretched in a threatening gesture, destroyer of all afflictions: / may Durgā, Bhavānī, and Śivā grant you peace.

1.178.s:
atisūkṣmo hyatikrodhastryakṣo bhṛṃgiriṭirmahān ..
sūryātmako mahāvīraḥ sūryaikagatamānasaḥ ..
sūryabhaktikaro nityaṃ śivaṃ te saṃprayacchatu .. 14 ..
1.178.d:
अतिसूक्ष्मो ह्यतिक्रोधस्त्र्यक्षो भृंगिरिटिर्महान् ॥
सूर्यात्मको महावीरः सूर्यैकगतमानसः ॥
सूर्यभक्तिकरो नित्यं शिवं ते संप्रयच्छतु ॥ 14 ॥
1.178.m: Exceedingly slender and exceedingly fierce, the three-eyed, the great Bhṛṅgiriṭi, / whose self belongs to the sun, the great hero, his mind fixed solely on the sun, / who continually practices devotion to the sun: may he bestow auspiciousness upon you.

1.178.s:
pracaṃḍagaṇasainyeśo mahāghaṃṭākṣadhārakaḥ ..
akṣamālārpitakaraścākṣacaṃḍeśvaro varaḥ .. 15 ..
1.178.d:
प्रचंडगणसैन्येशो महाघंटाक्षधारकः ॥
अक्षमालार्पितकरश्चाक्षचंडेश्वरो वरः ॥ 15 ॥
1.178.m: The lord of the army of fierce hosts, bearer of a great bell and rosary beads, / his hand endowed with a rosary, the excellent lord of the fierce eye,

1.178.s:
caṃḍapāpaharo nityaṃ brahmahatyā vināśanaḥ ..
śāṃtiṃ karotu te nityamādityārādhane rataḥ ..
karoti ca mahāyogī kalyāṇānāṃ paraṃparām .. 16 ..
1.178.d:
चंडपापहरो नित्यं ब्रह्महत्या विनाशनः ॥
शांतिं करोतु ते नित्यमादित्याराधने रतः ॥
करोति च महायोगी कल्याणानां परंपराम् ॥ 16 ॥
1.178.m: who constantly removes terrible sins and destroys [even the sin of] killing a Brahmin: / intent on worshipping the sun, may he continually grant you peace, / and may that great yogin bring forth a continuous succession of blessings.

1.178.s:
ākāśamātaro divyāstathānyā devamātaraḥ ..
sūryāyaṇaparā devyo jagadvyāpya vyavasthitāḥ ..
śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu me nityaṃ mātaraḥ surapūjitāḥ .. 17 ..
1.178.d:
आकाशमातरो दिव्यास्तथान्या देवमातरः ॥
सूर्यायणपरा देव्यो जगद्व्याप्य व्यवस्थिताः ॥
शांतिं कुर्वंतु मे नित्यं मातरः सुरपूजिताः ॥ 17 ॥
1.178.m: The divine mothers of the sky and the other mothers of the gods, / goddesses devoted to the course of the sun, who abide pervading the world: / worshipped by the gods, may the mothers continually grant me peace.

1.178.s:
ye rudrā raudrakarmāṇo raudra sthānanivāsinaḥ ..
mātaro rudrarūpāśca gaṇānāmadhipāśca ye .. 18 ..
1.178.d:
ये रुद्रा रौद्रकर्माणो रौद्र स्थाननिवासिनः ॥
मातरो रुद्ररूपाश्च गणानामधिपाश्च ये ॥ 18 ॥
1.178.m: Those Rudras of terrible deeds who dwell in terrifying abodes, / the mothers possessing Rudra's form, and those who are chiefs of the hosts,

1.178.s:
vighnabhūtāstathā cānye digvidikṣu samāśritāḥ ..
sarve te prītamanasaḥ pratigṛhṇaṃtu me balim ..
siddhiṃ kurvaṃtu te nityaṃ bhayebhyaḥ pāṃtu sarvataḥ .. 19 ..
1.178.d:
विघ्नभूतास्तथा चान्ये दिग्विदिक्षु समाश्रिताः ॥
सर्वे ते प्रीतमनसः प्रतिगृह्णंतु मे बलिम् ॥
सिद्धिं कुर्वंतु ते नित्यं भयेभ्यः पांतु सर्वतः ॥ 19 ॥
1.178.m: and others who have become obstacles, residing in the cardinal and intermediate directions: / may all of them, with pleased minds, accept my offering. / May they constantly bring you success and protect you from terrors on all sides.

1.178.s:
aiṃdrādayo gaṇā ye tu vajrahastā mahābalāḥ ..
himakundeṃdusadṛśā nīlakṛṣṇāṃgalohitāḥ .. 1.178.20 ..
1.178.d:
ऐंद्रादयो गणा ये तु वज्रहस्ता महाबलाः ॥
हिमकुन्देंदुसदृशा नीलकृष्णांगलोहिताः ॥ 1.178.20 ॥
1.178.m: Those hosts belonging to Indra and others, wielding thunderbolts, of great strength, / resembling snow, the kunda flower, and the moon, with limbs dark-blue, black, and red,

1.178.s:
divyāṃtarikṣā bhaumāśca pātālatalavāsinaḥ ..
aiṃdrāḥ śāṃtiṃ prakurvaṃtu bhadrāṇi ca punaḥ punaḥ .. 21 ..
1.178.d:
दिव्यांतरिक्षा भौमाश्च पातालतलवासिनः ॥
ऐंद्राः शांतिं प्रकुर्वंतु भद्राणि च पुनः पुनः ॥ 21 ॥
1.178.m: celestial, atmospheric, terrestrial, and dwelling in the realm of Pātāla: / may those of Indra bring peace and good fortune again and again.

1.178.s:
āgneyyāṃ ye bhṛtāḥ sarve dhruvahatyānuṣaṃgiṇaḥ ..
sūryānuraktā raktābhā japāsumanibhāstathā .. 22 ..
1.178.d:
आग्नेय्यां ये भृताः सर्वे ध्रुवहत्यानुषंगिणः ॥
सूर्यानुरक्ता रक्ताभा जपासुमनिभास्तथा ॥ 22 ॥
1.178.m: All those maintained in the southeast who adhere to the slaughter of the steady, / devoted to the sun, glowing red, resembling the hibiscus flower,

1.178.s:
viraktalohitā divyā āgneyyāṃ bhāskarādayaḥ ..
ādityārādhanaparā ādityagatamānasāḥ .. 23 ..
1.178.d:
विरक्तलोहिता दिव्या आग्नेय्यां भास्करादयः ॥
आदित्याराधनपरा आदित्यगतमानसाः ॥ 23 ॥
1.178.m: celestial ones glowing passionately red in the southeast, Bhāskara and others, / intent on worshipping the sun, their minds fixed on the sun:

1.178.s:
śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te nityaṃ prayacchaṃtu baliṃ mama ..
bhayā''dityasamā ye tu satataṃ daṇḍapāṇayaḥ ..
ādityārādhanaparāḥ kaṃ prayacchaṃtu te sadā .. 24 ..
1.178.d:
शांतिं कुर्वंतु ते नित्यं प्रयच्छंतु बलिं मम ॥
भया'ऽदित्यसमा ये तु सततं दण्डपाणयः ॥
आदित्याराधनपराः कं प्रयच्छंतु ते सदा ॥ 24 ॥
1.178.m: May they continually grant you peace, and may they accept my offering. / Those who resemble the sun out of dread, constantly holding staves in their hands, / intent on worshipping the sun: may they always bestow happiness upon you.

1.178.s:
aiśānyāṃ saṃsthitā ye tu praśāṃtāḥ śūlapāṇayaḥ ..
bhasmoddhūlitadehāśca nīlakaṇṭhā vilohitāḥ .. 25 ..
1.178.d:
ऐशान्यां संस्थिता ये तु प्रशांताः शूलपाणयः ॥
भस्मोद्धूलितदेहाश्च नीलकण्ठा विलोहिताः ॥ 25 ॥
1.178.m: Those abiding in the northeast, tranquil, holding tridents in their hands, / their bodies smeared with ashes, blue-throated, deeply crimson,

1.178.s:
divyāṃtarikṣā bhaumāśca pātālatalavāsinaḥ ..
sūryapūjākarā nityaṃ pūjayitvāṃśumālinam .. 26 ..
1.178.d:
दिव्यांतरिक्षा भौमाश्च पातालतलवासिनः ॥
सूर्यपूजाकरा नित्यं पूजयित्वांशुमालिनम् ॥ 26 ॥
1.178.m: celestial, atmospheric, terrestrial, and dwelling in the realm of Pātāla, / who continually perform the worship of the sun, having worshipped the ray-garlanded one:

1.178.s:
tataḥ suprītamanaso lokapālaiḥ sama nvitāḥ ..
śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu me nityaṃ kaṃ prayacchaṃtu pūjitāḥ ..27..
1.178.d:
ततः सुप्रीतमनसो लोकपालैः सम न्विताः ॥
शांतिं कुर्वंतु मे नित्यं कं प्रयच्छंतु पूजिताः ॥27॥
1.178.m: Then, with very pleased minds, accompanied by the world protectors, / may they, being worshipped, continually grant me peace and bestow happiness.

1.178.s:
amarāvatī purī nāma pūrvabhāge vyavasthitā ..
vidyādharagaṇākīrṇā siddhagandharvase vitā ..28..
1.178.d:
अमरावती पुरी नाम पूर्वभागे व्यवस्थिता ॥
विद्याधरगणाकीर्णा सिद्धगन्धर्वसे विता ॥28॥
1.178.m: The city named Amarāvatī, situated in the eastern region, / crowded with hosts of Vidyādharas, attended by Siddhas and Gandharvas,

1.178.s:
ratnaprākārarucirā mahāratnopaśobhitā ..
tatra devapatiḥ śrīmānvajrapāṇirmahābalaḥ ..
gopatirgosahasreṇa śobhamānena śobhate ..29..
1.178.d:
रत्नप्राकाररुचिरा महारत्नोपशोभिता ॥
तत्र देवपतिः श्रीमान्वज्रपाणिर्महाबलः ॥
गोपतिर्गोसहस्रेण शोभमानेन शोभते ॥29॥
1.178.m: splendid with ramparts of jewels, adorned with great gems: / there the glorious lord of the gods, wielding the thunderbolt, of great strength, / the lord of cattle, shines brightly with a shining thousand of rays.

1.178.s:
airāvatagajārūḍho gairikābho mahādyutiḥ..
deveṃdraḥ satataṃ hṛṣṭa ādityārādhane rataḥ .. 1.178.30 ..
1.178.d:
ऐरावतगजारूढो गैरिकाभो महाद्युतिः॥
देवेंद्रः सततं हृष्ट आदित्याराधने रतः ॥ 1.178.30 ॥
1.178.m: Mounted on the elephant Airāvata, glowing like red chalk, of great splendor, / the lord of the gods, constantly delighted, devoted to the worship of the sun,

1.178.s:
sūryajñānaikaparamaḥ sūryabhaktisamanvitaḥ ..
sūryapraṇāmaḥ paramāṃ śāṃtiṃ te'dya prayacchatu .. 31 ..
1.178.d:
सूर्यज्ञानैकपरमः सूर्यभक्तिसमन्वितः ॥
सूर्यप्रणामः परमां शांतिं तेऽद्य प्रयच्छतु ॥ 31 ॥
1.178.m: devoted exclusively to the knowledge of the sun, endowed with devotion to the sun: / bowing to the sun, may he grant you supreme peace today.

1.178.s:
āgneyadigvibhāge tu purī tejasvatī śubhā ..
nānādevagaṇākīrṇā nānāratnopaśobhitā .. 32 ..
1.178.d:
आग्नेयदिग्विभागे तु पुरी तेजस्वती शुभा ॥
नानादेवगणाकीर्णा नानारत्नोपशोभिता ॥ 32 ॥
1.178.m: In the southeastern quarter lies the auspicious city Tejasvatī, / crowded with hosts of various gods, adorned with various jewels.

1.178.s:
tatra jvālā samākīrṇo dīptāṃgārasamadyutiḥ ..
purago dahano devo jvalanaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ .. 33 ..
1.178.d:
तत्र ज्वाला समाकीर्णो दीप्तांगारसमद्युतिः ॥
पुरगो दहनो देवो ज्वलनः पापनाशनः ॥ 33 ॥
1.178.m: There is the god of fire who abides in the city, surrounded by flames, brilliant as blazing charcoal, / the consumer [of offerings], the burner, the destroyer of sins,

1.178.s:
ādityārādhanarata ādityagatamānasaḥ ..
śāṃtiṃ karotu te devastathā pāpaparikṣayam .. 34 ..
1.178.d:
आदित्याराधनरत आदित्यगतमानसः ॥
शांतिं करोतु ते देवस्तथा पापपरिक्षयम् ॥ 34 ॥
1.178.m: devoted to the worship of the sun, his mind fixed upon the sun: / may the god grant you peace and the destruction of sins.

1.178.s:
vaivasvatī purī ramyā dakṣiṇena mahātmanaḥ ..
surāsuraśatākīrṇā nānāratnopaśobhitā ..35..
1.178.d:
वैवस्वती पुरी रम्या दक्षिणेन महात्मनः ॥
सुरासुरशताकीर्णा नानारत्नोपशोभिता ॥35॥
1.178.m: The charming city Vaivasvatī, belonging to that great soul, lies in the south, / crowded with hundreds of gods and asuras, adorned with various gems.

1.178.s:
tatra kundeṃdusaṃkāśo haripiṃgalalocanaḥ ..
mahāmahiṣamārūḍhaḥ kṛṣṇasragvastrabhūṣaṇaḥ .. 36 ..
1.178.d:
तत्र कुन्देंदुसंकाशो हरिपिंगललोचनः ॥
महामहिषमारूढः कृष्णस्रग्वस्त्रभूषणः ॥ 36 ॥
1.178.m: There abides [Yama], resembling the kunda flower and the moon, with yellowish-tawny eyes, / mounted upon a great buffalo, adorned with black garlands and garments,

1.178.s:
antako'tha mahātejāḥ sūryadharmaparāyaṇaḥ ..
ādityārādhanaparaḥ kṣemārogye dadātu te .. 37 ..
1.178.d:
अन्तकोऽथ महातेजाः सूर्यधर्मपरायणः ॥
आदित्याराधनपरः क्षेमारोग्ये ददातु ते ॥ 37 ॥
1.178.m: the ender [of life], of great splendor, devoted to the law of the sun: / intent on the worship of the sun, may he grant you security and health.

1.178.s:
nairṛte digvibhāge tu purī kṛṣṇeti viśrutā ..
moharakṣogaṇāśaucapiśācapretasaṃkulā .. 38 ..
1.178.d:
नैरृते दिग्विभागे तु पुरी कृष्णेति विश्रुता ॥
मोहरक्षोगणाशौचपिशाचप्रेतसंकुला ॥ 38 ॥
1.178.m: In the southwestern quarter lies the city celebrated as Kṛṣṇā, / filled with infatuated hosts of rākṣasas, impurities, piśācas, and pretas.

1.178.s:
tatra kundanibho devo raktasragvastra bhūṣaṇaḥ ..
khaḍgapāṇirmahātejāḥ karālavadanojjvalaḥ .. 39 ..
1.178.d:
तत्र कुन्दनिभो देवो रक्तस्रग्वस्त्र भूषणः ॥
खड्गपाणिर्महातेजाः करालवदनोज्ज्वलः ॥ 39 ॥
1.178.m: There the god resembling the kunda flower, adorned with red garlands and garments, / holding a sword in his hand, of great splendor, radiant with a terrifying face,

1.178.s:
rakṣeṃdro vasate nityamādityārādhane rataḥ ..
karotu me sadā śāṃtiṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ praya cchatu .. 1.178.40 ..
1.178.d:
रक्षेंद्रो वसते नित्यमादित्याराधने रतः ॥
करोतु मे सदा शांतिं धनं धान्यं प्रय च्छतु ॥ 1.178.40 ॥
1.178.m: the lord of the rākṣasas dwells continually, devoted to the worship of the sun: / may he always bring me peace and grant wealth and grain.

1.178.s:
paścime tu diśo bhāge purī śuddhavatī sadā ..
nānābhogisamākīrṇā nānākinnarasevitā .. 41 ..
1.178.d:
पश्चिमे तु दिशो भागे पुरी शुद्धवती सदा ॥
नानाभोगिसमाकीर्णा नानाकिन्नरसेविता ॥ 41 ॥
1.178.m: In the western quarter lies the city Śuddhavatī, / crowded with various serpent-beings, served by various Kinnaras.

1.178.s:
tatra kundedusaṃkāśo haripiṃgala locanaḥ ..
śāṃtiṃ karotu me prītaḥ śāṃtaḥ śāṃtena cetasā .. 42 ..
1.178.d:
तत्र कुन्देदुसंकाशो हरिपिंगल लोचनः ॥
शांतिं करोतु मे प्रीतः शांतः शांतेन चेतसा ॥ 42 ॥
1.178.m: There [abides the lord], resembling the kunda flower and the moon, with yellowish-tawny eyes: / pleased and tranquil, may he grant me peace with a tranquil mind.

1.178.s:
yaśovatī purī ramyā aiśānīṃ diśamāśritā ..
nānāgaṇasamākīrṇā nānākṛta śubhālayā ..
tejaḥprākāraparyaṃtā anaupamyā sadojvalā .. 43 ..
1.178.d:
यशोवती पुरी रम्या ऐशानीं दिशमाश्रिता ॥
नानागणसमाकीर्णा नानाकृत शुभालया ॥
तेजःप्राकारपर्यंता अनौपम्या सदोज्वला ॥ 43 ॥
1.178.m: The lovely city Yaśovatī, situated in the northeast direction, / filled with various hosts, having auspicious abodes created in various forms, / bounded by a rampart of splendour, peerless, and ever radiant; 43

1.178.s:
tatra kuṃdeṃdusaṃkāśaścāṃbujākṣo vibhūṣitaḥ ..
trinetraḥ śāṃtarūpātmā akṣamālā dharādharaḥ ..
īśānaḥ paramo devaḥ sadā śāṃtiṃ prayacchatu .. 44 ..
1.178.d:
तत्र कुंदेंदुसंकाशश्चांबुजाक्षो विभूषितः ॥
त्रिनेत्रः शांतरूपात्मा अक्षमाला धराधरः ॥
ईशानः परमो देवः सदा शांतिं प्रयच्छतु ॥ 44 ॥
1.178.m: There, resembling a jasmine flower and the moon, lotus-eyed, adorned, / three-eyed, whose nature is of tranquil form, bearer of the rosary, / may the supreme god Īśāna ever grant peace. 44

1.178.s:
bhūloke tu bhuvarloke nivasaṃti ca ye sadā ..
devādevāḥ śubhāyuktāḥ śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā .. 45 ..
1.178.d:
भूलोके तु भुवर्लोके निवसंति च ये सदा ॥
देवादेवाः शुभायुक्ताः शांतिं कुर्वंतु ते सदा ॥ 45 ॥
1.178.m: And those gods endowed with auspiciousness who dwell constantly in the earth-realm and the atmosphere-realm, / may they ever grant peace to you. 45

1.178.s:
maharloke janoloke paraloke gatāśca ye ..
te sarve muditā devāḥ śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā .. 46 ..
1.178.d:
महर्लोके जनोलोके परलोके गताश्च ये ॥
ते सर्वे मुदिता देवाः शांतिं कुर्वंतु ते सदा ॥ 46 ॥
1.178.m: And those who have gone to Maharloka, Janaloka, and the other realm, / may all those delighted gods ever grant peace to you. 46

1.178.s:
sarasvatī sūryabhaktā śāṃtidā vidadhātu me ..
cārucāmīkarasthā yā sarojakarapallavā ..
sūryabhaktyāśritā devī vibhūtiṃ te prayacchatu .. 47 ..
1.178.d:
सरस्वती सूर्यभक्ता शांतिदा विदधातु मे ॥
चारुचामीकरस्था या सरोजकरपल्लवा ॥
सूर्यभक्त्याश्रिता देवी विभूतिं ते प्रयच्छतु ॥ 47 ॥
1.178.m: May Sarasvatī, devoted to the sun, the giver of peace, bestow [it] upon me; / she who stands on beautiful gold, whose hand-sprouts hold lotuses, / the goddess reliant on devotion to the sun—may she grant prosperity to you. 47

1.178.s:
hareṇa suvicitreṇa bhāsvatkanakamekhalā ..
aparājitā sūryabhaktā karotu vijayaṃ tava .. 48 ..
sauradharmavarṇanam
1.178.d:
हरेण सुविचित्रेण भास्वत्कनकमेखला ॥
अपराजिता सूर्यभक्ता करोतु विजयं तव ॥ 48 ॥
सौरधर्मवर्णनम्
1.178.m:
With a variegated necklace, her girdle of shining gold, / may Aparājitā, devoted to the sun, bring about your victory. 48
Description of the Solar Religion

1.179.s:
.. aruṇa uvāca .. ..
kṛttikā paramā devī rohiṇī ca varānanā ..
śrīmanmṛgaśiro bhadrā ārdrā cāpyaparojjvalā .. 1 ..
1.179.d:
॥ अरुण उवाच ॥ ॥
कृत्तिका परमा देवी रोहिणी च वरानना ॥
श्रीमन्मृगशिरो भद्रा आर्द्रा चाप्यपरोज्ज्वला ॥ 1 ॥
1.179.m: Aruṇa said: / The supreme goddess Kṛttikā, and Rohiṇī of excellent face, / the glorious Mṛgaśiras, the auspicious Ārdrā, and the peerlessly radiant one, 1

1.179.s:
punarvasustathā puṣya āśleṣā ca tathādhipa ..
sūryārcanaratā nityaṃ sūryabhāvānubhāvitāḥ .. 2 ..
1.179.d:
पुनर्वसुस्तथा पुष्य आश्लेषा च तथाधिप ॥
सूर्यार्चनरता नित्यं सूर्यभावानुभाविताः ॥ 2 ॥
1.179.m: Punarvasu as well, Puṣya, and likewise Āśleṣā, O lord, / constantly devoted to sun-worship, suffused with devotion to the sun, 2

1.179.s:
arcayaṃti sadā devamādityaṃ surate sadā ..
nakṣatramātaro hyetāḥ prabhāmālāvibhūṣitāḥ .. 3 ..
1.179.d:
अर्चयंति सदा देवमादित्यं सुरते सदा ॥
नक्षत्रमातरो ह्येताः प्रभामालाविभूषिताः ॥ 3 ॥
1.179.m: Ever worship the god Āditya, constantly for the sake of the gods; / for these mother-stars are adorned with garlands of radiance. 3

1.179.s:
maghā sarvaguṇopetā pūrvā caiva tu phālgunī ..
svātī viśākhā varadā dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāśritāḥ .. 4 ..
1.179.d:
मघा सर्वगुणोपेता पूर्वा चैव तु फाल्गुनी ॥
स्वाती विशाखा वरदा दक्षिणां दिशमाश्रिताः ॥ 4 ॥
1.179.m: Maghā endowed with all virtues, and Pūrvaphalgunī, / Svātī, and boon-bestowing Viśākhā, situated in the southern direction, 4

1.179.s:
arcayaṃti sadā devamādityaṃ surapūjitam ..
tavāpi śāṃtikaṃ dyotaṃ kurvaṃtu gaganoditāḥ .. 5 ..
1.179.d:
अर्चयंति सदा देवमादित्यं सुरपूजितम् ॥
तवापि शांतिकं द्योतं कुर्वंतु गगनोदिताः ॥ 5 ॥
1.179.m: Ever worship the god Āditya, worshipped by the gods; / risen in the sky, may they bring about peaceful light for you as well. 5

1.179.s:
anurādhā tathā jyeṣṭhā mūlaṃ sūryapuraḥsarā ..
pūrvāṣāḍhā mahāvīryā āṣāḍhā cottarā tathā .. 6 ..
1.179.d:
अनुराधा तथा ज्येष्ठा मूलं सूर्यपुरःसरा ॥
पूर्वाषाढा महावीर्या आषाढा चोत्तरा तथा ॥ 6 ॥
1.179.m: Anurādhā, and Jyeṣṭhā, Mūla following the sun, / Pūrvāṣāḍhā of great valour, and likewise Uttarāṣāḍhā, 6

1.179.s:
abhijinnāma nakṣatraṃ śravaṇaṃ ca bahuśrutam ..
etāḥ paścimato dīptā rājaṃte cānu mūrtayaḥ .. 7 ..
1.179.d:
अभिजिन्नाम नक्षत्रं श्रवणं च बहुश्रुतम् ॥
एताः पश्चिमतो दीप्ता राजंते चानु मूर्तयः ॥ 7 ॥
1.179.m: The asterism named Abhijit, and Śravaṇa of wide renown— / these blazing forms shine forth in succession in the west. 7

1.179.s:
bhāskaraṃ pūjayaṃtyetāḥ sarvakālaṃ subhāvitāḥ ..
śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te nityaṃ vibhūtiṃ ca maharddhikām ..8..
1.179.d:
भास्करं पूजयंत्येताः सर्वकालं सुभाविताः ॥
शांतिं कुर्वंतु ते नित्यं विभूतिं च महर्द्धिकाम् ॥8॥
1.179.m: Filled with noble devotion, they worship the sun at all times; / may they constantly bring you peace and prosperity of great abundance. 8

1.179.s: dhaniṣṭhā śatabhiṣā tu pūrvabhādrapadā tathā .. 9 ..
1.179.d: धनिष्ठा शतभिषा तु पूर्वभाद्रपदा तथा ॥ 9 ॥
1.179.m: Dhaniṣṭhā, Śatabhiṣaj, and Pūrvabhādrapadā, 9

1.179.s:
uttarā bhādrarevatyau cāśvinī ca mahāmate ..
bharaṇī ca mahādevī nityamuttarataḥ sthitāḥ .. 1.179.10 ..
1.179.d:
उत्तरा भाद्ररेवत्यौ चाश्विनी च महामते ॥
भरणी च महादेवी नित्यमुत्तरतः स्थिताः ॥ 1.179.10 ॥
1.179.m: Uttarabhādrapadā, Revatī, and Aśvinī, O noble-minded one, / and the great goddess Bharaṇī, ever situated in the north, 10

1.179.s:
sūryārcanaratā nityamādityagatamā nasāḥ ..
śāṃtiṃ kurvatu te nityaṃ vibhūtiṃ ca maharddhikām .. 11 ..
1.179.d:
सूर्यार्चनरता नित्यमादित्यगतमा नसाः ॥
शांतिं कुर्वतु ते नित्यं विभूतिं च महर्द्धिकाम् ॥ 11 ॥
1.179.m: Constantly devoted to sun-worship, their minds focused on Āditya, / may they constantly bring you peace and prosperity of great abundance. 11

1.179.s:
meṣo mṛgādhipaḥ siṃho dhanurdīptimatāṃ varaḥ ..
pūrveṇa bhāsayaṃtyete sūryayogaparāḥ śubhāḥ ..
śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te nityaṃ bhaktyā sūryapadāṃbuje .. 12 ..
1.179.d:
मेषो मृगाधिपः सिंहो धनुर्दीप्तिमतां वरः ॥
पूर्वेण भासयंत्येते सूर्ययोगपराः शुभाः ॥
शांतिं कुर्वंतु ते नित्यं भक्त्या सूर्यपदांबुजे ॥ 12 ॥
1.179.m: Aries, Leo the king of beasts, and Sagittarius the best of the radiant ones; / shining in the east, these auspicious signs are intent on union with the sun; / through devotion to the sun's lotus feet, may they constantly grant you peace. 12

1.179.s:
vṛṣaḥ kanyā ca paramā makaraścāpi buddhimān ..
ete dakṣiṇabhāge tu pūjayaṃti raviṃ sadā ..
bhaktyā paramayā nityaṃ śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā ..13..
1.179.d:
वृषः कन्या च परमा मकरश्चापि बुद्धिमान् ॥
एते दक्षिणभागे तु पूजयंति रविं सदा ॥
भक्त्या परमया नित्यं शांतिं कुर्वंतु ते सदा ॥13॥
1.179.m: Taurus, the supreme Virgo, and wise Capricorn; / these in the southern quarter ever worship the sun; / with supreme devotion, may they ever bring peace to you. 13

1.179.s:
mithunaṃ ca tulā kuṃbhaḥ paścime ca vyavasthitāḥ ..
japaṃtyete sadākālamādityaṃ grahanāya kam .. 14 ..
1.179.d:
मिथुनं च तुला कुंभः पश्चिमे च व्यवस्थिताः ॥
जपंत्येते सदाकालमादित्यं ग्रहनाय कम् ॥ 14 ॥
1.179.m: Gemini, Libra, and Aquarius, situated in the west; / they at all times chant [the praise of] Āditya, the lord of the planets. 14

1.179.s:
śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te nityaṃ khakholkājñānatatparāḥ ..
satapodattapuṣpābhyāṃ ye smṛtā satataṃ budhaiḥ .. 15 ..
1.179.d:
शांतिं कुर्वंतु ते नित्यं खखोल्काज्ञानतत्पराः ॥
सतपोदत्तपुष्पाभ्यां ये स्मृता सततं बुधैः ॥ 15 ॥
1.179.m: Intent upon the wisdom of Khakholka, may they constantly grant you peace; / they who are continuously remembered by the wise with austerity and offerings of flowers. 15

1.179.s:
ṛṣayaḥ sapta vikhyātā dhruvāṃtāḥ praramojjvalāḥ ..
bhānuprasādātsaṃpannāḥ śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā .. 16 ..
1.179.d:
ऋषयः सप्त विख्याता ध्रुवांताः प्ररमोज्ज्वलाः ॥
भानुप्रसादात्संपन्नाः शांतिं कुर्वंतु ते सदा ॥ 16 ॥
1.179.m: The renowned seven sages, ending with Dhruva, supremely radiant, / perfected through the grace of the sun—may they ever bring peace to you: 16

1.179.s:
kaśyapo gālavo gārgyo viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ ..
munirdakṣo vaśiṣṭhaśca mārkaṇḍaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ .. 17 ..
1.179.d:
कश्यपो गालवो गार्ग्यो विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः ॥
मुनिर्दक्षो वशिष्ठश्च मार्कण्डः पुलहः क्रतुः ॥ 17 ॥
1.179.m: Kaśyapa, Gālava, Gārgya, the great sage Viśvāmitra, / the sage Dakṣa, Vasiṣṭha, Mārkaṇḍa, Pulaha, Kratu, 17

1.179.s:
nārado bhṛgurātreyo bhāradvājaśca vai muniḥ ..
vālmīkiḥ kauśiko vātsyaḥ śākalyo'tha punarvasuḥ .. 18 ..
1.179.d:
नारदो भृगुरात्रेयो भारद्वाजश्च वै मुनिः ॥
वाल्मीकिः कौशिको वात्स्यः शाकल्योऽथ पुनर्वसुः ॥ 18 ॥
1.179.m: Nārada, Bhṛgu, Ātreya, and indeed the sage Bhāradvāja, / Vālmīki, Kauśika, Vātsya, Śākalya, and Punarvasu, 18

1.179.s:
śālaṃkāyana ityete ṛṣayo'tha mahātapāḥ ..
sūryadhyānaikaparamāḥ śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā.. 19 ..
1.179.d:
शालंकायन इत्येते ऋषयोऽथ महातपाः ॥
सूर्यध्यानैकपरमाः शांतिं कुर्वंतु ते सदा॥ 19 ॥
1.179.m: Śālaṅkāyana—these sages of great austerities, / wholly devoted to meditation on the sun, may they ever grant peace to you. 19

1.179.s:
munikanyā mahābhāgā ṛṣikanyāḥ kumārikāḥ ..
sūryārcanaratā nityaṃ śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā .. 1.179.20 ..
1.179.d:
मुनिकन्या महाभागा ऋषिकन्याः कुमारिकाः ॥
सूर्यार्चनरता नित्यं शांतिं कुर्वंतु ते सदा ॥ 1.179.20 ॥
1.179.m: The fortunate daughters of the munis, the maiden daughters of the sages, / constantly devoted to sun-worship, may they ever grant peace to you. 20

1.179.s:
siddhāḥ samṛddhatapaso ye cānye vai mahātapāḥ ..
vidyādharā mahātmāno garuḍaśca tvayā saha .. 21 ..
1.179.d:
सिद्धाः समृद्धतपसो ये चान्ये वै महातपाः ॥
विद्याधरा महात्मानो गरुडश्च त्वया सह ॥ 21 ॥
1.179.m: The siddhas of abundant ascetic power, and whatever other [sages] of great austerities, / the noble vidyādharas, and Garuḍa along with you, 21

1.179.s:
ādityaparamā hyete ādityārādhane ratāḥ ..
siddhiṃ te saṃprayacchaṃtu āśīrvādaparāyaṇāḥ .. 22 ..
1.179.d:
आदित्यपरमा ह्येते आदित्याराधने रताः ॥
सिद्धिं ते संप्रयच्छंतु आशीर्वादपरायणाः ॥ 22 ॥
1.179.m: Devoted to Āditya, intent upon worshipping Āditya, / intent on blessings, may they bestow accomplishment upon you. 22

1.179.s:
namucirdaityarājedraḥ śaṃkukarṇo mahābalaḥ ..
mahānātho'tha vikhyāto daityaḥ paramavīryavān .. 23 ..
1.179.d:
नमुचिर्दैत्यराजेद्रः शंकुकर्णो महाबलः ॥
महानाथोऽथ विख्यातो दैत्यः परमवीर्यवान् ॥ 23 ॥
1.179.m: Namuci, the lord among kings of daityas, Śaṅkukarṇa of great strength, / and the renowned Mahānātha, a daitya of supreme prowess, 23

1.179.s:
grahādhipasya devasya nityaṃ pūjāparāyaṇāḥ ..
balaṃ vīryaṃ ca te ṛddhimārogyaṃ ca bruvaṃtu te ..24..
1.179.d:
ग्रहाधिपस्य देवस्य नित्यं पूजापरायणाः ॥
बलं वीर्यं च ते ऋद्धिमारोग्यं च ब्रुवंतु ते ॥24॥
1.179.m: Ever devoted to the worship of the god who is the lord of planets— / may they declare strength, prowess, prosperity, and health for you. 24

1.179.s:
mahāḍhyo yo hayagrīvaḥ prahlādaḥ prabhayānvitaḥ ..
tānaikāgnimukho daityaḥ kālanemirmahābalaḥ .. 25 ..
1.179.d:
महाढ्यो यो हयग्रीवः प्रह्लादः प्रभयान्वितः ॥
तानैकाग्निमुखो दैत्यः कालनेमिर्महाबलः ॥ 25 ॥
1.179.m: The very wealthy Hayagrīva, Prahlāda endowed with lustre, / the daitya Tānaikāgnimukha, and Kālanemi of great strength, 25

1.179.s:
ete daityā mahātmānaḥ sūryabhāvena bhāvitāḥ ...
tuṣṭiṃ balaṃ tathā''rogyaṃ prayacchaṃtu surārayaḥ .. 26 ..
1.179.d:
एते दैत्या महात्मानः सूर्यभावेन भाविताः ॥।
तुष्टिं बलं तथा'ऽरोग्यं प्रयच्छंतु सुरारयः ॥ 26 ॥
1.179.m: These noble daityas, suffused with devotion to the sun, / may these enemies of the gods grant contentment, strength, and health. 26

1.179.s:
vairocano hiraṇyākṣasturvasuśca sulocanaḥ ..
mucakuṃdo mukuṃdaśca daityo raivatakastathā ..27..
1.179.d:
वैरोचनो हिरण्याक्षस्तुर्वसुश्च सुलोचनः ॥
मुचकुंदो मुकुंदश्च दैत्यो रैवतकस्तथा ॥27॥
1.179.m: Virocana's son [Bali], Hiraṇyākṣa, Turvasu, Sulocana, / Mucukunda, Mukunda, and the daitya Raivataka, 27

1.179.s:
bhāvena parameṇemaṃ yajaṃte satataṃ ravim ..
satataṃ ca śubhātmānaḥ puṣṭiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā .. 28 ..
1.179.d:
भावेन परमेणेमं यजंते सततं रविम् ॥
सततं च शुभात्मानः पुष्टिं कुर्वंतु ते सदा ॥ 28 ॥
1.179.m: Continuously worship this sun with supreme devotion; / may these auspicious-natured ones ever bring nourishment to you. 28

1.179.s:
daityapatayo mahābhāgā daityānāṃ kanyakāḥ śubhāḥ ..
kumārā ye ca daityānāṃ śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā .. 29 ..
1.179.d:
दैत्यपतयो महाभागा दैत्यानां कन्यकाः शुभाः ॥
कुमारा ये च दैत्यानां शांतिं कुर्वंतु ते सदा ॥ 29 ॥
1.179.m: The fortunate lords of the daityas, the auspicious daughters of the daityas, / and the young sons of the daityas, may they ever grant peace to you. 29

1.179.s:
āraktena śarīraṇa raktāṃtāyatalocanāḥ ..
mahābhāgāḥ kṛtāṭopāḥ śaṃkhādyāḥ kṛtalakṣaṇāḥ .. 1.179.30 ..
1.179.d:
आरक्तेन शरीरण रक्तांतायतलोचनाः ॥
महाभागाः कृताटोपाः शंखाद्याः कृतलक्षणाः ॥ 1.179.30 ॥
1.179.m: With reddish bodies, wide eyes with red corners, / glorious, displaying their hoods, Śaṅkha and the others, marked with auspicious signs; 30

1.179.s:
anaṃto nāgarājeṃdra ādityārādhane rataḥ ..
mahāpāpaviṣaṃ hatvā śāṃtimāśu karotu te .. 31 ..
1.179.d:
अनंतो नागराजेंद्र आदित्याराधने रतः ॥
महापापविषं हत्वा शांतिमाशु करोतु ते ॥ 31 ॥
1.179.m: Ananta, the foremost king among nāgas, devoted to the worship of Āditya, / having destroyed the poison of great sins, may he swiftly grant peace to you. 31

1.179.s:
atipītena dehena visphuradbhogasaṃpadā ..
tejasā cātidīptena kṛtasvastikalāṃchanaḥ .. 32 ..
1.179.d:
अतिपीतेन देहेन विस्फुरद्भोगसंपदा ॥
तेजसा चातिदीप्तेन कृतस्वस्तिकलांछनः ॥ 32 ॥
1.179.m: With an intensely yellow body, displaying an abundance of glittering hoods, / and with exceedingly brilliant splendour, bearing the mark of the svastika, 32

1.179.s:
nāgarāṭ takṣakaḥ śrīmānnāmakoṭyā samanvitaḥ ..
karotu te mahāśāṃtiṃ sarvadoṣaviṣāpahām .. 33 ..
1.179.d:
नागराट् तक्षकः श्रीमान्नामकोट्या समन्वितः ॥
करोतु ते महाशांतिं सर्वदोषविषापहाम् ॥ 33 ॥
1.179.m: May the glorious Takṣaka, king of nāgas, accompanied by millions of names, / bring about great peace for you, removing all afflictions and poisons. 33

1.179.s:
atikṛṣṇena varṇena sphuṭādhikaṭamastakaḥ ..
kaṃṭharekhātrayopeto ghoradaṃṣṭrāyudhodyataḥ .. 34 ..
1.179.d:
अतिकृष्णेन वर्णेन स्फुटाधिकटमस्तकः ॥
कंठरेखात्रयोपेतो घोरदंष्ट्रायुधोद्यतः ॥ 34 ॥
1.179.m: Intensely black in colour, with an expansive, prominent crest, / endowed with three lines on his neck, raising fierce fangs as weapons, 34

1.179.s:
karkoṭako mahānāgo viṣadarpabalānvitaḥ ..
viṣaśastrāgnisaṃtāpaṃ hatvā śāṃtiṃ karotu te .. 35 ..
1.179.d:
कर्कोटको महानागो विषदर्पबलान्वितः ॥
विषशस्त्राग्निसंतापं हत्वा शांतिं करोतु ते ॥ 35 ॥
1.179.m: May the great nāga Karkoṭaka, endowed with the strength and pride of poison, / having dispelled the torment of poison, weapons, and fire, grant peace to you. 35

1.179.s:
padmavarṇaḥ padmakāntiḥ phullapadmāyatekṣaṇaḥ ..
khyātaḥ padmo mahānāgo nityaṃ bhāskarapūjakaḥ .. 36 ..
1.179.d:
पद्मवर्णः पद्मकान्तिः फुल्लपद्मायतेक्षणः ॥
ख्यातः पद्मो महानागो नित्यं भास्करपूजकः ॥ 36 ॥
1.179.m: Lotus-coloured, having the lustre of a lotus, with eyes wide like blooming lotuses, / the famous great nāga Padma, who constantly worships the sun, 36

1.179.s:
sa te śāṃti śubhaṃ śīghramacalaṃ saṃprayacchatu ..
śyāmena dehabhāreṇa śrīmatkamalalocanaḥ .. 37 ..
1.179.d:
स ते शांति शुभं शीघ्रमचलं संप्रयच्छतु ॥
श्यामेन देहभारेण श्रीमत्कमललोचनः ॥ 37 ॥
1.179.m: May he quickly grant you peace, auspiciousness, and stability, / [he who has] beautiful lotus eyes and a massive, dark-hued body,

1.179.s:
viṣadarpabalonmatto grīvāyāṃ rekhayānvitaḥ ..
śaṃkhapālaśriyā dīptaḥ sūryapādābjapūjakaḥ .. 38...
mahāviṣaṃ garaśreṣṭhaṃ hatvā śāṃtiṃ karotu te ..
atigaureṇa dehena caṃdrārdhakṛtaśekharaḥ .. 39 ..
1.179.d:
विषदर्पबलोन्मत्तो ग्रीवायां रेखयान्वितः ॥
शंखपालश्रिया दीप्तः सूर्यपादाब्जपूजकः ॥ 38॥।
महाविषं गरश्रेष्ठं हत्वा शांतिं करोतु ते ॥
अतिगौरेण देहेन चंद्रार्धकृतशेखरः ॥ 39 ॥
1.179.m: Who is intoxicated with the pride and power of his venom, marked with lines on his neck, / radiant with the splendour of Śaṅkhapāla, worshipping the lotus feet of the sun! / Having destroyed great venom and the deadliest poison, may he bring you peace, / [he who has] an exceedingly fair body, crested with the crescent moon,

1.179.s:
dīpabhāge kṛtāṭopaśubhalakṣaṇalakṣitaḥ ..
kuliko nāma nāgendro nityaṃ sūryaparāyaṇaḥ ..
apahṛtya viṣaṃ ghoraṃ karotu tava śāṃtikam .. 1.179.40 ..
1.179.d:
दीपभागे कृताटोपशुभलक्षणलक्षितः ॥
कुलिको नाम नागेन्द्रो नित्यं सूर्यपरायणः ॥
अपहृत्य विषं घोरं करोतु तव शांतिकम् ॥ 1.179.40 ॥
1.179.m: Puffed with pride in his luminous form, distinguished by auspicious marks, / the serpent king named Kulika, ever devoted to the sun! / Having taken away terrible poison, may he bring about peace for you.

1.179.s:
aṃtarikṣe ca ye nāgā ye nāgāḥ svargasaṃsthitāḥ ..
girikaṃdaradurgeṣu ye nāgā bhuvi saṃsthitāḥ .. 41 ..
1.179.d:
अंतरिक्षे च ये नागा ये नागाः स्वर्गसंस्थिताः ॥
गिरिकंदरदुर्गेषु ये नागा भुवि संस्थिताः ॥ 41 ॥
1.179.m: And whatever serpents dwell in the intermediate space, whatever serpents reside in heaven, / whatever serpents dwell on earth in mountain caves and fastnesses,

1.179.s:
pātāle ye sthitā nāgāḥ sarve yatra samāhitāḥ ..
sūryapādā rcanāsaktāḥ śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā ..42..
1.179.d:
पाताले ये स्थिता नागाः सर्वे यत्र समाहिताः ॥
सूर्यपादा र्चनासक्ताः शांतिं कुर्वंतु ते सदा ॥42॥
1.179.m: Whatever serpents dwell in the netherworld, all concentrated together, / intent on worshipping the sun's feet—may they ever bring you peace!

1.179.s:
nāginyo nāgakanyāśca tathā nāgakumārakāḥ ..
sūryabhaktāḥ sumanasaḥ śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā ..43..
1.179.d:
नागिन्यो नागकन्याश्च तथा नागकुमारकाः ॥
सूर्यभक्ताः सुमनसः शांतिं कुर्वंतु ते सदा ॥43॥
1.179.m: May the female serpents, the serpent maidens, and likewise the serpent youths, / devoted to the sun and pure of mind, ever bring you peace!

1.179.s:
ya idaṃ nāmasaṃsthānaṃ kīrtayecchṛṇuyāttathā ..
na taṃ sarpā vihiṃsati na viṣaṃ kramate sadā .. 44 ..
1.179.d:
य इदं नामसंस्थानं कीर्तयेच्छृणुयात्तथा ॥
न तं सर्पा विहिंसति न विषं क्रमते सदा ॥ 44 ॥
1.179.m: Whoever recites or hears this catalogue of names, / serpents never harm him, nor does poison ever overtake him.

1.179.s:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe saura dharmavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonāśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..179.. ..
śāntikavarṇanam
1.179.d:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे ब्राह्मे पर्वणि सप्तमीकल्पे सौर धर्मवर्णनं नामैकोनाशीत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ॥179॥ ॥
शान्तिकवर्णनम्
1.179.m:
Thus ends the one hundred and seventy-ninth chapter, entitled "Description of the Solar Dharma," in the Saptamīkalpa of the Brāhmaparvan in the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
Description of the Peace-Bestowing Rite

1.180.s:
gaṃgā puṇyā mahādevī yamunā narmadā nadī ..
gautamī cāpi kāverī varuṇā devikā tathā ..1..
1.180.d:
गंगा पुण्या महादेवी यमुना नर्मदा नदी ॥
गौतमी चापि कावेरी वरुणा देविका तथा ॥1॥
1.180.m: The sacred, great goddess Gaṅgā, the river Yamunā and Narmadā, / Gautamī as well, Kāverī, Varuṇā, and likewise Devikā—

1.180.s:
sarvagrahapatiṃ devaṃ lokeśaṃ lokanāyakam ..
pūjayaṃti sadā nadyaḥ sūryasadbhāvabhāvitāḥ ..
śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te nityaṃ sūryadhyānaikamānasāḥ ..2..
1.180.d:
सर्वग्रहपतिं देवं लोकेशं लोकनायकम् ॥
पूजयंति सदा नद्यः सूर्यसद्भावभाविताः ॥
शांतिं कुर्वंतु ते नित्यं सूर्यध्यानैकमानसाः ॥2॥
1.180.m: These rivers, imbued with true devotion to the sun, ever worship / the lord of all planets, the deity, ruler of the worlds, leader of the worlds. / With minds solely intent on meditation upon the sun, may they constantly bring you peace!

1.180.s:
niraṃjanā nāma nadī śoṇaścāpi mahānadaḥ ..
maṃdākinī ca paramā tathā sannihitā śubhā..3..
1.180.d:
निरंजना नाम नदी शोणश्चापि महानदः ॥
मंदाकिनी च परमा तथा सन्निहिता शुभा॥3॥
1.180.m: The river named Nirañjanā and the great river Śoṇa, / the supreme Mandākinī, and likewise the auspicious Sannihitā—

1.180.s:
etāścānyāśca bahavo bhuvi divyaṃtarikṣake..
sūryārcanaratā nadyaḥ kurvaṃtu tava śāṃtikam ..4..
1.180.d:
एताश्चान्याश्च बहवो भुवि दिव्यंतरिक्षके॥
सूर्यार्चनरता नद्यः कुर्वंतु तव शांतिकम् ॥4॥
1.180.m: These and many other rivers on earth, in heaven, and in the intermediate space, / intent on worshipping the sun, may they bring about peace for you!

1.180.s:
mahāvaiśravaṇo devo yakṣarājo maharṣikaḥ ..
yakṣakoṭiparīvāro yakṣasaṃkhyeyasaṃyutaḥ ..5..
1.180.d:
महावैश्रवणो देवो यक्षराजो महर्षिकः ॥
यक्षकोटिपरीवारो यक्षसंख्येयसंयुतः ॥5॥
1.180.m: The great god Vaiśravaṇa, king of the yakṣas, of great power, / surrounded by crores of yakṣas and accompanied by countless yakṣas,

1.180.s:
mahāvibhavasaṃpannaḥ sūryapādārcane rataḥ ..
sūryadhyānaikaparamaḥ sūryabhāvena bhāvitaḥ..6..
1.180.d:
महाविभवसंपन्नः सूर्यपादार्चने रतः ॥
सूर्यध्यानैकपरमः सूर्यभावेन भावितः॥6॥
1.180.m: Endowed with immense power, devoted to worshipping the sun's feet, / wholly dedicated to single-minded meditation upon the sun, imbued with devotion to the sun—

1.180.s:
śāṃtiṃ karotu te prītaḥ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇaḥ ..
māṇibhadro mahāyakṣo maṇiratnavibhūṣitaḥ ..7..
1.180.d:
शांतिं करोतु ते प्रीतः पद्मपत्रायतेक्षणः ॥
माणिभद्रो महायक्षो मणिरत्नविभूषितः ॥7॥
1.180.m: Pleasantly disposed, with eyes long as lotus petals, may he bring you peace! / The great yakṣa Māṇibhadra, adorned with jewels and gems,

1.180.s:
manohareṇa hāreṇa kaṃṭhalagnena rājate ..
yakṣiṇīyakṣakanyābhiḥ parivāritavigrahaḥ ..
sūryārcanasamāsaktaḥ karotu tava śāṃtikam..8..
1.180.d:
मनोहरेण हारेण कंठलग्नेन राजते ॥
यक्षिणीयक्षकन्याभिः परिवारितविग्रहः ॥
सूर्यार्चनसमासक्तः करोतु तव शांतिकम्॥8॥
1.180.m: Shines with a captivating necklace clasped about his throat, / his person surrounded by yakṣiṇīs and yakṣa maidens. / Wholly absorbed in worshipping the sun, may he bring about peace for you!

1.180.s:
suciro nāma yakṣeṃdro maṇikuḍala bhūṣitaḥ ..
lalāṭe hemapaṭalaprabaddhena virājate .. 9 ..
1.180.d:
सुचिरो नाम यक्षेंद्रो मणिकुडल भूषितः ॥
ललाटे हेमपटलप्रबद्धेन विराजते ॥ 9 ॥
1.180.m: The yakṣa lord named Sucira, adorned with jewelled earrings, / shines with a golden diadem bound upon his forehead.

1.180.s:
bahuyakṣasamākīrṇo yakṣairnamitavigrahaḥ ..
sūryapūjāparo yuktaḥ karotu tava śāṃtikam .. 1.180.10...
1.180.d:
बहुयक्षसमाकीर्णो यक्षैर्नमितविग्रहः ॥
सूर्यपूजापरो युक्तः करोतु तव शांतिकम् ॥ 1.180.10॥।
1.180.m: Surrounded by many yakṣas, his body bowed to by yakṣas, / devoted to worshipping the sun and disciplined, may he bring about peace for you!

1.180.s:
pāṃciko nāma yakṣeṃdraḥ kaṃṭhābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ ..
kukkuṭena vicitreṇa bahuratnānvitena tu .. 11 ..
1.180.d:
पांचिको नाम यक्षेंद्रः कंठाभरणभूषितः ॥
कुक्कुटेन विचित्रेण बहुरत्नान्वितेन तु ॥ 11 ॥
1.180.m: The yakṣa lord named Pāñcika, adorned with neck ornaments, / along with a wondrous rooster endowed with many jewels,

1.180.s:
yakṣavṛndasamākīrṇo yakṣakoṭisamanvitaḥ ..
sūryārcanakaraḥ śrīmānkarotu tava śāṃtikam .. 12 ..
1.180.d:
यक्षवृन्दसमाकीर्णो यक्षकोटिसमन्वितः ॥
सूर्यार्चनकरः श्रीमान्करोतु तव शांतिकम् ॥ 12 ॥
1.180.m: Thronged with hosts of yakṣas, accompanied by crores of yakṣas, / who performs the worship of the sun, glorious, may he bring about peace for you!

1.180.s:
dhṛtarāṣṭro mahātejā nānāyakṣādhipaḥ khaga ..
divyapaṭṭaḥ śuklacchatro maṇikāṃcanabhūṣitaḥ .. 13 ..
1.180.d:
धृतराष्ट्रो महातेजा नानायक्षाधिपः खग ॥
दिव्यपट्टः शुक्लच्छत्रो मणिकांचनभूषितः ॥ 13 ॥
1.180.m: Dhṛtarāṣṭra, endowed with great splendour, lord of diverse yakṣas, O bird, / with a celestial silk band and a white royal parasol, adorned with gems and gold,

1.180.s:
sūryabhaktaḥ sūryarataḥ sūryapūjāparāyaṇaḥ ..
sūryaprasādasaṃpannaḥ karotu tava śāṃtikam .. 14 ..
1.180.d:
सूर्यभक्तः सूर्यरतः सूर्यपूजापरायणः ॥
सूर्यप्रसादसंपन्नः करोतु तव शांतिकम् ॥ 14 ॥
1.180.m: Devoted to the sun, delighting in the sun, dedicated to the worship of the sun, / endowed with the sun's grace, may he bring about peace for you!

1.180.s:
virūpākṣaśca yakṣeṃdraḥ śvetavāsā mahādyutiḥ ..
nānākāṃcanamālābhirupaśobhitakaṃdharaḥ .. 15 ..
1.180.d:
विरूपाक्षश्च यक्षेंद्रः श्वेतवासा महाद्युतिः ॥
नानाकांचनमालाभिरुपशोभितकंधरः ॥ 15 ॥
1.180.m: And the yakṣa lord Virūpākṣa, clad in white, of great lustre, / his neck adorned with garlands of various kinds of gold,

1.180.s:
sūryapūjāparo bhaktaḥ kaṃjākṣaḥ kaṃjasannibhaḥ ..
tejasādityasaṃkāśaḥ karotu tava śāṃtikam .. 16 ..
1.180.d:
सूर्यपूजापरो भक्तः कंजाक्षः कंजसन्निभः ॥
तेजसादित्यसंकाशः करोतु तव शांतिकम् ॥ 16 ॥
1.180.m: Devoted to the worship of the sun, faithful, lotus-eyed, resembling a lotus, / equal in brilliance to the sun, may he bring about peace for you!

1.180.s:
aṃtīrakṣagatā yakṣā ye yakṣāḥ svargagāminaḥ ..
nānārūpadharā yakṣāḥ sūryabhaktā dṛḍhavratāḥ .. 17 ..
1.180.d:
अंतीरक्षगता यक्षा ये यक्षाः स्वर्गगामिनः ॥
नानारूपधरा यक्षाः सूर्यभक्ता दृढव्रताः ॥ 17 ॥
1.180.m: The yakṣas stationed in the intermediate space, the yakṣas who go to heaven, / the yakṣas who assume diverse forms, devoted to the sun and firm in their vows,

1.180.s:
tadbhaktāstadgamanasaḥ sūryapūjāsamutsukāḥ ..
śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te hṛṣṭāḥ śāṃtāḥ śāṃtiparāyaṇāḥ .. 18 ..
1.180.d:
तद्भक्तास्तद्गमनसः सूर्यपूजासमुत्सुकाः ॥
शांतिं कुर्वंतु ते हृष्टाः शांताः शांतिपरायणाः ॥ 18 ॥
1.180.m: Devoted to him, their minds fixed on him, eager to worship the sun, / delighted, tranquil, dedicated to peace, may they bring you peace!

1.180.s:
yakṣiṇyo vividhākārāstathā yakṣakumārakāḥ ..
yakṣakanyā mahābhāgāḥ sūryārādhanatatparāḥ .. 19 ..
1.180.d:
यक्षिण्यो विविधाकारास्तथा यक्षकुमारकाः ॥
यक्षकन्या महाभागाः सूर्याराधनतत्पराः ॥ 19 ॥
1.180.m: May the yakṣiṇīs of diverse forms, and likewise the yakṣa youths, / the illustrious yakṣa maidens, intent on worshipping the sun,

1.180.s:
śāṃtiṃ svastyayanaṃ kṣemaṃ balaṃ kalyāṇamuttamam ..
siddhiṃ cāśu prayacchaṃtu nityaṃ ca susamāhitāḥ .. 1.180.20 ..
1.180.d:
शांतिं स्वस्त्ययनं क्षेमं बलं कल्याणमुत्तमम् ॥
सिद्धिं चाशु प्रयच्छंतु नित्यं च सुसमाहिताः ॥ 1.180.20 ॥
1.180.m: Quickly grant you peace, blessing, security, strength, supreme welfare, / and accomplishment, ever being well concentrated!

1.180.s:
parvatāḥ sarvataḥ sarve vṛkṣāścaiva maharddhikāḥ ..
sūryabhaktāḥ sadā sarve śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā .. 21 ..
1.180.d:
पर्वताः सर्वतः सर्वे वृक्षाश्चैव महर्द्धिकाः ॥
सूर्यभक्ताः सदा सर्वे शांतिं कुर्वंतु ते सदा ॥ 21 ॥
1.180.m: May all the mountains everywhere, and all the trees of great power, / all being ever devoted to the sun, constantly bring you peace!

1.180.s:
sāgarāḥ sarvataḥ sarve gṛhāraṇyāni kṛtsnaśaḥ ..
sūryasyārādhanaparāḥ kurvaṃtu tava śāṃtikam .. 22 ..
1.180.d:
सागराः सर्वतः सर्वे गृहारण्यानि कृत्स्नशः ॥
सूर्यस्याराधनपराः कुर्वंतु तव शांतिकम् ॥ 22 ॥
1.180.m: May all the oceans everywhere, the dwellings and the forests in their entirety, / intent upon worshipping the sun, bring about peace for you!

1.180.s:
rākṣasāḥ sarvataḥ sarve ghorarūpā mahābalāḥ ..
sthalajā rākṣasā ye tu aṃtarikṣagatāśca ye ..23..
1.180.d:
राक्षसाः सर्वतः सर्वे घोररूपा महाबलाः ॥
स्थलजा राक्षसा ये तु अंतरिक्षगताश्च ये ॥23॥
1.180.m: May all the rākṣasas everywhere, of terrible forms and great strength— / those rākṣasas born of the earth and those who move through the intermediate space,

1.180.s:
pātāle rākṣasā ye tu nityaṃ sūryārcane ratāḥ ..
śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sarve tejasā nityadīpitāḥ .. 24 ..
1.180.d:
पाताले राक्षसा ये तु नित्यं सूर्यार्चने रताः ॥
शांतिं कुर्वंतु ते सर्वे तेजसा नित्यदीपिताः ॥ 24 ॥
1.180.m: And those rākṣasas in the netherworld, who are ever intent on worshipping the sun, / all ever illumined by splendour, bring you peace!

1.180.s:
pretāḥ pretagaṇāḥ sarve ye pretāḥ sarvatomukhāḥ ..
atidīptāśca ye pretā ye pretā rudhirāśanāḥ ..25...
1.180.d:
प्रेताः प्रेतगणाः सर्वे ये प्रेताः सर्वतोमुखाः ॥
अतिदीप्ताश्च ये प्रेता ये प्रेता रुधिराशनाः ॥25॥।
1.180.m: All the pretas and troops of pretas, those pretas whose faces look in all directions, / those pretas who are exceedingly blazing, and those pretas who feed on blood,

1.180.s:
aṃtarikṣe ca ye pretāstathā ye svargavāsinaḥ ..
pātāle bhūtale vāpi ye pretāḥ kāmarūpiṇaḥ .. 26 ..
1.180.d:
अंतरिक्षे च ये प्रेतास्तथा ये स्वर्गवासिनः ॥
पाताले भूतले वापि ये प्रेताः कामरूपिणः ॥ 26 ॥
1.180.m: Those pretas in the intermediate space and likewise those dwelling in heaven, / or those pretas in the netherworld or on the earth's surface who change their form at will,

1.180.s:
ekacakro ratho yasya yastu devo vṛṣadhvajaḥ ..
tejasā tasya devasya śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā ..27..
1.180.d:
एकचक्रो रथो यस्य यस्तु देवो वृषध्वजः ॥
तेजसा तस्य देवस्य शांतिं कुर्वंतु ते सदा ॥27॥
1.180.m: Through the splendour of that deity whose chariot has a single wheel / and who bears the bull on his banner, may they ever bring you peace!

1.180.s:
ye piśācā mahāvīryā vṛddhimaṃto mahābalāḥ ..
nānārūpadharāḥ sarve sarve ca guṇavattarāḥ ..28...
1.180.d:
ये पिशाचा महावीर्या वृद्धिमंतो महाबलाः ॥
नानारूपधराः सर्वे सर्वे च गुणवत्तराः ॥28॥।
1.180.m: Those piśācas of great prowess, prosperous and mighty, / all assuming diverse forms, and all endowed with superior qualities,

1.180.s:
aṃtarikṣe piśācā ye svarge ye ca mahābalāḥ ..
pātāle bhūtale ye ca bahurūpā manojavāḥ .. 29 ..
1.180.d:
अंतरिक्षे पिशाचा ये स्वर्गे ये च महाबलाः ॥
पाताले भूतले ये च बहुरूपा मनोजवाः ॥ 29 ॥
1.180.m: Those piśācas in the intermediate space, those of great might in heaven, / and those in the netherworld and on the earth's surface, manifold in form and swift as thought,

1.180.s:
yasyāhaṃ sārathirvīra yasya tvaṃ turagaḥ sadā ..
tejasā tasya devasya śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te'ñjasā .. 1.180.30 ..
1.180.d:
यस्याहं सारथिर्वीर यस्य त्वं तुरगः सदा ॥
तेजसा तस्य देवस्य शांतिं कुर्वंतु तेऽञ्जसा ॥ 1.180.30 ॥
1.180.m: Through the splendour of that deity whose charioteer I am, O hero, / and whose steed you ever are, may they swiftly bring you peace!

1.180.s:
apasmāragrahāḥ sarve sarve cāpi jvaragrahāḥ ..
ye ca svargasthitāḥ sarve bhūmigā ye grahottamāḥ .. .. 31 ..
1.180.d:
अपस्मारग्रहाः सर्वे सर्वे चापि ज्वरग्रहाः ॥
ये च स्वर्गस्थिताः सर्वे भूमिगा ये ग्रहोत्तमाः ॥ ॥ 31 ॥
1.180.m: All the seizure-demons of epilepsy and all the seizure-demons of fever, / all those residing in heaven and the foremost seizure-demons roaming on earth,

1.180.s:
pātāle tu grahā ye ca ye grahāḥ sarvato gatāḥ ..
dakṣiṇe kiraṇe yasya sūryasya ca sthito hariḥ .. 32 ..
1.180.d:
पाताले तु ग्रहा ये च ये ग्रहाः सर्वतो गताः ॥
दक्षिणे किरणे यस्य सूर्यस्य च स्थितो हरिः ॥ 32 ॥
1.180.m: And those seizure-demons in the netherworld, those seizure-demons who go everywhere— / upon whose right ray, the sun's, Hari is stationed,

1.180.s:
haro yasya sadā vāme lalāṭe kaṃjajaḥ sthitaḥ ..
tejasā tasya devasya śāṃtiṃ kurvaṃtu te sadā .. 33 ..
1.180.d:
हरो यस्य सदा वामे ललाटे कंजजः स्थितः ॥
तेजसा तस्य देवस्य शांतिं कुर्वंतु ते सदा ॥ 33 ॥
1.180.m: On whose left Hara ever stands, and upon whose forehead the lotus-born [Brahmā] is stationed— / through the splendour of that deity, may they ever bring you peace!

1.180.s:
iti devādayaḥ sarve sūryayajñavidhāyinaḥ ..
kurvaṃtu jagataḥ śāṃtiṃ sūryabhakteṣu sarvadā .. 34 ..
1.180.d:
इति देवादयः सर्वे सूर्ययज्ञविधायिनः ॥
कुर्वंतु जगतः शांतिं सूर्यभक्तेषु सर्वदा ॥ 34 ॥
1.180.m: Thus may all beings, beginning with the gods, who perform the sacrifice to the sun, / ever bring peace to the world among the devotees of the sun!

1.180.s:
jayaḥ sūryāya devāya tamohaṃtre vivasvate ..
jayapradāya sūryāya bhāskarāya namostu te .. 35 ..
1.180.d:
जयः सूर्याय देवाय तमोहंत्रे विवस्वते ॥
जयप्रदाय सूर्याय भास्कराय नमोस्तु ते ॥ 35 ॥
1.180.m: Victory to the sun, to the deity, to Vivasvat who destroys darkness! / To the sun who grants victory, to the illuminator, homage be to you!

1.180.s:
grahottamāya devāya jayaḥ kalyāṇakāriṇe ..
jayaḥ padmavikāśāya budharūpāya te namaḥ .. 36 ..
1.180.d:
ग्रहोत्तमाय देवाय जयः कल्याणकारिणे ॥
जयः पद्मविकाशाय बुधरूपाय ते नमः ॥ 36 ॥
1.180.m: Victory to the best of planets, the god who causes auspiciousness! / Victory to him who causes the lotus to blossom, who has the form of Budha; reverence to you!

1.180.s:
jayaḥ dīptividhānāya jayaḥ śāṃtividhāyine ..
tamoghnāya jayāyaiva ajitāya namonamaḥ ..37..
1.180.d:
जयः दीप्तिविधानाय जयः शांतिविधायिने ॥
तमोघ्नाय जयायैव अजिताय नमोनमः ॥37॥
1.180.m: Victory to him who ordains radiance, victory to him who ordains peace! / Reverence, reverence to the dispeller of darkness, to Victory, to the Unvanquished!

1.180.s:
jayārka jayadīptīśa sahasrakiraṇojjvala ..
jaya nirmitalokastvamajitāya namonamaḥ .. 38 ..
1.180.d:
जयार्क जयदीप्तीश सहस्रकिरणोज्ज्वल ॥
जय निर्मितलोकस्त्वमजिताय नमोनमः ॥ 38 ॥
1.180.m: Victory, O Sun! Victory, O Lord of Radiance, blazing with a thousand rays! / Victory, you by whom the world is fashioned; reverence, reverence to the Unvanquished!

1.180.s:
gāyatrīdeharūpāya sāvitrīdayitāya ca ..
dharādharāya sūryāya mārtaṃḍāya namonamaḥ .. 39 ..
1.180.d:
गायत्रीदेहरूपाय सावित्रीदयिताय च ॥
धराधराय सूर्याय मार्तंडाय नमोनमः ॥ 39 ॥
1.180.m: To him whose body is the form of the Gāyatrī, and who is the beloved of Sāvitrī, / to the supporter of the earth, to the Sun, to Mārtaṇḍa, reverence, reverence!

1.180.s:
sumaṃturuvāca ..
evaṃ hi kurvataḥ śāṃtimaruṇasya mahīpate ..
śreyase vainateyasya garuḍasya mahātmanaḥ .. 1.180.40 ..
1.180.d:
सुमंतुरुवाच ॥
एवं हि कुर्वतः शांतिमरुणस्य महीपते ॥
श्रेयसे वैनतेयस्य गरुडस्य महात्मनः ॥ 1.180.40 ॥
1.180.m: Sumantu said: / As Aruṇa was thus performing the pacification rite, O king, / for the welfare of the son of Vinatā, the noble Garuḍa, 1.180.40

1.180.s:
etasminneva kāle tu suparṇaḥ patravānabhūt ..
tejasā budhasaṃkāśo valena hariṇā samaḥ .. 41 ..
1.180.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु सुपर्णः पत्रवानभूत् ॥
तेजसा बुधसंकाशो वलेन हरिणा समः ॥ 41 ॥
1.180.m: at that very time Suparṇa became possessed of wings, / resembling Budha in brilliance and equal to Hari in strength.

1.180.s:
saṃpūrṇāvayavo rājanyathāpūrvaṃ tathābhavat ..
prasādāddevadevasya bhāskarasya mahātmanaḥ .. 42 ..
1.180.d:
संपूर्णावयवो राजन्यथापूर्वं तथाभवत् ॥
प्रसादाद्देवदेवस्य भास्करस्य महात्मनः ॥ 42 ॥
1.180.m: With all his limbs complete, O king, he became just as before, / through the grace of the god of gods, the noble Bhāskara.

1.180.s:
evamanye'pi rājeṃdra mānavā ye ca rogiṇaḥ ..
asmitkṛte'gnikārye tu virujāste bhavaṃti hi ..
tasmādyatnena kartavyamagnikāryaṃ vidhānataḥ .. 43 ..
1.180.d:
एवमन्येऽपि राजेंद्र मानवा ये च रोगिणः ॥
अस्मित्कृतेऽग्निकार्ये तु विरुजास्ते भवंति हि ॥
तस्माद्यत्नेन कर्तव्यमग्निकार्यं विधानतः ॥ 43 ॥
1.180.m: In this way other mortal men also, who are sick, O king of kings, / when this fire ritual is performed, indeed become free of disease; / therefore this fire ritual must be performed diligently according to rule.

1.180.s:
karaṇīyaṃ ca rājeṃdra mānavaiśca prarogibhiḥ ..
asminkṛte agnikāye virujāste bhavaṃti hi.. 44 ..
1.180.d:
करणीयं च राजेंद्र मानवैश्च प्ररोगिभिः ॥
अस्मिन्कृते अग्निकाये विरुजास्ते भवंति हि॥ 44 ॥
1.180.m: It should also be performed, O king of kings, by men who are deeply afflicted by disease; / when this fire rite is performed, they indeed become free of disease.

1.180.s:
graho paghāte durbhikṣa utpāteṣu ca kṛtsnaśaḥ ..
avarṣamāṇe parjanye lakṣahomasamanvitaḥ .. 45 ..
1.180.d:
ग्रहो पघाते दुर्भिक्ष उत्पातेषु च कृत्स्नशः ॥
अवर्षमाणे पर्जन्ये लक्षहोमसमन्वितः ॥ 45 ॥
1.180.m: During affliction by evil planets, famine, and in all portents, / and when the rain god does not rain, accompanied by a hundred thousand oblations,

1.180.s:
pūjayitvā prasūktaṃ tu dhyātvā vīraṃ prayatnataḥ ..
vāruṇaiśca tathā sūktairhomaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ .. 46 ..
1.180.d:
पूजयित्वा प्रसूक्तं तु ध्यात्वा वीरं प्रयत्नतः ॥
वारुणैश्च तथा सूक्तैर्होमं कुर्याद्विचक्षणः ॥ 46 ॥
1.180.m: having worshipped well with hymns, and having meditated diligently on the Hero, / the wise man should offer oblations with hymns to Varuṇa,

1.180.s:
cetasā suprasannena sarpiṣā madhunā saha ..
tilairyavaiśca sahitaiḥ pāyasaṃ madhunā tathā .. 47 ..
1.180.d:
चेतसा सुप्रसन्नेन सर्पिषा मधुना सह ॥
तिलैर्यवैश्च सहितैः पायसं मधुना तथा ॥ 47 ॥
1.180.m: with a serene mind, together with clarified butter and honey, / accompanied by sesame and barley, and milk-rice with honey as well.

1.180.s:
idaṃ ca śāṃtikaṃ kuryādbaliṃ dayātprayatnataḥ ..
evaṃ kṛte śriyaṃ devā varṣaṃte kāmanā nṛṇām .. 48 ..
1.180.d:
इदं च शांतिकं कुर्याद्बलिं दयात्प्रयत्नतः ॥
एवं कृते श्रियं देवा वर्षंते कामना नृणाम् ॥ 48 ॥
1.180.m: And he should perform this pacification rite and diligently make an offering; / when this is done, the gods shower the desired wealth of men.

1.180.s:
ityevaṃ śāṃtikādhyāyaṃ yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādapi ..
vidhinā sarvalokastu dhyāyamāno divākaram.. 49 ..
1.180.d:
इत्येवं शांतिकाध्यायं यः पठेच्छृणुयादपि ॥
विधिना सर्वलोकस्तु ध्यायमानो दिवाकरम्॥ 49 ॥
1.180.m: Whoever recites or even listens to this pacification chapter in this manner, / according to rule, the entire world meditating upon the maker of day,

1.180.s:
sa vijitya raṇe śatruṃ mānaṃ ca paramaṃ labhet ..
akṣayaṃ modate kālamatiraskṛtaśāsanaḥ .. 1.180.50 ..
1.180.d:
स विजित्य रणे शत्रुं मानं च परमं लभेत् ॥
अक्षयं मोदते कालमतिरस्कृतशासनः ॥ 1.180.50 ॥
1.180.m: he, having conquered his enemy in battle, obtains supreme honour; / he rejoices for imperishable time, his command never transgressed. 1.180.50

1.180.s:
vyādhibhirnābhibhūyeta putrapautraiḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ ..
bhavedādityasadṛśastejasā prabhayā tathā .. 51 ..
1.180.d:
व्याधिभिर्नाभिभूयेत पुत्रपौत्रैः प्रतिष्ठितः ॥
भवेदादित्यसदृशस्तेजसा प्रभया तथा ॥ 51 ॥
1.180.m: He would not be overcome by diseases, established with sons and grandsons; / he would become like the sun in brilliance and in radiance.

1.180.s:
yānuddiśya paṭhedvīra vācako mānavo bhuvi..
na pīḍyate ca tai rogairvātapittakaphātmakaiḥ .. 52 ..
1.180.d:
यानुद्दिश्य पठेद्वीर वाचको मानवो भुवि॥
न पीड्यते च तै रोगैर्वातपित्तकफात्मकैः ॥ 52 ॥
1.180.m: Intending whomsoever the human reciter recites it on earth, O hero, / that person is not tormented by diseases arising from wind, bile, and phlegm.

1.180.s:
nākāle maraṇaṃ tasya na sarpaiścāpi daśyate ..
na viṣaṃ kramate dehe na jaḍāṃdhyaṃ na mūkatā .. 53 ..
1.180.d:
नाकाले मरणं तस्य न सर्पैश्चापि दश्यते ॥
न विषं क्रमते देहे न जडांध्यं न मूकता ॥ 53 ॥
1.180.m: There is no untimely death for him, nor is he bitten by serpents; / poison does not take effect in his body, nor is there dullness, blindness, or muteness.

1.180.s:
na cotpatti bhayaṃ tasya nābhicārakajaṃ bhavet ..
ye rogā ye mahotpātā ye'hayaśca mahāviṣāḥ ..
te sarve praśamaṃ yāṃti śravaṇādasya bhārata...54 ..
1.180.d:
न चोत्पत्ति भयं तस्य नाभिचारकजं भवेत् ॥
ये रोगा ये महोत्पाता येऽहयश्च महाविषाः ॥
ते सर्वे प्रशमं यांति श्रवणादस्य भारत॥.54 ॥
1.180.m: And he has no fear of misfortunes, nor any arising from sorcery; / whatever diseases, whatever great portents, and whatever serpents of terrible venom there are, / they all go to complete cessation from hearing this, O descendant of Bharata.

1.180.s:
yatpuṇyaṃ sarva tīrthānāṃ gaṃgādīnāṃ viśeṣataḥ ..
tatpuṇyaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ prāpnoti śravaṇādibhiḥ .. 55 ..
1.180.d:
यत्पुण्यं सर्व तीर्थानां गंगादीनां विशेषतः ॥
तत्पुण्यं कोटिगुणितं प्राप्नोति श्रवणादिभिः ॥ 55 ॥
1.180.m: Whatever religious merit belongs to all holy places, especially the Gaṅgā and others, / he attains that merit multiplied ten-millionfold by hearing and the rest.

1.180.s:
daśānāṃ rājasūyānāmanyeṣāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ..
jīvedvarṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ .. 56 ..
1.180.d:
दशानां राजसूयानामन्येषां च विशेषतः ॥
जीवेद्वर्षशतं साग्रं सर्वव्याधिविवर्जितः ॥ 56 ॥
1.180.m: And especially [the merit] of ten Rājasūya sacrifices; / he would live a full hundred years, freed from all diseases.

1.180.s:
goghnaścaiva kṛtaghnaśca brahmahā gurutalpagaḥ ..
śaraṇāgatadīnārtamitraviśrabhaghātakaḥ .. 57 ...
1.180.d:
गोघ्नश्चैव कृतघ्नश्च ब्रह्महा गुरुतल्पगः ॥
शरणागतदीनार्तमित्रविश्रभघातकः ॥ 57 ॥।
1.180.m: A cow-killer, an ungrateful person, a slayer of a brāhmaṇa, one who violates the teacher's bed, / a slayer of one who has sought refuge, of the poor, the afflicted, or of one who has placed trust as a friend,

1.180.s:
duṣṭaḥ pāpasamācāraḥ pitṛhā mātṛhā tathā ..
śravaṇādasya pāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 58 ..
1.180.d:
दुष्टः पापसमाचारः पितृहा मातृहा तथा ॥
श्रवणादस्य पापेभ्यो मुच्यते नात्र संशयः ॥ 58 ॥
1.180.m: a wicked person, one of sinful conduct, a patricide, or a matricide— / from hearing this, he is freed from sins; there is no doubt about this.

1.180.s:
itihāsamimaṃ puṇyamagnikāryamanuttamam ..
na dadyātkasyacidvīra mūrkhasya kaluṣātmanaḥ .. 59 ..
1.180.d:
इतिहासमिमं पुण्यमग्निकार्यमनुत्तमम् ॥
न दद्यात्कस्यचिद्वीर मूर्खस्य कलुषात्मनः ॥ 59 ॥
1.180.m: This holy story and unequalled fire rite, / O hero, one should not give to any foolish, tainted person.

1.180.s:
sūryabhakte sadā deyaṃ sūryeṇa kathitaṃ purā ..
aruṇasya mahābāho garuḍasyāruṇena ca .. 1.180.60 ..
1.180.d:
सूर्यभक्ते सदा देयं सूर्येण कथितं पुरा ॥
अरुणस्य महाबाहो गरुडस्यारुणेन च ॥ 1.180.60 ॥
1.180.m: It should always be given to a devotee of the sun; it was told formerly by the sun / to Aruṇa, O mighty-armed one, and by Aruṇa to Garuḍa. 1.180.60

1.180.s:
garuḍena purā proktaṃ bhojakānāṃ mahātmanām ..
sūryaśarmasukhādīnāṃ śākadvīpe mahīpate .. 61 ..
1.180.d:
गरुडेन पुरा प्रोक्तं भोजकानां महात्मनाम् ॥
सूर्यशर्मसुखादीनां शाकद्वीपे महीपते ॥ 61 ॥
1.180.m: It was told formerly by Garuḍa to the noble Bhojakas, / Sūryaśarman, Sukha, and others, in Śākadvīpa, O king.

1.180.s:
taiścāpi kathitaṃ puṇyaṃ munervyāsasya dhīmataḥ ..
tenāpi kathitaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpabhayāpaham .. 62 .. ..
smṛtibhedavarṇanam
1.180.d:
तैश्चापि कथितं पुण्यं मुनेर्व्यासस्य धीमतः ॥
तेनापि कथितं पुण्यं सर्वपापभयापहम् ॥ 62 ॥ ॥
स्मृतिभेदवर्णनम्
1.180.m:
And by them was this holy [rite] related to the wise sage Vyāsa; / by him too was it recounted, sacred and removing all sins and fears.
Description of the Divisions of Smṛti

1.181.s:
.. śatānīka uvāca.. ..
paṃcaprakāraṃ dharmaṃ me vada smārtaṃ yathākramam ..
kautukaṃ pṛccha te brahmansamāsavyāsayogataḥ .. 1 ..
1.181.d:
॥ शतानीक उवाच॥ ॥
पंचप्रकारं धर्मं मे वद स्मार्तं यथाक्रमम् ॥
कौतुकं पृच्छ ते ब्रह्मन्समासव्यासयोगतः ॥ 1 ॥
1.181.m: Śatānīka said: / Speak to me in due order of the fivefold Smārta dharma; / out of curiosity I ask you, O brāhmaṇa, concisely and in detail.

1.181.s:
.. sumanturuvāca .. ..
paṃcadhā varṇitaṃ dharmaṃ śṛṇu rājansamāsataḥ ..
yathoktaṃ bhāskareṇeha aruṇasya mahātmanaḥ .. 2 ..
1.181.d:
॥ सुमन्तुरुवाच ॥ ॥
पंचधा वर्णितं धर्मं शृणु राजन्समासतः ॥
यथोक्तं भास्करेणेह अरुणस्य महात्मनः ॥ 2 ॥
1.181.m: Sumantu said: / Hear briefly, O king, of dharma described as fivefold, / as it was told here by Bhāskara to the noble Aruṇa.

1.181.s:
sahasrakiraṇaṃ bhānumudayasthaṃ divākaram ..
praṇamya śirasā devamuvāca garuḍāgrajaḥ .. 3 ..
1.181.d:
सहस्रकिरणं भानुमुदयस्थं दिवाकरम् ॥
प्रणम्य शिरसा देवमुवाच गरुडाग्रजः ॥ 3 ॥
1.181.m: Having bowed his head to the thousand-rayed Bhānu, the maker of day at his rising, / the god, Garuḍa's elder brother spoke:

1.181.s:
bhagavandevadeveśa sahasrakiraṇojjvala ..
smṛtidharmānyathātattvaṃ vaktumarhasi pṛcchataḥ .. 4 ..
1.181.d:
भगवन्देवदेवेश सहस्रकिरणोज्ज्वल ॥
स्मृतिधर्मान्यथातत्त्वं वक्तुमर्हसि पृच्छतः ॥ 4 ॥
1.181.m: O Lord, ruler of the gods of gods, blazing with a thousand rays! / You ought to declare the duties of smṛti as they truly are to me who ask.

1.181.s:
evaṃ pṛṣṭastu bhagavānaruṇena khagādhipaḥ ..
uvāca parayā prītyā pūjayitvā mahīpate .. 5 ..
1.181.d:
एवं पृष्टस्तु भगवानरुणेन खगाधिपः ॥
उवाच परया प्रीत्या पूजयित्वा महीपते ॥ 5 ॥
1.181.m: Thus questioned by Aruṇa, the lord, king of birds, / having honoured him, spoke with supreme joy, O king:

1.181.s:
.. .. bhāskara uvāca .. ..
smṛtidharmaṃ vedamūlaṃ śṛṇu tvaṃ garuḍāgraja ..
pūrvānubhūtaṃ yaddhyānamatha tatsmaraṇaṃ smṛtiḥ .. 6 ..
1.181.d:
॥ ॥ भास्कर उवाच ॥ ॥
स्मृतिधर्मं वेदमूलं शृणु त्वं गरुडाग्रज ॥
पूर्वानुभूतं यद्ध्यानमथ तत्स्मरणं स्मृतिः ॥ 6 ॥
1.181.m: Bhāskara said: / Hear, O elder brother of Garuḍa, the smṛti dharma rooted in the Veda; / that contemplation which has been previously experienced, the recollection of it is smṛti.

1.181.s:
dharmaḥ kriyātmā nirdiṣṭaḥ śreyobhyudayalakṣaṇaḥ ..
sa ca pañcavidhaḥ prokto vedamūlaḥ sanātanaḥ .. 7 ..
1.181.d:
धर्मः क्रियात्मा निर्दिष्टः श्रेयोभ्युदयलक्षणः ॥
स च पञ्चविधः प्रोक्तो वेदमूलः सनातनः ॥ 7 ॥
1.181.m: Dharma is defined as consisting of action, characterised by supreme good and prosperity; / and it is declared to be fivefold, rooted in the Veda, and eternal.

1.181.s:
asya śabdasyānuṣṭhānātsvargo mokṣaśca jāyate ..
iha loke sukhaiśvaryamalaṃ yacca khagādhipa .. 8 ..
1.181.d:
अस्य शब्दस्यानुष्ठानात्स्वर्गो मोक्षश्च जायते ॥
इह लोके सुखैश्वर्यमलं यच्च खगाधिप ॥ 8 ॥
1.181.m: From the practice of this teaching heaven and liberation arise, / as well as happiness, sovereignty, and sufficient prosperity in this world, O lord of birds.

1.181.s:
.. anūruruvāca .. ..
kathaṃ paṃcavidho hyeṣa prokto dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ..
kasya bhedāstu te paṃca brūhi me devasattama .. 9 .. ..
1.181.d:
॥ अनूरुरुवाच ॥ ॥
कथं पंचविधो ह्येष प्रोक्तो धर्मः सनातनः ॥
कस्य भेदास्तु ते पंच ब्रूहि मे देवसत्तम ॥ 9 ॥ ॥
1.181.m: Anūru said: / How is this eternal dharma declared to be fivefold? / What are those five divisions? Tell me, O best of gods!

1.181.s:
.. bhāskara uvāca .. ..
vedadharmaḥ smṛtastveka āśramāṇāṃ sa tatparaḥ ..
varṇāśramastṛtīyastu guṇanaimittiko yathā .. 1.181.10 ..
1.181.d:
॥ भास्कर उवाच ॥ ॥
वेदधर्मः स्मृतस्त्वेक आश्रमाणां स तत्परः ॥
वर्णाश्रमस्तृतीयस्तु गुणनैमित्तिको यथा ॥ 1.181.10 ॥
1.181.m: Bhāskara said: / One is remembered as the dharma of the Veda, and beyond that is that of the stages of life; / the third is of caste and stage of life, and likewise that which is incidental to a quality, 1.181.10

1.181.s:
varṇatvamekamāśritya adhikāre pravartate ..
savarṇāśramadaṃḍastu bhikṣā daṃḍādiko yathā ..11..
1.181.d:
वर्णत्वमेकमाश्रित्य अधिकारे प्रवर्तते ॥
सवर्णाश्रमदंडस्तु भिक्षा दंडादिको यथा ॥11॥
1.181.m: taking recourse solely in caste, one acts within one's sphere of duty; / such as the staff of caste and stage of life, and begging, staff, and the like.

1.181.s:
varṇāśramāśramatvaṃ ca yodhikṛtya pravartate..
sa varṇāśramadharmastu daṃḍādyā mekhalā yathā ..12..
1.181.d:
वर्णाश्रमाश्रमत्वं च योधिकृत्य प्रवर्तते॥
स वर्णाश्रमधर्मस्तु दंडाद्या मेखला यथा ॥12॥
1.181.m: And that which proceeds taking its authority from caste, stage of life, and [specific] stage of life, / that is the duty of caste and stage of life, such as the staff and the girdle.

1.181.s:
yo guṇena pravarteta sa guṇo dharma ucyate ..
yathā mūrdhābhiṣiktasya prajānāṃ pālanaṃ param ..13..
1.181.d:
यो गुणेन प्रवर्तेत स गुणो धर्म उच्यते ॥
यथा मूर्धाभिषिक्तस्य प्रजानां पालनं परम् ॥13॥
1.181.m: That which proceeds according to an inherent quality is called the dharma of quality; / such as the supreme protection of the subjects by an anointed king.

1.181.s:
nimittamekamāśritya yo dharmaḥ saṃpravartate ..
naimittikaḥ sa vijñeyo jātidravyaguṇāśrayaḥ ..14..
1.181.d:
निमित्तमेकमाश्रित्य यो धर्मः संप्रवर्तते ॥
नैमित्तिकः स विज्ञेयो जातिद्रव्यगुणाश्रयः ॥14॥
1.181.m: That dharma which proceeds taking recourse to a particular occasion / is to be known as occasional, resting upon class, material, and quality.

1.181.s:
eṣa tu dvividhaḥ proktaḥ samāsādaviśeṣataḥ ..
naimittikaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ prāyaścittavidhiryathā .. 15 ..
1.181.d:
एष तु द्विविधः प्रोक्तः समासादविशेषतः ॥
नैमित्तिकः स विज्ञेयः प्रायश्चित्तविधिर्यथा ॥ 15 ॥
1.181.m: This is declared to be of two kinds, concisely without differentiation: / it should be understood as occasional, like the rule for expiation.

1.181.s:
sa caturdhā nirūpyastu svarūpaphalasādhanaiḥ ..
pramāṇatastu pratyekasamastaiśca yathākramam .. 16 ..
1.181.d:
स चतुर्धा निरूप्यस्तु स्वरूपफलसाधनैः ॥
प्रमाणतस्तु प्रत्येकसमस्तैश्च यथाक्रमम् ॥ 16 ॥
1.181.m: It is to be examined in four ways through essential nature, result, and means, / and from authority, individually and collectively, in due order.

1.181.s:
śrutyā saha virodhe tu bādhyate viṣayaṃ vinā ..
vyavasthayā virodhena kāryo yatnaḥ parīkṣyate ..17..
1.181.d:
श्रुत्या सह विरोधे तु बाध्यते विषयं विना ॥
व्यवस्थया विरोधेन कार्यो यत्नः परीक्ष्यते ॥17॥
1.181.m: When in conflict with Śruti, it is set aside, unless in its own domain; / when there is conflict with an established rule, the effort to be undertaken is examined.

1.181.s:
smṛtyā saha virodhena cārthaśāstrasya sādhanam ..
parasparavirodhe tu arthaśāstrasya sādhanam ..18..
1.181.d:
स्मृत्या सह विरोधेन चार्थशास्त्रस्य साधनम् ॥
परस्परविरोधे तु अर्थशास्त्रस्य साधनम् ॥18॥
1.181.m: When in conflict with Smṛti, the demonstration of the treatise on statecraft [is barred]; / and when there is mutual conflict, the demonstration of the treatise on statecraft [is also barred].

1.181.s:
adṛṣṭārthe vikalpastu vyavasthāsaṃbhave sati ..
smṛtiśāstravikalpastu ākāṃkṣāpūraṇe sati .. 19 ..
1.181.d:
अदृष्टार्थे विकल्पस्तु व्यवस्थासंभवे सति ॥
स्मृतिशास्त्रविकल्पस्तु आकांक्षापूरणे सति ॥ 19 ॥
1.181.m: Where an unseen purpose is concerned, an option [is admitted] when an established rule is possible; / but an option among Smṛti treatises [occurs] when a syntactic expectation is fulfilled.

1.181.s:
vedamūle sthitaṃ tvetadanuṣṭhānaṃ kriyā satī ..
evaṃ śakyavidhānaṃ tu nyāyo hyevaṃ vyavasthitaḥ .. 1.181.20 ..
1.181.d:
वेदमूले स्थितं त्वेतदनुष्ठानं क्रिया सती ॥
एवं शक्यविधानं तु न्यायो ह्येवं व्यवस्थितः ॥ 1.181.20 ॥
1.181.m: This performance, grounded in the Veda, is a true ritual act; / thus is the prescribed application possible, for this is how the reasoning is settled.

1.181.s:
niṣedhavidhirūpaṃ tu dvidhā śāstraṃ khagādhipa ..
ekarūpaṃ vadaṃtyanye bahurūpamathā pare .. 21 ..
1.181.d:
निषेधविधिरूपं तु द्विधा शास्त्रं खगाधिप ॥
एकरूपं वदंत्यन्ये बहुरूपमथा परे ॥ 21 ॥
