1.181.m: The scripture is of two kinds, taking the form of prohibition and injunction, O lord of birds; / others say it is of one form, and yet others, of manifold forms.

1.181.s:
paṃcaprakārāḥ smṛtaya evaṃ śiṣyavyavasthitāḥ ..
tridhā caturdhā dvedhā vā ekadhā bahudhā khaga .. 22 ..
1.181.d:
पंचप्रकाराः स्मृतय एवं शिष्यव्यवस्थिताः ॥
त्रिधा चतुर्धा द्वेधा वा एकधा बहुधा खग ॥ 22 ॥
1.181.m: The Smṛtis are established for pupils in five categories, / or in three, four, two, one, or manifold ways, O bird:

1.181.s:
dṛṣṭārthā tu smṛtiḥ kācidadṛṣṭārthā tathāparā ..
anuvādasmṛtistvanyā dṛṣṭādṛṣṭā tu paṃcamī ..
sarvā etā vedamūlāḥ smṛtā vai ṛṣibhiḥ svayam .. 23 .. ..
1.181.d:
दृष्टार्था तु स्मृतिः काचिददृष्टार्था तथापरा ॥
अनुवादस्मृतिस्त्वन्या दृष्टादृष्टा तु पंचमी ॥
सर्वा एता वेदमूलाः स्मृता वै ऋषिभिः स्वयम् ॥ 23 ॥ ॥
1.181.m: One Smṛti has a seen purpose, another has an unseen purpose, / another is a restating Smṛti, and the fifth has both seen and unseen purposes; / all these are remembered by the sages themselves as rooted in the Veda.

1.181.s:
.. aruṇa uvāca .. ..
yā etā bhavatā proktāḥ smṛtayaḥ parvagopane ..
etāsāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ brūhi samāsādeva sattama .. 24 ..
1.181.d:
॥ अरुण उवाच ॥ ॥
या एता भवता प्रोक्ताः स्मृतयः पर्वगोपने ॥
एतासां लक्षणं ब्रूहि समासादेव सत्तम ॥ 24 ॥
1.181.m: Aruṇa said: / These Smṛtis that have been declared by you in protecting the divisions— / state their defining characteristics concisely, O best of beings.

1.181.s:
dṛṣṭārthā kā matā deva adṛṣṭārthā ca kā bhavet ..
dṛṣṭādṛṣṭasvarūpā kā nyāyamūlā ca kā bhavet ..
anuvādasmṛtiḥ kā syādṛṣṭādṛṣṭā tu kā bhavet .. 25 ..
1.181.d:
दृष्टार्था का मता देव अदृष्टार्था च का भवेत् ॥
दृष्टादृष्टस्वरूपा का न्यायमूला च का भवेत् ॥
अनुवादस्मृतिः का स्यादृष्टादृष्टा तु का भवेत् ॥ 25 ॥
1.181.m: Which is considered to have a seen purpose, O lord, and which has an unseen purpose? / Which has the nature of both seen and unseen, and which is rooted in reasoning? / Which is a restating Smṛti, and which has both seen and unseen purposes?

1.181.s:
evamukto mahātejā bhāskaro vāritaskaraḥ ..
uvāca taṃ khagaṃ vīraṃ praṇataṃ vinayānvitam .. 26 ..
1.181.d:
एवमुक्तो महातेजा भास्करो वारितस्करः ॥
उवाच तं खगं वीरं प्रणतं विनयान्वितम् ॥ 26 ॥
1.181.m: Addressed thus, the resplendent Sun, who wards off thieves, / spoke to that heroic bird, who was bowed and endowed with modesty.

1.181.s:
.. āditya uvāca .. ..
ṣaḍguṇasya svarūpaṃ tu prayogā tkāryagauravāt ..
samayānāmupāyānāṃ yogo vyāsasamāsataḥ .. 27 ..
1.181.d:
॥ आदित्य उवाच ॥ ॥
षड्गुणस्य स्वरूपं तु प्रयोगा त्कार्यगौरवात् ॥
समयानामुपायानां योगो व्याससमासतः ॥ 27 ॥
1.181.m: Āditya said: / The nature of the sixfold foreign policy through practical application and importance of tasks, / the combination of agreements and expedients, in detail and in brief,

1.181.s:
adhyakṣāṇāṃ ca nikṣepaḥ karaṇānāṃ nirūpaṇam ..
dṛṣṭārtheyaṃ smṛtiḥ proktā ṛṣibhirgaruḍāgraja .. 28 ..
1.181.d:
अध्यक्षाणां च निक्षेपः करणानां निरूपणम् ॥
दृष्टार्थेयं स्मृतिः प्रोक्ता ऋषिभिर्गरुडाग्रज ॥ 28 ॥
1.181.m: the appointment of overseers, and the examination of administrative offices— / this Smṛti is declared by the sages to have a seen purpose, O elder brother of Garuḍa.

1.181.s:
saṃdhyopāstistathā kāryā śuno māṃsaṃ na bhakṣayet ..
adṛṣṭārthā smṛtiḥ proktā manunā vinatātmaja .. 29 ..
1.181.d:
संध्योपास्तिस्तथा कार्या शुनो मांसं न भक्षयेत् ॥
अदृष्टार्था स्मृतिः प्रोक्ता मनुना विनतात्मज ॥ 29 ॥
1.181.m: One must perform the twilight worship; one must not eat dog meat— / [such] Smṛti is declared by Manu to have an unseen purpose, O son of Vinatā.

1.181.s:
pālāśaṃ dhārayeddaṃḍamubhayārthā vidurbudhāḥ ..
virodhe tu vikalpaḥ syādyāgo homastato yathā .. 1.181.30 ..
1.181.d:
पालाशं धारयेद्दंडमुभयार्था विदुर्बुधाः ॥
विरोधे तु विकल्पः स्याद्यागो होमस्ततो यथा ॥ 1.181.30 ॥
1.181.m: One should carry a staff of palāśa wood: the wise understand this as having both purposes. / But when there is a conflict, an option arises, just as sacrifice and oblation [differ].

1.181.s:
śrutau dṛṣṭaṃ yathā kāryaṃ smṛto tattādṛśaṃ yadi ..
uktānuvādinī sā tu pārivrājyaṃ tathā gṛhāt .. 31 ..
1.181.d:
श्रुतौ दृष्टं यथा कार्यं स्मृतो तत्तादृशं यदि ॥
उक्तानुवादिनी सा तु पारिव्राज्यं तथा गृहात् ॥ 31 ॥
1.181.m: If what is seen in Śruti is similarly [enjoined] to be done in Smṛti, / that is an explanatory restatement, as is renunciation from home.

1.181.s:
ukto dharmaśca saṃkṣepātparibhāṣā ca tadgatā ..
tatsādhanaṃ ca deśādi itthamityabravīdraviḥ .. 32 ..
1.181.d:
उक्तो धर्मश्च संक्षेपात्परिभाषा च तद्गता ॥
तत्साधनं च देशादि इत्थमित्यब्रवीद्रविः ॥ 32 ॥
1.181.m: Dharma has been declared in brief, along with its interpretive conventions, / and its means, region, and so on; thus spoke the Sun:

1.181.s:
brahmāvartaḥ paro deśa ṛṣiśastastvanaṃtaraḥ ..
madhyadeśastato'pyanya āryāvartastvanaṃtaraḥ .. 33 ..
1.181.d:
ब्रह्मावर्तः परो देश ऋषिशस्तस्त्वनंतरः ॥
मध्यदेशस्ततोऽप्यन्य आर्यावर्तस्त्वनंतरः ॥ 33 ॥
1.181.m: Brahmāvarta is the supreme country, next is the land praised by the sages; / different from that is Madhyadeśa, and next to it is Āryāvarta.

1.181.s:
kṛṣṇasārastu vicarenmṛgo yatra svabhāvataḥ ..
yajñiyaḥ sa tu deśaḥ syānmlecchadeśastataḥ paraḥ .. 34 ..
1.181.d:
कृष्णसारस्तु विचरेन्मृगो यत्र स्वभावतः ॥
यज्ञियः स तु देशः स्यान्म्लेच्छदेशस्ततः परः ॥ 34 ॥
1.181.m: Where the blackbuck roams by its own nature, / that is the land fit for sacrifice; beyond that lies the country of the mlecchas.

1.181.s:
brahmādīnāṃ ca devānāṃ brāhmaṇādestathaiva ca ..
bhūtagrāmasya kṛtsnasya trayaṃ kṛtsnasya khecara .. .. 35 ..
1.181.d:
ब्रह्मादीनां च देवानां ब्राह्मणादेस्तथैव च ॥
भूतग्रामस्य कृत्स्नस्य त्रयं कृत्स्नस्य खेचर ॥ ॥ 35 ॥
1.181.m: For Brahmā and the other gods, for the brāhmaṇas and others as well, / and for the whole collection of beings, the three [are valid] for the entirety, O sky-wanderer.

1.181.s:
sādhanatvaṃ manuḥ prāha vedamūlaṃ sanātanam ..
prakāśayajñasaṃsiddhyai yadaśabdasya eva tu .. 36 ..
1.181.d:
साधनत्वं मनुः प्राह वेदमूलं सनातनम् ॥
प्रकाशयज्ञसंसिद्ध्यै यदशब्दस्य एव तु ॥ 36 ॥
1.181.m: Manu declared its status as a means, eternal and rooted in the Veda, / for the accomplishment of the manifest sacrifice [...]

1.181.s:
upalabhya yathātattvaṃ sa ca darśitavānṛṣiḥ ..
samyaksaṃsādhanaṃ dharmaḥ kartavyastvadhikāriṇā .. 37 ..
1.181.d:
उपलभ्य यथातत्त्वं स च दर्शितवानृषिः ॥
सम्यक्संसाधनं धर्मः कर्तव्यस्त्वधिकारिणा ॥ 37 ॥
1.181.m: Having understood it in accordance with truth, that sage displayed it: / dharma is a complete accomplishment to be performed by one who is qualified,

1.181.s:
niṣkāmena sadā vīra kāmyaṃ rūpānvitena ca ..
ācārayuktaḥ śraddhālurvedajño'dhyātmaciṃtakaḥ ..
karmaṇāṃ phalamāpnoti nyāyārjitadhanaśca yaḥ .. 38 ..
1.181.d:
निष्कामेन सदा वीर काम्यं रूपान्वितेन च ॥
आचारयुक्तः श्रद्धालुर्वेदज्ञोऽध्यात्मचिंतकः ॥
कर्मणां फलमाप्नोति न्यायार्जितधनश्च यः ॥ 38 ॥
1.181.m: always without desire, O hero, and by one endowed with desire for the optional rites. / Endowed with proper conduct, faithful, knowing the Veda, contemplating the self, / and one whose wealth is earned righteously, obtains the fruit of rites.

1.181.s:
.. aruṇa uvāca .. ..
brahmāvartādideśānāṃ samastānāṃ vibhāvaso ..
vibhāgaṃ brūhi deveṃdra saṃmānaya grahādhipa .. 39 ..
1.181.d:
॥ अरुण उवाच ॥ ॥
ब्रह्मावर्तादिदेशानां समस्तानां विभावसो ॥
विभागं ब्रूहि देवेंद्र संमानय ग्रहाधिप ॥ 39 ॥
1.181.m: Aruṇa said: / State the divisions of all the regions beginning with Brahmāvarta, O Sun; / O lord of the gods, honour [my request], O lord of planets.

1.181.s:
.. āditya uvāca .. ..
sarasvatīdṛṣadvatyordevanadyoryadaṃtaram ..
taṃ devanirmitaṃ deśaṃ brahmāvartaṃ pracakṣate .. 1.181.40 ..
1.181.d:
॥ आदित्य उवाच ॥ ॥
सरस्वतीदृषद्वत्योर्देवनद्योर्यदंतरम् ॥
तं देवनिर्मितं देशं ब्रह्मावर्तं प्रचक्षते ॥ 1.181.40 ॥
1.181.m: Āditya said: / That land situated between the two divine rivers, the Sarasvatī and the Dṛṣadvatī, / fashioned by the gods, is called Brahmāvarta.

1.181.s:
himavadviṃdhyadharayoryadaṃtaramudāhṛtam ..
pratyageva prayāgācca madhyadeśaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ..
āsamudrāttu vai pūrvādāsamudrāttu paścimāt .. 41 ..
1.181.d:
हिमवद्विंध्यधरयोर्यदंतरमुदाहृतम् ॥
प्रत्यगेव प्रयागाच्च मध्यदेशः प्रकीर्तितः ॥
आसमुद्रात्तु वै पूर्वादासमुद्रात्तु पश्चिमात् ॥ 41 ॥
1.181.m: That which is declared to lie between the Himavat and Vindhya mountains, / west of Prayāga, is celebrated as Madhyadeśa. / From the eastern ocean to the western ocean,

1.181.s:
tayorevāṃtaraṃ giryorāryāvartaṃ vidurbudhāḥ .. āryāvarta
etānvijñāya saddeśāntsaṃśrayeta prayatnataḥ .. 42 ..
1.181.d:
तयोरेवांतरं गिर्योरार्यावर्तं विदुर्बुधाः ॥ आर्यावर्त
एतान्विज्ञाय सद्देशान्त्संश्रयेत प्रयत्नतः ॥ 42 ॥
1.181.m: the region between those very two mountains the wise know as Āryāvarta. / Having known these noble regions, one should take resort in them with diligence.

1.181.s:
śūdrastu yasmiṃstasminvā nivasedvṛttikarśitaḥ ..
eṣā dharmasya vai jyotiḥ samāsātkathitā tava .. 43 .. ..
vivāhavidhivarṇanam
1.181.d:
शूद्रस्तु यस्मिंस्तस्मिन्वा निवसेद्वृत्तिकर्शितः ॥
एषा धर्मस्य वै ज्योतिः समासात्कथिता तव ॥ 43 ॥ ॥
विवाहविधिवर्णनम्
1.181.m:
A śūdra, however, afflicted for a livelihood, may reside anywhere. / This illumination of dharma has been related to you in brief.
Description of the Rules of Marriage

1.182.s:
.. .. āditya uvāca .. ..
uktaṃ dharmasya rūpaṃ tu sādhikāraṃ sanātanam ..
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi dharmamāśramiṇāṃ khaga .. 1 ..
1.182.d:
॥ ॥ आदित्य उवाच ॥ ॥
उक्तं धर्मस्य रूपं तु साधिकारं सनातनम् ॥
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि धर्ममाश्रमिणां खग ॥ 1 ॥
1.182.m: Āditya said: / The eternal nature of dharma, along with qualification, has been declared; / hereafter, I shall proclaim the dharma of the people of the orders of life, O bird.

1.182.s:
brahmacārī gṛhasthaśca vanastho bhikṣureva ca ..
catvāra āśramāḥ proktā eka eva caturvidhaḥ .. 2 ..
1.182.d:
ब्रह्मचारी गृहस्थश्च वनस्थो भिक्षुरेव च ॥
चत्वार आश्रमाः प्रोक्ता एक एव चतुर्विधः ॥ 2 ॥
1.182.m: The student, the householder, the forest-dweller, and the mendicant: / four orders of life are declared; a single one is fourfold.

1.182.s:
gāyatro brahmacārī tu prājāpatyo dvitīyakaḥ ..
devavratastṛtīyastu naiṣṭhikastu caturthakaḥ .. 3 ..
1.182.d:
गायत्रो ब्रह्मचारी तु प्राजापत्यो द्वितीयकः ॥
देवव्रतस्तृतीयस्तु नैष्ठिकस्तु चतुर्थकः ॥ 3 ॥
1.182.m: The Gāyatra student is the first, the Prājāpatya is the second, / the Devavrata is the third, and the perpetual student is the fourth.

1.182.s:
catvāra āśramāḥ proktāḥ savedāḥ samadharmakāḥ ..
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi saṃskāraṃ dharmasiddhaye .. 4 ..
1.182.d:
चत्वार आश्रमाः प्रोक्ताः सवेदाः समधर्मकाः ॥
अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि संस्कारं धर्मसिद्धये ॥ 4 ॥
1.182.m: Four orders of life are declared, possessing the Vedas and sharing equal duties. / Hereafter, I shall proclaim the life-cycle rites for the attainment of dharma.

1.182.s:
garbhādhānamṛtau kāryaṃ hṛṣṭayostu samantrakam ..
kāryaṃ puṃsavanaṃ mātustṛtīye māsi saṃyutaiḥ .. 5 ..
1.182.d:
गर्भाधानमृतौ कार्यं हृष्टयोस्तु समन्त्रकम् ॥
कार्यं पुंसवनं मातुस्तृतीये मासि संयुतैः ॥ 5 ॥
1.182.m: The rite of conception is to be performed in the fertile period by a joyous couple, accompanied by mantras; / the rite for quickening a male child is to be performed for the mother in the third month with companions.

1.182.s:
sīmantaḥ saptame garbhe ṣaṣṭhe vā saptame'pi vā ..
pātrasaṃskārakā iṣṭā garbhādhānādayastrayaḥ .. 6 ..
1.182.d:
सीमन्तः सप्तमे गर्भे षष्ठे वा सप्तमेऽपि वा ॥
पात्रसंस्कारका इष्टा गर्भाधानादयस्त्रयः ॥ 6 ॥
1.182.m: The parting of the hair [is performed] in the seventh [month of] pregnancy, or in the sixth or seventh; / the three beginning with the rite of conception are prescribed as sanctifying the receptacle.

1.182.s:
jātakarmādayaḥ sarve saṃskārāḥ puruṣasya tu ..
jātasya prāśanaṃ yatra svarṇā dīnāṃ samantrakam .. 7 ..
1.182.d:
जातकर्मादयः सर्वे संस्काराः पुरुषस्य तु ॥
जातस्य प्राशनं यत्र स्वर्णा दीनां समन्त्रकम् ॥ 7 ॥
1.182.m: All the rites beginning with the birth-rite, however, belong to the male person; / the newborn is fed [honey and ghee] with gold and other [utensils], accompanied by mantras.

1.182.s:
jātakarmeti tatproktaṃ guhyaṃ nāma tadaiva tu ..
prakāśo nāma kartavyaṃ dine tvekādaśerthavat .. 8 ..
1.182.d:
जातकर्मेति तत्प्रोक्तं गुह्यं नाम तदैव तु ॥
प्रकाशो नाम कर्तव्यं दिने त्वेकादशेर्थवत् ॥ 8 ॥
1.182.m: That is declared to be the birth-rite; the secret name is [given] at that very time, / but the public, meaningful name should be given on the eleventh day.

1.182.s:
dharmaśāstrādisaṃyuktaṃ ṣaṣṭhe'nnaprāśanaṃ khaga ..
prathame'bde tṛtīye vā cūḍākarma vidhīyate .. 9 ..
1.182.d:
धर्मशास्त्रादिसंयुक्तं षष्ठेऽन्नप्राशनं खग ॥
प्रथमेऽब्दे तृतीये वा चूडाकर्म विधीयते ॥ 9 ॥
1.182.m: The first feeding of solid food, accompanied by Dharmaśāstra [observances], is in the sixth month, O bird; / the tonsure rite is prescribed in the first or third year.

1.182.s:
aṣṭame daśame vāpi brāhmaṇasyopanāyanam ..
puruṣasya tathā cānyajātīyānāṃ viśeṣataḥ .. 1.182.10 ..
1.182.d:
अष्टमे दशमे वापि ब्राह्मणस्योपनायनम् ॥
पुरुषस्य तथा चान्यजातीयानां विशेषतः ॥ 1.182.10 ॥
1.182.m: The sacred thread investiture of a brāhmaṇa is performed in the eighth or tenth [year], / and for a man of the other castes specifically.

1.182.s:
ekādaśe dvādaśe vā kārya kṣatriyavaiśyayoḥ ..
vedasaṃskārakaṃ vacmi manyante tvaupanāyanam .. 11 ..
1.182.d:
एकादशे द्वादशे वा कार्य क्षत्रियवैश्ययोः ॥
वेदसंस्कारकं वच्मि मन्यन्ते त्वौपनायनम् ॥ 11 ॥
1.182.m: In the eleventh or twelfth [year], it should be performed for a kṣatriya and a vaiśya [respectively]. / I shall explain that which purifies through the Veda, but they consider it the investiture [with the sacred thread].

1.182.s:
puruṣasya tathā cānya ubhayośca bravīmyaham ..
sāvitraṃ vaidikaṃ caiva mahānāmnīmahāvratam .. 12 ..
1.182.d:
पुरुषस्य तथा चान्य उभयोश्च ब्रवीम्यहम् ॥
सावित्रं वैदिकं चैव महानाम्नीमहाव्रतम् ॥ 12 ॥
1.182.m: Likewise, I shall explain the other [observances] for a man, and for both: / the Sāvitra, the Vedic [vow], the Mahānāmnī, and the Mahāvrata,

1.182.s:
tathaupaniṣadaṃ cābdaṃ godānaṃ ca suvarṇakam ..
vratāni grahaṇārthāni vedasyeti manormatam .. 13 ..
1.182.d:
तथौपनिषदं चाब्दं गोदानं च सुवर्णकम् ॥
व्रतानि ग्रहणार्थानि वेदस्येति मनोर्मतम् ॥ 13 ॥
1.182.m: and the Aupaniṣada for a year, the Godāna, and the Suvarṇaka. / These vows are for the acquisition of the Veda: such is the opinion of Manu.

1.182.s:
vedaikadeśapāṭhasya uktaṃ gṛhye prapañcakam ..
uktā gurostu śuśrūṣā dṛṣṭādṛṣṭārthasādhanam .. 14 ..
1.182.d:
वेदैकदेशपाठस्य उक्तं गृह्ये प्रपञ्चकम् ॥
उक्ता गुरोस्तु शुश्रूषा दृष्टादृष्टार्थसाधनम् ॥ 14 ॥
1.182.m: The detailed procedure for the recitation of a single portion of the Veda is declared in the Gṛhya [sūtra]. / Service to the guru is declared to be the means of accomplishing both seen and unseen aims.

1.182.s:
ubhayorvā tathā cānyā yathānyāyaṃ yathāśrutam ..
gurorapyeva taṃ vidyāttaddhyānaṃ trividhaṃ smṛtam .. 15 ..
1.182.d:
उभयोर्वा तथा चान्या यथान्यायं यथाश्रुतम् ॥
गुरोरप्येव तं विद्यात्तद्ध्यानं त्रिविधं स्मृतम् ॥ 15 ॥
1.182.m: Or of both, and likewise other [duties], according to rule and according to revelation. / One should know this regarding the guru as well; meditation upon him is taught to be threefold.

1.182.s:
toṣaḥ parasparasyeti etāvāndharmasaṃgrahaḥ ..
kṛtsno vedo'dhigaṃtavyaḥ svadharmamanutiṣṭhatā .. 16 ..
1.182.d:
तोषः परस्परस्येति एतावान्धर्मसंग्रहः ॥
कृत्स्नो वेदोऽधिगंतव्यः स्वधर्ममनुतिष्ठता ॥ 16 ॥
1.182.m: Pleasing one another—this is the summary of dharma. / The entire Veda is to be studied by one who follows his own dharma.

1.182.s:
jñātvā vedaṃ brahmacārī graṃthārthānyānyathāvidhi ..
naiṣṭhikaśca vidhānaṃ tu yāvatklībaṃ vidhīyate ..
vidyānte'bhīṣṭadānaṃ ca anujñāto gṛhī bhavet .. 17 ..
1.182.d:
ज्ञात्वा वेदं ब्रह्मचारी ग्रंथार्थान्यान्यथाविधि ॥
नैष्ठिकश्च विधानं तु यावत्क्लीबं विधीयते ॥
विद्यान्तेऽभीष्टदानं च अनुज्ञातो गृही भवेत् ॥ 17 ॥
1.182.m: Having learned the Veda, the student, [understanding] the texts and meanings according to rule— / and for a perpetual student the rule is enjoined as long as [he is not] impotent— / having given what is desired at the end of study, with permission he may become a householder.

1.182.s:
niṣkāsanaṃ gurugṛhādgṛhasthasya yathābhavet ..
naiṣṭhikaśca tathā snānaṃ kuryātsamyagyathāvidhi .. 18 ..
1.182.d:
निष्कासनं गुरुगृहाद्गृहस्थस्य यथाभवेत् ॥
नैष्ठिकश्च तथा स्नानं कुर्यात्सम्यग्यथाविधि ॥ 18 ॥
1.182.m: When departure from the teacher’s house takes place for the householder, / and likewise for the perpetual [student], he should properly take the bath according to rule.

1.182.s:
udvahedvai tato bhāryāṃ savarṇāṃ lakṣaṇānvitām ..
aviplutabrahmacaryaścādhikārī khagottama .. 19 ..
1.182.d:
उद्वहेद्वै ततो भार्यां सवर्णां लक्षणान्विताम् ॥
अविप्लुतब्रह्मचर्यश्चाधिकारी खगोत्तम ॥ 19 ॥
1.182.m: Then, O best of birds, having preserved his chastity unbroken, being entitled [to marry], / he should marry a wife of the same caste endowed with auspicious marks.

1.182.s:
svatantramanye cecchanti hyadhikāraṃ dvijottamāḥ ..
saptamīṃ pañcamīṃ caiva kanyakāṃ pitṛmātṛtaḥ .. 1.182.20 ..
1.182.d:
स्वतन्त्रमन्ये चेच्छन्ति ह्यधिकारं द्विजोत्तमाः ॥
सप्तमीं पञ्चमीं चैव कन्यकां पितृमातृतः ॥ 1.182.20 ॥
1.182.m: Others among the best of the twice-born desire independent eligibility. / [A maiden] removed seven degrees on the father’s side and five degrees on the mother’s side,

1.182.s:
udvaheta dvijo bhāryāmasamānārṣagotrajām ..
saṃkhyāvidhivivāheṣu gotrārthaṃ vidhivarjitam .. 21 ...
1.182.d:
उद्वहेत द्विजो भार्यामसमानार्षगोत्रजाम् ॥
संख्याविधिविवाहेषु गोत्रार्थं विधिवर्जितम् ॥ 21 ॥।
1.182.m: a twice-born man should marry as his wife, not born of the same ancestral lineage or gotra. / In marriages according to the enumerated rules, [one born of the same gotra] is devoid of legality with respect to gotra.

1.182.s:
vikalpenaiva mantavyamṛṣīṇāṃ vividhā śrutiḥ ..
aṣṭau vivāhā varṇānāṃ saṃskārākhyā iti śrutiḥ .. 22 ..
1.182.d:
विकल्पेनैव मन्तव्यमृषीणां विविधा श्रुतिः ॥
अष्टौ विवाहा वर्णानां संस्काराख्या इति श्रुतिः ॥ 22 ॥
1.182.m: It should be understood as an option; there are diverse revelations of the sages. / The eight marriages of the castes are called sacraments: such is the revelation.

1.182.s:
yastu doṣavatīṃ kanyāmanākhyāya praya cchati ..
tasya kuryānnṛpo daṃḍaṃ svayaṃ ṣaṇṇavatiṃ paṇān ..23..
1.182.d:
यस्तु दोषवतीं कन्यामनाख्याय प्रय च्छति ॥
तस्य कुर्यान्नृपो दंडं स्वयं षण्णवतिं पणान् ॥23॥
1.182.m: If someone gives away a maiden having a defect without declaring it, / the king himself should impose a fine of ninety-six paṇas upon him.

1.182.s:
piturgṛhe tu yā kanyā rajaḥ paśyatyasaṃskṛtā ..
pataṃti pitarastasya kanyā ca vṛṣalī bhavet .. 24 ..
1.182.d:
पितुर्गृहे तु या कन्या रजः पश्यत्यसंस्कृता ॥
पतंति पितरस्तस्य कन्या च वृषली भवेत् ॥ 24 ॥
1.182.m: When an unmarried maiden sees menstruation in her father’s house, / his ancestors fall, and that maiden becomes a vṛṣalī.

1.182.s:
yastu tāṃ varayetkanyāṃ brāhmaṇo jñānadurbalaḥ ..
aśrāddheyamapāṅkteyaṃ taṃ vidyādvṛṣalīpatim .. 25 ..
1.182.d:
यस्तु तां वरयेत्कन्यां ब्राह्मणो ज्ञानदुर्बलः ॥
अश्राद्धेयमपाङ्क्तेयं तं विद्याद्वृषलीपतिम् ॥ 25 ॥
1.182.m: If a brāhmaṇa deficient in wisdom should choose that maiden, / one should know him as the husband of a vṛṣalī, unfit for funeral offerings and unfit to sit in company.

1.182.s:
sarvadoṣānhi vikhyāpya striyā vā puruṣasya vā ..
ubhayorapi vikhyāpya tataḥ saṃbandhamācaret .. 26 ..
1.182.d:
सर्वदोषान्हि विख्याप्य स्त्रिया वा पुरुषस्य वा ॥
उभयोरपि विख्याप्य ततः संबन्धमाचरेत् ॥ 26 ॥
1.182.m: Having openly declared all defects, whether of the woman or of the man, / having announced [them] of both, he should then contract the alliance.

1.182.s:
gaurī kanyā pradhānā vai madhyamā kanyakā smṛtā ..
rohiṇī tatsamā jñeyā adhamā tu rajasvalā .. 27 ..
1.182.d:
गौरी कन्या प्रधाना वै मध्यमा कन्यका स्मृता ॥
रोहिणी तत्समा ज्ञेया अधमा तु रजस्वला ॥ 27 ॥
1.182.m: A gaurī is regarded as the best maiden, an [ordinary] maiden is middling, / a rohiṇī is to be known as equal to her, but a menstruating girl is the lowest.

1.182.s:
.. anūruruvāca .. ..
gaurī tu kā matā kanyā rohiṇī ca jagatpate ..
rajasvalā nagnikā ca devakanyā ca kā bhavet .. 28 ..
1.182.d:
॥ अनूरुरुवाच ॥ ॥
गौरी तु का मता कन्या रोहिणी च जगत्पते ॥
रजस्वला नग्निका च देवकन्या च का भवेत् ॥ 28 ॥
1.182.m: Anūru said: / Which maiden is considered a gaurī, and which a rohiṇī, O Lord of the world? / And what would be a rajasvalā, a nagnikā, and a devakanyā?

1.182.s:
.. bhāskara uvāca .. ..
asaṃprāptarajā gaurī prāpte rajasi rohiṇī ..
avyañjanayutā kanyā kucahīnā ca nagnikā .. 29 ..
1.182.d:
॥ भास्कर उवाच ॥ ॥
असंप्राप्तरजा गौरी प्राप्ते रजसि रोहिणी ॥
अव्यञ्जनयुता कन्या कुचहीना च नग्निका ॥ 29 ॥
1.182.m: Bhāskara said: / A gaurī is one who has not yet attained menstruation; upon attaining menstruation, she is a rohiṇī. / A maiden without signs [of puberty] and devoid of breasts is a nagnikā.

1.182.s:
saptavarṣā bhavedgaurī daśavarṣā tu nagnikā ..
dvādaśe tu bhavetkanyā ata ūrdhvaṃ rajasvalā .. 1.182.30 ..
1.182.d:
सप्तवर्षा भवेद्गौरी दशवर्षा तु नग्निका ॥
द्वादशे तु भवेत्कन्या अत ऊर्ध्वं रजस्वला ॥ 1.182.30 ॥
1.182.m: At seven years she is a gaurī; at ten years she is a nagnikā; / at twelve she is a [mature] maiden; beyond that, she is a rajasvalā.

1.182.s:
vyañjanena samopetāṃ somo bhuṅkte hi kanyakām .. tu. - ṛgveda 10.85.40
payodhareṣu gaṃdharvā rajasyagniḥ prakīrtitaḥ .. 31 ..
1.182.d:
व्यञ्जनेन समोपेतां सोमो भुङ्क्ते हि कन्यकाम् ॥ तु। - ऋग्वेद 10.85.40
पयोधरेषु गंधर्वा रजस्यग्निः प्रकीर्तितः ॥ 31 ॥
1.182.m: Soma indeed enjoys a maiden who is endowed with signs [of puberty]; / the Gandharvas [enjoy her] when breasts appear; Agni is said [to enjoy her] at menstruation.

1.182.s:
hinasti vyañjanaiḥ putrānkulaṃ hanyātpayodharaiḥ ..
gatimiṣṭāṃ tathā lokānhanyāttu rajasā pituḥ .. 32 ..
1.182.d:
हिनस्ति व्यञ्जनैः पुत्रान्कुलं हन्यात्पयोधरैः ॥
गतिमिष्टां तथा लोकान्हन्यात्तु रजसा पितुः ॥ 32 ॥
1.182.m: Through the signs [of puberty] she destroys sons; through breasts she would destroy the family; / and through menstruation she would destroy the desired goal and the worlds of her father.

1.182.s:
tasmādavyañjanopetāmarajaskapayodharām ..
nānyopabhuktāṃ somādyairdadyādduhitaraṃ pitā .. 33 ..
1.182.d:
तस्मादव्यञ्जनोपेतामरजस्कपयोधराम् ॥
नान्योपभुक्तां सोमाद्यैर्दद्याद्दुहितरं पिता ॥ 33 ॥
1.182.m: Therefore, a father should give his daughter who is without signs [of puberty], without menstruation, and without breasts, / not enjoyed by others such as Soma.

1.182.s:
annaṃ tasya na bhoktavyaṃ vṛthā pāko hi sa smṛtaḥ ..
vṛthā pākasya bhuktvānnaṃ prāyaścittaṃ samācaret ..34..
1.182.d:
अन्नं तस्य न भोक्तव्यं वृथा पाको हि स स्मृतः ॥
वृथा पाकस्य भुक्त्वान्नं प्रायश्चित्तं समाचरेत् ॥34॥
1.182.m: His food must not be eaten, for that is regarded as wasted cooking. / Having eaten the food of wasted cooking, one should perform an expiation.

1.182.s:
prāṇāyāmaṃ trirabhyasya ghṛtaṃ prāśya viśuddhyati ..
vivāhayedekagotrāṃ samānapravarāṃ khaga ..
kṛtvā tasyāṃ samutsargamatikṛcchro viśodhanam .. 35 ..
1.182.d:
प्राणायामं त्रिरभ्यस्य घृतं प्राश्य विशुद्ध्यति ॥
विवाहयेदेकगोत्रां समानप्रवरां खग ॥
कृत्वा तस्यां समुत्सर्गमतिकृच्छ्रो विशोधनम् ॥ 35 ॥
1.182.m: Having practiced breath control three times and consumed ghee, he becomes purified. / If one marries a woman of the same gotra or having the same pravara, O bird, / having abandoned her, the atikṛcchra penance is the purification.

1.182.s:
udvāhayetsagotrāṃ ca tanayāṃ mātulasya ca ..
ṛṣibhiścaiva tulyo yo dvijaścāṃdrāyaṇaṃ caret .. 36 ..
1.182.d:
उद्वाहयेत्सगोत्रां च तनयां मातुलस्य च ॥
ऋषिभिश्चैव तुल्यो यो द्विजश्चांद्रायणं चरेत् ॥ 36 ॥
1.182.m: If one should marry a woman of the same gotra, or the daughter of a maternal uncle, / even a twice-born man who is equal to the sages must perform the cāndrāyaṇa penance.

1.182.s:
asapiṇḍā tu yā māturasagotrā ca yā pituḥ ..
sā praśastā dvijātīnāṃ dārakarmaṇi maithune .. 37 .. ..
1.182.d:
असपिण्डा तु या मातुरसगोत्रा च या पितुः ॥
सा प्रशस्ता द्विजातीनां दारकर्मणि मैथुने ॥ 37 ॥ ॥
1.182.m: She who is not a sapiṇḍa of the mother and not of the same gotra as the father / is praised for the twice-born for the rites of marriage and for intercourse.

1.182.s:
.. aruṇa uvāca .. ..
dārakarma kimuktaṃ vai yaduktaṃ bhavatā idam ..
sā praśastā dvijātīnāṃ dārakarmaṇi maithune .. 38 ..
1.182.d:
॥ अरुण उवाच ॥ ॥
दारकर्म किमुक्तं वै यदुक्तं भवता इदम् ॥
सा प्रशस्ता द्विजातीनां दारकर्मणि मैथुने ॥ 38 ॥
1.182.m: Aruṇa said: / What is called the rite of marriage, which was stated by you here: / 'She is praised for the twice-born for the rites of marriage and for intercourse'?

1.182.s:
.. āditya uvāca .. ..
agnihotrādi yatkarma vaidikaṃ vinatātmaja ..
taduktaṃ dārakarmeti dvābhyāṃ yogāttu maithune ..39..
1.182.d:
॥ आदित्य उवाच ॥ ॥
अग्निहोत्रादि यत्कर्म वैदिकं विनतात्मज ॥
तदुक्तं दारकर्मेति द्वाभ्यां योगात्तु मैथुने ॥39॥
1.182.m: Āditya said: / That Vedic rite such as the agnihotra, O son of Vinatā, / that is called the rite of marriage, while intercourse arises from the union of the two.

1.182.s:
nodvahetkapilāṃ kanyāṃ nādhikāṃgīṃ na rogiṇīm ..
nālomikāṃ nātilomāṃ na cākūṭāṃ na piṅgalām ..1.182.40..
1.182.d:
नोद्वहेत्कपिलां कन्यां नाधिकांगीं न रोगिणीम् ॥
नालोमिकां नातिलोमां न चाकूटां न पिङ्गलाम् ॥1.182.40॥
1.182.m: He should not marry a girl with yellowish-brown hair, nor one with extra limbs, nor a sickly girl, / nor one who is hairless, nor one with excessive hair, nor one who is talkative, nor one who is tawny,

1.182.s:
ṛkṣavṛkṣanadīnāmnīṃ nānyaparvatanāmikām ..
na yakṣāhipreṣyanāmnīṃ cātibhīṣaṇanāmikām..41..
1.182.d:
ऋक्षवृक्षनदीनाम्नीं नान्यपर्वतनामिकाम् ॥
न यक्षाहिप्रेष्यनाम्नीं चातिभीषणनामिकाम्॥41॥
1.182.m: nor one named after a constellation, a tree, or a river, nor one having the name of a low mountain, / nor one named after a yakṣa, a serpent, or a servant, nor one with a terrifying name.

1.182.s:
yasyāstu na bhavedbhrātā na vijñāyeta vai pitā ..
nopagaccheddhi tāṃ prājñaḥ putrikādharmaśaṃkayā ..42..
1.182.d:
यस्यास्तु न भवेद्भ्राता न विज्ञायेत वै पिता ॥
नोपगच्छेद्धि तां प्राज्ञः पुत्रिकाधर्मशंकया ॥42॥
1.182.m: A wise man should not approach [in marriage] one who has no brother, / or whose father is not known, for fear of the law of an appointed daughter.

1.182.s:
haṃsasvarāmekavarṇāṃ madhupiṃgalalocanām ..
tādṛśīṃ varayetkanyāṃ gṛhārthī khagasattama .. 43 ..
1.182.d:
हंसस्वरामेकवर्णां मधुपिंगललोचनाम् ॥
तादृशीं वरयेत्कन्यां गृहार्थी खगसत्तम ॥ 43 ॥
1.182.m: Having a voice like a swan, of uniform complexion, with eyes reddish-brown like honey— / such a maiden should one who desires a household choose, O best of birds.

1.182.s:
dārāgnihotrasaṃyogaṃ kurute yo'graje sthite ..
parivettā sa vijñeyaḥ parivittistu pūrvajaḥ ..44 ..
1.182.d:
दाराग्निहोत्रसंयोगं कुरुते योऽग्रजे स्थिते ॥
परिवेत्ता स विज्ञेयः परिवित्तिस्तु पूर्वजः ॥44 ॥
1.182.m: He who contracts marriage and the agnihotra fire while his elder brother remains [unmarried] / is to be known as a parivettā, and the elder brother is the parivitti.

1.182.s:
parivittiḥ parivettā ca yayā sa parividyate ..
sarve te narakaṃ yāṃti dātṛyājakapaṃcamāḥ .. 45 ..
1.182.d:
परिवित्तिः परिवेत्ता च यया स परिविद्यते ॥
सर्वे ते नरकं यांति दातृयाजकपंचमाः ॥ 45 ॥
1.182.m: The parivitti, the parivettā, and she through whom he commits the parivedana— / all of them go to hell, with the giver and the officiating priest as the fourth and fifth.

1.182.s:
klībe deśāṃtarasthe vā patite vrajite tathā ..
yogaśāstrābhiyukte ca na doṣaḥ parivedane ..46..
1.182.d:
क्लीबे देशांतरस्थे वा पतिते व्रजिते तथा ॥
योगशास्त्राभियुक्ते च न दोषः परिवेदने ॥46॥
1.182.m: When [the elder brother] is impotent, living in another land, an outcaste, an ascetic, / or devoted to the teachings of Yoga, there is no fault in parivedana.

1.182.s:
khaṃjavāmanakubjeṣu gadgadeṣu jaḍeṣu ca ..
jātyaṃdhe badhire mūke na doṣaḥ parivedane .. 47 ..
1.182.d:
खंजवामनकुब्जेषु गद्गदेषु जडेषु च ॥
जात्यंधे बधिरे मूके न दोषः परिवेदने ॥ 47 ॥
1.182.m: In the case of those who are lame, dwarfs, hunchbacked, stutterers, imbeciles, / blind from birth, deaf, or mute, there is no fault in parivedana.

1.182.s:
na śrāddhaṃ tu kaniṣṭhasya vikulāya ca kanyakā ..
varaśca kulaśīlābhyāṃ na śuddhyeta kadācana ..
na maṃtrāḥ kāraṇaṃ tatra na ca kanyā vṛtā bhavet .. 48 ..
1.182.d:
न श्राद्धं तु कनिष्ठस्य विकुलाय च कन्यका ॥
वरश्च कुलशीलाभ्यां न शुद्ध्येत कदाचन ॥
न मंत्राः कारणं तत्र न च कन्या वृता भवेत् ॥ 48 ॥
1.182.m: There is no funeral offering for a younger brother, nor [should a maiden be given] to one of base family; / and if a suitor is never purified in family and conduct, / the mantras are of no effect there, nor is the maiden chosen.

1.182.s:
udvāhitā tu yākanyā na ca prāptā tu maithunam ..
punarabhyeti bhartāraṃ yathā kanyā tathaiva sā .. 49 ..
1.182.d:
उद्वाहिता तु याकन्या न च प्राप्ता तु मैथुनम् ॥
पुनरभ्येति भर्तारं यथा कन्या तथैव सा ॥ 49 ॥
1.182.m: A maiden who has been married but has not attained sexual union, / she may go again to a husband; she is just as a [virgin] maiden.

1.182.s:
samākṣipya matāṃ kanyāṃ pitā tvakṣatayonikām ..
kulaśīlavate dadyānna syāddoṣaḥ khagādhipa .. 1.182.50 ..
1.182.d:
समाक्षिप्य मतां कन्यां पिता त्वक्षतयोनिकाम् ॥
कुलशीलवते दद्यान्न स्याद्दोषः खगाधिप ॥ 1.182.50 ॥
1.182.m: Taking back an approved maiden whose virginity is intact, / the father may give her to one of good family and conduct; there would be no fault, O lord of birds.

1.182.s:
.. anūruruvāca .. ..
ete'ṣṭau prabhavāḥ proktā vivāhā ye jagatpate ..
lakṣaṇaṃ brūhi caiteṣāṃ samāsāttimirāpaha .. 51 ..
1.182.d:
॥ अनूरुरुवाच ॥ ॥
एतेऽष्टौ प्रभवाः प्रोक्ता विवाहा ये जगत्पते ॥
लक्षणं ब्रूहि चैतेषां समासात्तिमिरापह ॥ 51 ॥
1.182.m: Anūru said: / These eight forms of marriage that have been declared, O Lord of the world— / tell their characteristics in brief, O dispeller of darkness.

1.182.s:
.. āditya uvāca .. ..
śubhāṃ lakṣaṇasaṃpannāṃ kulaśīlaguṇānvitām ..
alaṃkṛtyārhate dānaṃ vivāho brāhma ucyate .. 52 ..
1.182.d:
॥ आदित्य उवाच ॥ ॥
शुभां लक्षणसंपन्नां कुलशीलगुणान्विताम् ॥
अलंकृत्यार्हते दानं विवाहो ब्राह्म उच्यते ॥ 52 ॥
1.182.m:
Āditya said:
The gift of an auspicious [girl] endowed with good marks, possessing noble family, conduct, and virtues, / having adorned her, to a worthy recipient is called the Brāhma marriage.

1.182.s:
saha dharmakriyāhetordānaṃ samayabaṃdhanāt ..
alaṃkṛtyaiva kanyāyāḥ prājāpatyaḥ sa ucyate .. 53 ..
1.182.d:
सह धर्मक्रियाहेतोर्दानं समयबंधनात् ॥
अलंकृत्यैव कन्यायाः प्राजापत्यः स उच्यते ॥ 53 ॥
1.182.m: The gift of a maiden, having adorned her, for the purpose of jointly performing religious rites / with a mutual agreement, that is called Prājāpatya.

1.182.s:
pradānaṃ yatra kanyāyāḥ sahagomithunena tu ..
savarṇāyāḥ sagotrāyāstamārṣamṛṣayo viduḥ.. 54 ..
1.182.d:
प्रदानं यत्र कन्यायाः सहगोमिथुनेन तु ॥
सवर्णायाः सगोत्रायास्तमार्षमृषयो विदुः॥ 54 ॥
1.182.m: Where the giving of a maiden of the same caste and the same gotra takes place / together with a pair of cattle, the sages know that as Ārṣa.

1.182.s:
aṃtarvedyāṃ samānīya kanyāṃ kanakamaṃḍitām ..
ṛtvije caiva yaddānaṃ vivāho daivasaṃjñakaḥ .. 55 ..
1.182.d:
अंतर्वेद्यां समानीय कन्यां कनकमंडिताम् ॥
ऋत्विजे चैव यद्दानं विवाहो दैवसंज्ञकः ॥ 55 ॥
1.182.m: Having brought the maiden adorned with gold into the sacrificial altar-enclosure, / the giving [of her] to an officiating priest is the marriage known as Daiva.

1.182.s:
ete vivāhāścatvāro dharmakāmārthadāyakāḥ ..
aśulkā brahmaṇā proktāstārayaṃti kuladvayam .. 56 ..
1.182.d:
एते विवाहाश्चत्वारो धर्मकामार्थदायकाः ॥
अशुल्का ब्रह्मणा प्रोक्तास्तारयंति कुलद्वयम् ॥ 56 ॥
1.182.m: These four marriages bestow dharma, desire, and wealth; / declared by Brahmā to be free of bride-price, they deliver both families.

1.182.s:
caturṣveteṣu dattāyāmutpanno yaḥ sutaḥ striyām ..
dātuḥ pratigrahītuśca punātyāsaptamānpitṝn .. 57 ..
1.182.d:
चतुर्ष्वेतेषु दत्तायामुत्पन्नो यः सुतः स्त्रियाम् ॥
दातुः प्रतिग्रहीतुश्च पुनात्यासप्तमान्पितॄन् ॥ 57 ॥
1.182.m: A son born of a woman given in these four [types of marriage] / purifies the ancestors up to the seventh generation of both the giver and the receiver.

1.182.s:
vivikte svayamanyo'nyaṃ strīpuṃsoryaḥ samāgamaḥ ..
prītihetuḥ sa gāṃdharvo vivāhaḥ paṃcamo mataḥ ..58..
1.182.d:
विविक्ते स्वयमन्योऽन्यं स्त्रीपुंसोर्यः समागमः ॥
प्रीतिहेतुः स गांधर्वो विवाहः पंचमो मतः ॥58॥
1.182.m: The union of a man and a woman in secret of their own accord, / having affection as its cause, is considered the fifth marriage, the Gāndharva.

1.182.s:
hatvā cchittvā ca bhittvā ca krośaṃtīṃ rudatīṃ gṛhāt..
prasahya kanyāharaṇaṃ rākṣasodvāha ucyate..59..
1.182.d:
हत्वा च्छित्त्वा च भित्त्वा च क्रोशंतीं रुदतीं गृहात्॥
प्रसह्य कन्याहरणं राक्षसोद्वाह उच्यते॥59॥
1.182.m: Having slain, severed, and breached, forcibly carrying off a maiden / who is screaming and weeping from her home, is called the Rākṣasa marriage.

1.182.s:
śulkaṃ pradāya kanyāyā haraṇaṃ vyasanādapi..
prasāda heturuktoyamāsuraḥ saptamastathā .. 1.182.60 ..
1.182.d:
शुल्कं प्रदाय कन्याया हरणं व्यसनादपि॥
प्रसाद हेतुरुक्तोयमासुरः सप्तमस्तथा ॥ 1.182.60 ॥
1.182.m: Carrying off a maiden after paying a bride-price, even out of distress, / said to have pleasure as its cause—this is likewise the seventh, the Āsura.

1.182.s:
suptāṃ mattāṃ pramattāṃ vā raho yatropagacchati ..
sa pāpiṣṭho vivāhānāṃ paiśācaścāṣṭamodhamaḥ .. 61 ..
1.182.d:
सुप्तां मत्तां प्रमत्तां वा रहो यत्रोपगच्छति ॥
स पापिष्ठो विवाहानां पैशाचश्चाष्टमोधमः ॥ 61 ॥
1.182.m: When one approaches [her] in secret while she is asleep, intoxicated, or heedless, / that most wicked and lowest of marriages is the Paiśāca, the eighth.

1.182.s:
etānsaśulkānsāmānyānvivāhāṃścaturo viduḥ ..
kevalaṃ kṣatriyasyaiva vīryaṃ chittvā hi rākṣasaḥ .. 62 ..
1.182.d:
एतान्सशुल्कान्सामान्यान्विवाहांश्चतुरो विदुः ॥
केवलं क्षत्रियस्यैव वीर्यं छित्त्वा हि राक्षसः ॥ 62 ॥
1.182.m: They know these four marriages, which involve bride-price, to be common; / only for a kṣatriya is the Rākṣasa [appropriate], having overcome valour.

1.182.s:
prāpte pūrvavivāhe tu vidhirvaivāhikaḥ śivaḥ ..
kartavyastu tribhirvarṇaiḥ samayenāgnisākṣikaḥ .. 63 ..
1.182.d:
प्राप्ते पूर्वविवाहे तु विधिर्वैवाहिकः शिवः ॥
कर्तव्यस्तु त्रिभिर्वर्णैः समयेनाग्निसाक्षिकः ॥ 63 ॥
1.182.m: When the previous [four] marriages are undertaken, the auspicious marital rite, / however, should be performed by the three classes with an agreement witnessed by fire.

1.182.s:
doṣavatyāḥ pradāne tu dātuḥ ṣaṇṇavatirdamaḥ ..
syāttu śulkapradāne ca kanyāyāścāpavarjane ..64..
1.182.d:
दोषवत्याः प्रदाने तु दातुः षण्णवतिर्दमः ॥
स्यात्तु शुल्कप्रदाने च कन्यायाश्चापवर्जने ॥64॥
1.182.m: In the case of giving a blemished girl, the fine of the giver shall be ninety-six; / and so it shall be in the case of giving a bride-price and in the abandonment of a maiden.

1.182.s:
mokṣopavartanaṃ dveṣaḥ strīdhanasya nivartanam ..
ākāṃkṣā tīrthasaṃrodhastyāgahetuśca vakṣyate .. 65 ..
1.182.d:
मोक्षोपवर्तनं द्वेषः स्त्रीधनस्य निवर्तनम् ॥
आकांक्षा तीर्थसंरोधस्त्यागहेतुश्च वक्ष्यते ॥ 65 ॥
1.182.m: Dissolution, departure, hatred, withholding of woman's property, / expectation, obstructing her fertile season, and the cause of abandonment shall be spoken of.

1.182.s:
parasparasya saṃbaṃdhānmokṣaḥ strīpuṃsayoḥ smṛtaḥ ..
na syādanyataraḥ prīto roṣātsāṃpratikādapi .. 66 ..
1.182.d:
परस्परस्य संबंधान्मोक्षः स्त्रीपुंसयोः स्मृतः ॥
न स्यादन्यतरः प्रीतो रोषात्सांप्रतिकादपि ॥ 66 ॥
1.182.m: Dissolution of the union between a man and a woman is recorded [in law]: / neither would be pleased, even out of momentary anger.

1.182.s:
bādhate cetpatirbhāryāṃ sa tu dveṣa iti smṛtaḥ ..
vṛttirābharaṇaṃ śulkaṃ lābhaśca strīdhanaṃ bhavet..67..
1.182.d:
बाधते चेत्पतिर्भार्यां स तु द्वेष इति स्मृतः ॥
वृत्तिराभरणं शुल्कं लाभश्च स्त्रीधनं भवेत्॥67॥
1.182.m: If a husband oppresses his wife, that is recorded as hatred. / Livelihood, ornaments, bride-price, and acquisitions constitute woman's property.

1.182.s:
bhoktṛstu svayamevedaṃ pratijñāhananaṃ bhavet ..
vṛthā mokṣeṇa bhogena striyai dadyātsavṛddhikam ..68..
1.182.d:
भोक्तृस्तु स्वयमेवेदं प्रतिज्ञाहननं भवेत् ॥
वृथा मोक्षेण भोगेन स्त्रियै दद्यात्सवृद्धिकम् ॥68॥
1.182.m: For the user [of it] himself, this becomes a breach of promise; / through futile dissolution [or] enjoyment, he must restore [it] to the woman with interest.

1.182.s:
āpattisamaye jāte strīdhanaṃ bhoktumarhati ..
ākāṃkṣetāṣṭavarṣāṇi bhartāpi prasavaṃ striyāḥ .. 69 ..
1.182.d:
आपत्तिसमये जाते स्त्रीधनं भोक्तुमर्हति ॥
आकांक्षेताष्टवर्षाणि भर्तापि प्रसवं स्त्रियाः ॥ 69 ॥
1.182.m: When a time of distress has arisen, he is entitled to enjoy the woman's property. / A husband, moreover, should wait eight years for offspring from a woman.

1.182.s:
jāyante yadi no putrāstasyāṃ yatne mahatyapi ..
tato viṃdeta putrārthī dharmataḥ kulajāṃ striyam.. 1.182.70 ..
1.182.d:
जायन्ते यदि नो पुत्रास्तस्यां यत्ने महत्यपि ॥
ततो विंदेत पुत्रार्थी धर्मतः कुलजां स्त्रियम्॥ 1.182.70 ॥
1.182.m: If sons are not born to her even upon great exertion, / then, desiring a son, he may lawfully take a well-born woman.

1.182.s:
putralābhātparaṃ loke nāsti hi prasavārthinaḥ ..
etāṃ śulkasya tāṃ bhuktvā anyāṃ labdhuṃ yadīcchati ..
samastāstoṣayitvārthaiḥ sūryoḍhāṃ paramāṃ varet..71..
1.182.d:
पुत्रलाभात्परं लोके नास्ति हि प्रसवार्थिनः ॥
एतां शुल्कस्य तां भुक्त्वा अन्यां लब्धुं यदीच्छति ॥
समस्तास्तोषयित्वार्थैः सूर्योढां परमां वरेत्॥71॥
1.182.m: For there is nothing higher in the world than obtaining a son for one desiring offspring. / Having enjoyed this woman of bride-price, if he wishes to obtain another, / he, having satisfied all with wealth, may marry a superior woman wed in the presence of the sun.

1.182.s:
ekā śūdrasya vaiśyasya dve tisraḥ kṣatriyasya tu..
catasro brāhmaṇasya syurbhāryā rājño yatheṣṭataḥ .. 72 ..
1.182.d:
एका शूद्रस्य वैश्यस्य द्वे तिस्रः क्षत्रियस्य तु॥
चतस्रो ब्राह्मणस्य स्युर्भार्या राज्ञो यथेष्टतः ॥ 72 ॥
1.182.m: A śūdra may have one wife, a vaiśya two, a kṣatriya three, / a brāhmaṇa four, and a king as many as he pleases.

1.182.s:
atīrthagamanātpuṃsastīrthe saṃgāhanātstriyāḥ ..
ubhayordharmalopaḥ syātsveṣveva tu viśeṣataḥ .. 73 ..
1.182.d:
अतीर्थगमनात्पुंसस्तीर्थे संगाहनात्स्त्रियाः ॥
उभयोर्धर्मलोपः स्यात्स्वेष्वेव तु विशेषतः ॥ 73 ॥
1.182.m: From a man's approaching [her] outside her fertile season, or a woman's bathing [with him] in her fertile season [improperly], / there occurs an omission of duty for both, particularly in their own [caste rules].

1.182.s:
yaugapadye tu tīrthānāṃ vivāhakramaśo vrajet ..
tatsāmyaṃ jīvaputrā vā grahaṇakramaśopi vā..74..
1.182.d:
यौगपद्ये तु तीर्थानां विवाहक्रमशो व्रजेत् ॥
तत्साम्यं जीवपुत्रा वा ग्रहणक्रमशोपि वा॥74॥
1.182.m: When the fertile seasons coincide, he should go according to the order of marriage; / or equally with them, or to one whose sons are living, or according to the order of taking [them].

1.182.s:
brāhmādibhirvivāhaistu saṃskṛtau tau khagādhipa ..
aṣṭau vivāhā varṇānāṃ vainateya uśaṃti vai .. 75..
1.182.d:
ब्राह्मादिभिर्विवाहैस्तु संस्कृतौ तौ खगाधिप ॥
अष्टौ विवाहा वर्णानां वैनतेय उशंति वै ॥ 75॥
1.182.m: Those two are consecrated by the marriages beginning with Brāhma, O lord of birds; / the eight marriages are indeed praised for the classes, O son of Vinatā.

1.182.s:
brāhmo daivastathārṣaśca prājāpatyaḥ khagā dhipa ..
gāṃdharvaścāsuro rakṣaḥ paiśācastvaṣṭamo'dhamaḥ .. 76 ..
1.182.d:
ब्राह्मो दैवस्तथार्षश्च प्राजापत्यः खगा धिप ॥
गांधर्वश्चासुरो रक्षः पैशाचस्त्वष्टमोऽधमः ॥ 76 ॥
1.182.m: Brāhma, Daiva, and likewise Ārṣa, Prājāpatya, O lord of birds, / Gāndharva, Āsura, Rākṣasa, and the eighth, the lowest, Paiśāca.

1.182.s:
praśastāḥ kṣatriyādīnāṃ viprādīnāṃ tu mānataḥ ..
pratigrahādayo baddhā vivāhā brāhmaṇasya tu ..77..
1.182.d:
प्रशस्ताः क्षत्रियादीनां विप्रादीनां तु मानतः ॥
प्रतिग्रहादयो बद्धा विवाहा ब्राह्मणस्य तु ॥77॥
1.182.m: They are recommended for the kṣatriyas and others, but for the brāhmaṇas and others according to authority; / marriages involving acceptance [of gifts] and so forth are bound to the brāhmaṇa.

1.182.s:
kṣatriyasyāpi deyā tu pratigrahavivarjitā ..
pravṛttiṃ kecidicchaṃti dānamityapare striyāḥ ..
pāvanaṃ puruṣāṇāṃ tu vivāhaṃ paricakṣate ..78..
śrāddhavidhikathāvarṇanam
1.182.d:
क्षत्रियस्यापि देया तु प्रतिग्रहविवर्जिता ॥
प्रवृत्तिं केचिदिच्छंति दानमित्यपरे स्त्रियाः ॥
पावनं पुरुषाणां तु विवाहं परिचक्षते ॥78॥
श्राद्धविधिकथावर्णनम्
1.182.m:
To a kṣatriya, however, [a bride] is to be given without acceptance of gifts; / some desire woman's initiative, others a gift; / but marriage is declared to be purifying for men.
Description of the narration of the rules of śrāddha.

1.183.s:
bhāskara uvāca..
kuryātpaṃcamahāyajñānadhikāro dvijasya saḥ..
bhūtapitramarabrahmamanuṣyāṇāṃ yathāvidhi..1..
1.183.d:
भास्कर उवाच॥
कुर्यात्पंचमहायज्ञानधिकारो द्विजस्य सः॥
भूतपित्रमरब्रह्ममनुष्याणां यथाविधि॥1॥
1.183.m:
Bhāskara said:
A twice-born should perform the five great sacrifices, for that is his entitlement: / those to the spirits, the ancestors, the gods, the Veda, and men, according to rule.

1.183.s:
sadā sadāna kṛtyānāṃ phalārthamapare sthitāḥ..
nityānitya miti prāhuranuṣaṃgātphalaṃ pare ..2..
1.183.d:
सदा सदान कृत्यानां फलार्थमपरे स्थिताः॥
नित्यानित्य मिति प्राहुरनुषंगात्फलं परे ॥2॥
1.183.m: Others abide always in the fruit of the rites of giving; / some declare [them] to be regular and occasional, and others [say] the fruit comes through secondary connection.

1.183.s:
atitheḥ paritoṣāya paricaryā vidhīyate ..
adṛṣṭaniyamādṛṣṭamārogyāntaṃ ca varjanam ..3..
1.183.d:
अतिथेः परितोषाय परिचर्या विधीयते ॥
अदृष्टनियमादृष्टमारोग्यान्तं च वर्जनम् ॥3॥
1.183.m: Service is prescribed for the satisfaction of a guest; / the unseen [fruit comes] from the restriction of the unseen, and abstention [lasts] until recovery of health.

1.183.s:
tisroṣṭakāstu kartavyā madhyāvartī caturthikā..
śākapāyasapūpaistu māṃsena tu caturthikā..4..
1.183.d:
तिस्रोष्टकास्तु कर्तव्या मध्यावर्ती चतुर्थिका॥
शाकपायसपूपैस्तु मांसेन तु चतुर्थिका॥4॥
1.183.m: Three aṣṭakās should be performed, and the fourth occurs in the middle: / with vegetables, milk-rice, and cakes, but the fourth with meat.

1.183.s:
pratipadi kriyate yattu catuṣpārvaṇamucyate ..
svagṛhyoktavidhānena tattu pakṣādi kīrtyate..5..
1.183.d:
प्रतिपदि क्रियते यत्तु चतुष्पार्वणमुच्यते ॥
स्वगृह्योक्तविधानेन तत्तु पक्षादि कीर्त्यते॥5॥
1.183.m: That which is performed on the first day of the fortnight is called the four-pārvaṇa; / performed according to the rite spoken in one's own Gṛhyasūtra, it is declared to begin the fortnight.

1.183.s:
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ sapiṃḍanam..
pārvaṇaṃ ceti vijñeyaṃ goṣṭhaśuddhyarthamuttamam..
karmāṃgaṃ navamaṃ proktaṃ vaidikaṃ daśamaṃ smṛtam ..6.. ..
1.183.d:
नित्यं नैमित्तिकं काम्यं वृद्धिश्राद्धं सपिंडनम्॥
पार्वणं चेति विज्ञेयं गोष्ठशुद्ध्यर्थमुत्तमम्॥
कर्मांगं नवमं प्रोक्तं वैदिकं दशमं स्मृतम् ॥6॥ ॥
1.183.m: The regular, the occasional, the optional, the vṛddhiśrāddha, the sapiṇḍana, / and the pārvaṇa is to be understood, an excellent [śrāddha] for the purification of a cow-pen; / the ninth is said to be an auxiliary to rites, and the tenth is recorded as Vedic.

1.183.s:
.. anūruruvāca .. ..
yadetadbhavatā proktaṃ śrāddhaṃ dvādaśadhā vibho ..
tasya sarvasya mā brūhi lakṣaṇaṃ vai pṛthakpṛthak .. 7 ..
1.183.d:
॥ अनूरुरुवाच ॥ ॥
यदेतद्भवता प्रोक्तं श्राद्धं द्वादशधा विभो ॥
तस्य सर्वस्य मा ब्रूहि लक्षणं वै पृथक्पृथक् ॥ 7 ॥
1.183.m:
Anūru said:
This śrāddha which has been spoken of by You as twelvefold, O Lord, / tell me each of their characteristics separately.

1.183.s:
nityaṃ kimucyate śrāddhaṃ kiṃ vā naimittikaṃ bhavet ..
kāmyādi devadeveśa eteṣāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vada .. 8 ..
1.183.d:
नित्यं किमुच्यते श्राद्धं किं वा नैमित्तिकं भवेत् ॥
काम्यादि देवदेवेश एतेषां लक्षणं वद ॥ 8 ॥
1.183.m: What is called the regular śrāddha? Or what would be the occasional? / Tell the characteristics of these, the optional and so forth, O Lord of the gods of gods.

1.183.s:
.. āditya uvāca .. ..
ahanyahani yacchrāddhaṃ tannityaṃ khaga kīrtitam ..
vaiśvadevavihīnaṃ tu aśaktāvudakena tu .. 9 ..
1.183.d:
॥ आदित्य उवाच ॥ ॥
अहन्यहनि यच्छ्राद्धं तन्नित्यं खग कीर्तितम् ॥
वैश्वदेवविहीनं तु अशक्तावुदकेन तु ॥ 9 ॥
1.183.m:
Āditya said:
The śrāddha which [is performed] day after day is declared to be regular, O bird; / but it is devoid of the rite to all-gods, or with water in case of inability.

1.183.s:
ekoddiṣṭaṃ tu yacchrāddhaṃ tannaimittikamucyate ..
tatsadaiva prakartavyamayugmānbhojayeddvijān .. 1.183.10 ..
1.183.d:
एकोद्दिष्टं तु यच्छ्राद्धं तन्नैमित्तिकमुच्यते ॥
तत्सदैव प्रकर्तव्यमयुग्मान्भोजयेद्द्विजान् ॥ 1.183.10 ॥
1.183.m: The śrāddha dedicated to a single [ancestor] is called occasional; / that should always be performed; one should feed an odd number of twice-born.

1.183.s:
kāmayuktaṃ hi tatkāmyamabhipretārthasiddhaye ..
pārvaṇena vidhānena tadapyuktaṃ khagādhipa .. 11 ..
1.183.d:
कामयुक्तं हि तत्काम्यमभिप्रेतार्थसिद्धये ॥
पार्वणेन विधानेन तदप्युक्तं खगाधिप ॥ 11 ॥
1.183.m: That which is accompanied by a desire is optional, for the attainment of a desired goal; / that also, O lord of birds, has been stated to be by the procedure of a pārvaṇa.

1.183.s:
vṛddhau yatkriyate śrāddhaṃ vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ taducyate ..
sarvaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kāryaṃ pūrvāhṇe tūpavītinā ..12..
1.183.d:
वृद्धौ यत्क्रियते श्राद्धं वृद्धिश्राद्धं तदुच्यते ॥
सर्वं प्रदक्षिणं कार्यं पूर्वाह्णे तूपवीतिना ॥12॥
1.183.m: The śrāddha which is performed on [an occasion of] prosperity is called the vṛddhiśrāddha; / everything should be done clockwise in the forenoon by one wearing the sacred thread over the left shoulder.

1.183.s:
gaṃdhodakatilairyuktaṃ kuryātpātracatuṣṭayam..
arghārthaṃ pitṛpātreṣu pretapātraṃ pramocayet ..13..
1.183.d:
गंधोदकतिलैर्युक्तं कुर्यात्पात्रचतुष्टयम्॥
अर्घार्थं पितृपात्रेषु प्रेतपात्रं प्रमोचयेत् ॥13॥
1.183.m: One should prepare four vessels supplied with fragrant water and sesamum; / for the sake of the water-offering, one should pour the vessel for the deceased spirit into the vessels for the ancestors.

1.183.s:
ye samānā iti dvābhyāmetajjñeyaṃ sapiṃḍanam ..
nityena tulyaṃ śeṣaṃ syādekoddiṣṭaṃ striyā api..14..
1.183.d:
ये समाना इति द्वाभ्यामेतज्ज्ञेयं सपिंडनम् ॥
नित्येन तुल्यं शेषं स्यादेकोद्दिष्टं स्त्रिया अपि॥14॥
1.183.m: This rite of sapiṇḍana is known to be performed with the two mantras beginning “ye samānāḥ”. / The remainder is equal to the daily [rite], and an ekoddiṣṭa is also [performed] for a woman.

1.183.s:
darśe vai kriyate yattu tatpārvaṇamudāhṛtam ..
parvaṇi kriyate yacca tatpārvaṇamiti sthitiḥ ..
gobhyaśca kriyate śrāddhaṃ tadgoṣṭhaśrāddhamucyate .. 15 ..
1.183.d:
दर्शे वै क्रियते यत्तु तत्पार्वणमुदाहृतम् ॥
पर्वणि क्रियते यच्च तत्पार्वणमिति स्थितिः ॥
गोभ्यश्च क्रियते श्राद्धं तद्गोष्ठश्राद्धमुच्यते ॥ 15 ॥
1.183.m: That which is performed on the new moon day is proclaimed as pārvaṇa; / and that which is performed on a conjunction day is pārvaṇa—such is the rule. / And the śrāddha performed for cows is called goṣṭha-śrāddha.

1.183.s:
bahūnāṃ viduṣāṃ saṃpatsukhārthaṃ pitṛtṛptaye ..
kriyate śuddhaye yadvai brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojanam ..
śudyarthamiti tatproktaṃ vainateya manīṣibhiḥ .. 16 ..
1.183.d:
बहूनां विदुषां संपत्सुखार्थं पितृतृप्तये ॥
क्रियते शुद्धये यद्वै ब्राह्मणानां च भोजनम् ॥
शुद्यर्थमिति तत्प्रोक्तं वैनतेय मनीषिभिः ॥ 16 ॥
1.183.m: The feeding of brāhmaṇas performed for the sake of prosperity and happiness / of many wise men, for the satisfaction of the ancestors, and for purification, / has been declared by the wise, O son of Vinatā, to be for purification.

1.183.s:
niṣekakāle some ca sīmatonnayane tathā ..
jñeyaṃ puṃsavanaṃ śrāddhaṃ tacca karmāṃgameva ca .. .. 17 ..
1.183.d:
निषेककाले सोमे च सीमतोन्नयने तथा ॥
ज्ञेयं पुंसवनं श्राद्धं तच्च कर्मांगमेव च ॥ ॥ 17 ॥
1.183.m: At the time of insemination, at the soma ritual, and likewise at the parting of the hair, / a puṃsavana-śrāddha is to be known, and that is indeed an auxiliary of the rite.

1.183.s:
kriyate devamuddiśya saptamyādiṣu yatnataḥ ..
gaccheddeśāṃtare yastu śrāddhaṃ kuryāttu sarpiṣā ..
tadyatnārthamiti proktaṃ pradiśecca na saṃśayaḥ ..18..
1.183.d:
क्रियते देवमुद्दिश्य सप्तम्यादिषु यत्नतः ॥
गच्छेद्देशांतरे यस्तु श्राद्धं कुर्यात्तु सर्पिषा ॥
तद्यत्नार्थमिति प्रोक्तं प्रदिशेच्च न संशयः ॥18॥
1.183.m: That which is performed with effort intending a deity, on the seventh day and so forth, / or when one goes to another country and performs a śrāddha with clarified butter, / is declared to be for special effort; one should assign it, without doubt.

1.183.s:
śarīropacaye śrāddhamaśvavṛddhyarthameva ca ..
puṣṭyarthametadvijñeyamaupacārikamucyate .. 19 ..
1.183.d:
शरीरोपचये श्राद्धमश्ववृद्ध्यर्थमेव च ॥
पुष्ट्यर्थमेतद्विज्ञेयमौपचारिकमुच्यते ॥ 19 ॥
1.183.m: A śrāddha [performed] for bodily development and for the increase of horses / is to be understood as being for nourishment; it is called aupacārika.

1.183.s:
sarveṣāmeva śrāddhānāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sāṃvatsaraṃ matam ..
kiyate yatkhagaśreṣṭha mṛtehani budhaiḥ saha .. 1.183.20 ..
1.183.d:
सर्वेषामेव श्राद्धानां श्रेष्ठं सांवत्सरं मतम् ॥
कियते यत्खगश्रेष्ठ मृतेहनि बुधैः सह ॥ 1.183.20 ॥
1.183.m: Of all śrāddhas indeed, the annual one is considered the best, / which is performed on the day of death together with the wise, O best of birds.

1.183.s:
mṛte'hani punaryastu na kuryācchrāddhamādarāt ..
mātuśca khagaśārdūla vatsarāṃte mṛte'hani .. 21 ..
1.183.d:
मृतेऽहनि पुनर्यस्तु न कुर्याच्छ्राद्धमादरात् ॥
मातुश्च खगशार्दूल वत्सरांते मृतेऽहनि ॥ 21 ॥
1.183.m: He who, on the other hand, does not respectfully perform the śrāddha on the day of death / of his mother, O tiger among birds, at the end of the year on the day of death—

1.183.s:
nāhaṃ tasya khagaśreṣṭha pūjāṃ gṛhṇāmi no hariḥ ..
na brahmā na ca vai rudro na cānye devatāgaṇāḥ .. 22 ..
1.183.d:
नाहं तस्य खगश्रेष्ठ पूजां गृह्णामि नो हरिः ॥
न ब्रह्मा न च वै रुद्रो न चान्ये देवतागणाः ॥ 22 ॥
1.183.m: I do not accept his worship, O best of birds, nor does Hari, / nor Brahmā, nor Rudra, nor the other hosts of deities.

1.183.s:
tasmādyatnena kartavyaṃ varṣevarṣe mṛte'hani ..
nareṇa khagaśārdūla bhojakena viśeṣataḥ .. 23 ..
1.183.d:
तस्माद्यत्नेन कर्तव्यं वर्षेवर्षे मृतेऽहनि ॥
नरेण खगशार्दूल भोजकेन विशेषतः ॥ 23 ॥
1.183.m: Therefore it must be performed with effort year after year on the day of death / by a man, O tiger among birds, especially by a Bhojaka.

1.183.s:
bhojako yastu vai śrāddhaṃ na karoti khagādhipa ..
mātāpitṛbhyāṃ satataṃ varṣevarṣe mṛte'hani ...27.
1.183.d:
भोजको यस्तु वै श्राद्धं न करोति खगाधिप ॥
मातापितृभ्यां सततं वर्षेवर्षे मृतेऽहनि ॥.27.
1.183.m: The Bhojaka who indeed does not perform the śrāddha, O king of birds, / for his mother and father constantly year after year on the day of death,

1.183.s:
sa yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ tāmisraṃ nāma nāmataḥ ..
tato bhavati duṣṭātmā nagare sūkaraḥ khaga .. 25 ..
1.183.d:
स याति नरकं घोरं तामिस्रं नाम नामतः ॥
ततो भवति दुष्टात्मा नगरे सूकरः खग ॥ 25 ॥
1.183.m: goes to the terrible hell named Tāmisra. / Then that wicked-minded one becomes a hog in a city, O bird.

1.183.s:
anūruruvāca .. ..
na jānāti dinaṃ yastu na māsaṃ vibudhādhipa ..
mṛtau yatra mahāprājña pitarau sa kathaṃ naraḥ ..
śrāddhaṃ karotu vai tābhyāṃ vidhivadvatsarātmakam .. 26 ..
1.183.d:
अनूरुरुवाच ॥ ॥
न जानाति दिनं यस्तु न मासं विबुधाधिप ॥
मृतौ यत्र महाप्राज्ञ पितरौ स कथं नरः ॥
श्राद्धं करोतु वै ताभ्यां विधिवद्वत्सरात्मकम् ॥ 26 ॥
1.183.m: Anūru said: / A man who knows neither the day nor the month, O lord of deities, / on which his two parents died, O greatly wise one, how may that man / perform the annual śrāddha for them according to the rules?

1.183.s:
.. āditya uvāca .. ..
na jānāti naro yastu mṛtānāṃ vinatātmaja ..
māsaṃ dinaṃ mṛtānāṃ tu pitṝṇāṃ khagasattama .. 27 ..
1.183.d:
॥ आदित्य उवाच ॥ ॥
न जानाति नरो यस्तु मृतानां विनतात्मज ॥
मासं दिनं मृतानां तु पितॄणां खगसत्तम ॥ 27 ॥
1.183.m: Āditya said: / The man who does not know, O son of Vinatā, / the month or day of the departed ancestors, O best among birds—

1.183.s:
yathā kuryātkhagaśreṣṭha śṛṇu kṛtsnaṃ samāsataḥ ..
mṛtāhaṃ yo na jānāti mānavo vinatātmaja .. 28 ..
1.183.d:
यथा कुर्यात्खगश्रेष्ठ शृणु कृत्स्नं समासतः ॥
मृताहं यो न जानाति मानवो विनतात्मज ॥ 28 ॥
1.183.m: hear in full, in brief, how he should act, O best of birds. / The mortal who does not know the day of death, O son of Vinatā,

1.183.s:
tena kāryamamāyāṃ ca śrāddhaṃ sāṃvatsaraṃ khaga ..
māse mārgaśire vīra māghe vā vidhivatkhaga .. .. 29 ..
1.183.d:
तेन कार्यममायां च श्राद्धं सांवत्सरं खग ॥
मासे मार्गशिरे वीर माघे वा विधिवत्खग ॥ ॥ 29 ॥
1.183.m: by him the annual śrāddha must be performed on the new moon day, O bird, / in the month of Mārgaśīrṣa, O hero, or in Māgha, according to the rule, O bird.

1.183.s:
viśeṣato bhojanena yo māṃ pūjyate sadā ..
prītaye mama vai tena saṃpūjyāḥ pitaraḥ sadā .. 1.183.30 ..
1.183.d:
विशेषतो भोजनेन यो मां पूज्यते सदा ॥
प्रीतये मम वै तेन संपूज्याः पितरः सदा ॥ 1.183.30 ॥
1.183.m: He who always worships me, especially through the feeding [of priests], / by him the ancestors must always be venerated for my gratification.

1.183.s:
mameṣṭāḥ pitaro nityaṃ gāvo viprāśca suvrata ..
tasmācca te sadā pūjyā madbhaktena viśeṣataḥ .. 31 ..
1.183.d:
ममेष्टाः पितरो नित्यं गावो विप्राश्च सुव्रत ॥
तस्माच्च ते सदा पूज्या मद्भक्तेन विशेषतः ॥ 31 ॥
1.183.m: Dear to me are always the ancestors, cows, and brāhmaṇas, O one of good vows; / therefore, they should always be worshipped especially by my devotee.

1.183.s:
iti śrībhaviṣye mahāpurāṇe brāhme parvaṇi saptamīkalpe sauradharme śrāddhavidhikathanaṃ nāma tryaśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..183.. ..
brāhmaṇadharmavidhivarṇanam
1.183.d:
इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराणे ब्राह्मे पर्वणि सप्तमीकल्पे सौरधर्मे श्राद्धविधिकथनं नाम त्र्यशीत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ॥183॥ ॥
ब्राह्मणधर्मविधिवर्णनम्
1.183.m:
Thus ends the one hundred and eighty-third chapter, named 'Description of the Rules for Śrāddha', in the Solar Dharma within the Saptamīkalpa of the Brāhmaparvan, in the glorious Bhaviṣya Mahāpurāṇa.
Description of the Rules of Conduct for Brāhmaṇas.

1.184.s:
prakhyāte pratyayenaiva praśnapūrvaṃ pratigrahaḥ ..
yajane'dhyāpane vāde ṣaḍvidho vedavikrayaḥ .. 1 ..
1.184.d:
प्रख्याते प्रत्ययेनैव प्रश्नपूर्वं प्रतिग्रहः ॥
यजनेऽध्यापने वादे षड्विधो वेदविक्रयः ॥ 1 ॥
1.184.m: Selling the Veda is sixfold: upon public fame, through trust alone, preceded by an enquiry, / in performing a sacrifice, in teaching, and in disputation.

1.184.s:
veda vikrayanirdiṣṭaṃ striyā cāvarjitaṃ dhanam ..
na deyaṃ pitṛdevebhyo yacca klībātkhagādhipa .. 2 ..
1.184.d:
वेद विक्रयनिर्दिष्टं स्त्रिया चावर्जितं धनम् ॥
न देयं पितृदेवेभ्यो यच्च क्लीबात्खगाधिप ॥ 2 ॥
1.184.m: Wealth designated by selling the Veda, and wealth acquired through a woman, / or that which comes from a eunuch, should not be given to the ancestors or gods, O king of birds.

1.184.s:
anuyogena yo dadyādbrāhmaṇāya pratigraham ..
sa pūrvaṃ narakaṃ yāti brāhmaṇāstadanaṃtaram .. 3 ..
1.184.d:
अनुयोगेन यो दद्याद्ब्राह्मणाय प्रतिग्रहम् ॥
स पूर्वं नरकं याति ब्राह्मणास्तदनंतरम् ॥ 3 ॥
1.184.m: He who gives a gift to a brāhmaṇa following an inquiry, / goes to hell first, and after him the brāhmaṇa [goes as well].

1.184.s:
vedākṣarāṇi yāvaṃti niyujyanterthakāraṇāt ..
tāvatyo bhrūṇahatyā vai vedavikrayamāpnuyāt .. 4 ..
1.184.d:
वेदाक्षराणि यावंति नियुज्यन्तेर्थकारणात् ॥
तावत्यो भ्रूणहत्या वै वेदविक्रयमाप्नुयात् ॥ 4 ॥
1.184.m: For as many syllables of the Veda as are employed for the sake of money, / so many foeticides indeed does one incur by the sale of the Veda.

1.184.s:
vaiśvadevena yo hīna ādityasya ca karmaṇaḥ ..
sarve te vṛṣalā jñeyāḥ prāptavedāśca brāhmaṇāḥ ..5..
1.184.d:
वैश्वदेवेन यो हीन आदित्यस्य च कर्मणः ॥
सर्वे ते वृषला ज्ञेयाः प्राप्तवेदाश्च ब्राह्मणाः ॥5॥
1.184.m: Those brāhmaṇas who are destitute of the vaiśvadeva and of the rite of Āditya, / even though they have acquired the Veda, are all to be known as outcasts.

1.184.s:
yeṣāmadhyayanaṃ nāsti ye ca kecidanagnayaḥ..
kulaṃ vā'śrotriyaṃ yeṣāṃ sarve te śūdradharmiṇaḥ .. 6 ..
1.184.d:
येषामध्ययनं नास्ति ये च केचिदनग्नयः॥
कुलं वाऽश्रोत्रियं येषां सर्वे ते शूद्रधर्मिणः ॥ 6 ॥
1.184.m: Those who have no Vedic study, and those who keep no sacred fire, / or those whose family is unlearned in the Veda, all share the condition of a śūdra.

1.184.s:
akṛtvā vaiśvadevaṃ tu yo bhuṅkte so'budhaḥ khaga ..
vṛthā tenānnapākena yamayoniṃ vrajettu saḥ .. 7 ..
1.184.d:
अकृत्वा वैश्वदेवं तु यो भुङ्क्ते सोऽबुधः खग ॥
वृथा तेनान्नपाकेन यमयोनिं व्रजेत्तु सः ॥ 7 ॥
1.184.m: He who eats without having performed the vaiśvadeva is a fool, O bird; / on account of that vain cooking of food, he goes to the womb of Yama.

1.184.s:
priyo vā yadi vā dveṣyo mūrkhaḥ paṃḍita eva ca ..
vaiśvadeve tu saṃprāpte so'tithiḥ svargasaṃkramaḥ .. 8 ..
1.184.d:
प्रियो वा यदि वा द्वेष्यो मूर्खः पंडित एव च ॥
वैश्वदेवे तु संप्राप्ते सोऽतिथिः स्वर्गसंक्रमः ॥ 8 ॥
1.184.m: Whether dear or hostile, a fool or a learned man, / who arrives when the vaiśvadeva is underway—such a guest is a bridge to heaven.

1.184.s:
naikagrāmīṇamatithiṃ viprasāṃgatikaṃ tathā ..
aciṃtyobhyāgato yasmāttasmādatithirucyate .. 9 ..
1.184.d:
नैकग्रामीणमतिथिं विप्रसांगतिकं तथा ॥
अचिंत्योभ्यागतो यस्मात्तस्मादतिथिरुच्यते ॥ 9 ॥
1.184.m: One should not consider as a guest a co-villager or a brāhmaṇa traveling companion. / Because he arrives unthought of, for that reason he is called a guest.

1.184.s:
aciṃtyaḥ sa tu vai nāmnā vaiśvadeva upāgataḥ ..
atithiṃ taṃ vijānīyānna punaḥ pūrvamāgataḥ .. 1.184.10 ..
1.184.d:
अचिंत्यः स तु वै नाम्ना वैश्वदेव उपागतः ॥
अतिथिं तं विजानीयान्न पुनः पूर्वमागतः ॥ 1.184.10 ॥
1.184.m: He who arrives unthought of by name at the vaiśvadeva / should be recognized as a guest, and not one who has arrived beforehand.

1.184.s:
yāvacca prāpnuyādannaṃ kṛtāśīḥ snātako dvijaḥ ..
tasyānnasya caturbhāgaṃ haṃtakāraṃ viduḥ khaga..11..
1.184.d:
यावच्च प्राप्नुयादन्नं कृताशीः स्नातको द्विजः ॥
तस्यान्नस्य चतुर्भागं हंतकारं विदुः खग॥11॥
1.184.m: As much food as a bath-graduate twice-born who has pronounced blessings would receive, / one-fourth of that food they know as the hantakāra, O bird.

1.184.s:
grāsamātrā bhavedbhikṣā catuṣkālaṃ caturguṇam ..
puṣkalāni ca catvāri haṃtakāro vidhīyate .. 12 ..
1.184.d:
ग्रासमात्रा भवेद्भिक्षा चतुष्कालं चतुर्गुणम् ॥
पुष्कलानि च चत्वारि हंतकारो विधीयते ॥ 12 ॥
1.184.m: Alms should be merely a mouthful; [the grāsa is] fourfold, four times that amount; / and four puṣkalas are prescribed as the hantakāra.

1.184.s:
ārūḍho naiṣṭhikaṃ dharmaṃ yastu pracyavate punaḥ ..
cāṃdrāyaṇaṃ carenmāsamiti viddhi khagādhipa .. 13 ..
1.184.d:
आरूढो नैष्ठिकं धर्मं यस्तु प्रच्यवते पुनः ॥
चांद्रायणं चरेन्मासमिति विद्धि खगाधिप ॥ 13 ॥
1.184.m: He who, having undertaken the lifelong observance of celibacy, lapses again, / should perform the cāndrāyaṇa for a month; know this, O king of birds.

1.184.s:
ārūḍhapatitāpatyā brāhmaṇo vṛṣalena ca ..
dvāvetau viddhi cāṃḍālau veditrādyaśca jāyate .. 14 ..
1.184.d:
आरूढपतितापत्या ब्राह्मणो वृषलेन च ॥
द्वावेतौ विद्धि चांडालौ वेदित्राद्यश्च जायते ॥ 14 ॥
1.184.m: The offspring of one who has fallen after taking vows, and a brāhmaṇa [begotten] by an outcast— / know both of these as cāṇḍālas, and [likewise] one who is born from a [woman who had a previous] husband.

1.184.s:
brāhmaṇī kulaṭā nityaṃ svakaṃ tyaktvā patiṃ khaga ..
anyasya viśate gehe brāhmaṇasya khagādhipa..15..
1.184.d:
ब्राह्मणी कुलटा नित्यं स्वकं त्यक्त्वा पतिं खग ॥
अन्यस्य विशते गेहे ब्राह्मणस्य खगाधिप॥15॥
1.184.m: A brāhmaṇa woman who is unchaste constantly, having abandoned her own husband, O bird, / enters the house of another brāhmaṇa, O king of birds;

1.184.s:
utpadyate tu yastasyā brāhmaṇena mahāmate ..
sa cāṃḍālo mahānprokto mahācāṃḍāla ityuta..16..
1.184.d:
उत्पद्यते तु यस्तस्या ब्राह्मणेन महामते ॥
स चांडालो महान्प्रोक्तो महाचांडाल इत्युत॥16॥
1.184.m: he who is born of her by that brāhmaṇa, O highly intelligent one, / is proclaimed a great cāṇḍāla, indeed called a mahācāṇḍāla.

1.184.s:
yastu pravrajito bhūtvā punaḥ sevati maithunam..
ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viṣṭhāyāṃ jāyate krimiḥ ..
paṃcagavyena śuddhiḥ syādityāha mama dehakṛt..17..
1.184.d:
यस्तु प्रव्रजितो भूत्वा पुनः सेवति मैथुनम्॥
षष्टिवर्षसहस्राणि विष्ठायां जायते क्रिमिः ॥
पंचगव्येन शुद्धिः स्यादित्याह मम देहकृत्॥17॥
1.184.m: He who, having become a renouncer, engages again in sexual union, / is born as a worm in faeces for sixty thousand years. / Purification occurs by the five products of the cow, so said my creator.

1.184.s:
abhojyaṃ brāhmaṇasyānnaṃ vṛṣalena nimaṃtritam ..
tathaiva vṛṣalasyānnaṃ brāhmaṇena nimaṃtritam ..18..
1.184.d:
अभोज्यं ब्राह्मणस्यान्नं वृषलेन निमंत्रितम् ॥
तथैव वृषलस्यान्नं ब्राह्मणेन निमंत्रितम् ॥18॥
1.184.m: Food of a brāhmaṇa invited by an outcast must not be eaten, / and likewise the food of an outcast invited by a brāhmaṇa.

1.184.s:
brāhmaṇānnaṃ dadacchūdraḥ śūdrānnaṃ brāhmaṇo dadat ..
ubhāvetāvabhojyānnau bhuktvā cāṃdrāyaṇaṃ caret ..19..
1.184.d:
ब्राह्मणान्नं ददच्छूद्रः शूद्रान्नं ब्राह्मणो ददत् ॥
उभावेतावभोज्यान्नौ भुक्त्वा चांद्रायणं चरेत् ॥19॥
1.184.m: A śūdra who gives food of a brāhmaṇa, and a brāhmaṇa who gives food of a śūdra— / both of these are persons whose food is inedible; having eaten it, one should perform the cāndrāyaṇa.

1.184.s:
upanikṣepadharmeṇa śūdrānnaṃ ca paceddvijaḥ ..
abhojyaṃ tadbhavedannaṃ sa ca vipraḥ purohitaḥ ..1.184.20..
1.184.d:
उपनिक्षेपधर्मेण शूद्रान्नं च पचेद्द्विजः ॥
अभोज्यं तद्भवेदन्नं स च विप्रः पुरोहितः ॥1.184.20॥
1.184.m: And if a twice-born should cook the food of a śūdra under the arrangement of a trust, / that food would become inedible, and that brāhmaṇa becomes [merely] a domestic priest.

1.184.s:
śūdrānnaṃ śūdrasaṃparkaṃ śūdreṇa saha vāsanam ..
śūdrājjñānāgamaḥ kaścijvalaṃtamapi pātayet ..21..
1.184.d:
शूद्रान्नं शूद्रसंपर्कं शूद्रेण सह वासनम् ॥
शूद्राज्ज्ञानागमः कश्चिज्वलंतमपि पातयेत् ॥21॥
1.184.m: Food from a śūdra, contact with a śūdra, residing together with a śūdra, / and any acquisition of knowledge from a śūdra will cause even a blazing [sage] to fall.

1.184.s:
śūdrānnopahatā viprā vihvalā ratilālasāḥ ..
kupitāḥ kiṃ kariṣyaṃti nirviṣā iva pannagāḥ .. 22 ..
1.184.d:
शूद्रान्नोपहता विप्रा विह्वला रतिलालसाः ॥
कुपिताः किं करिष्यंति निर्विषा इव पन्नगाः ॥ 22 ॥
1.184.m: Brāhmaṇas ruined by the food of a śūdra, agitated and longing for sexual pleasure— / what will they do when angered, like serpents deprived of poison?

1.184.s:
hastadattāstu ye snehāllavaṇavyaṃjanādayaḥ ..
dātāraṃ nādhitiṣṭhaṃti bhoktā bhuṃkte tu kilbiṣam .. 23 ..
1.184.d:
हस्तदत्तास्तु ये स्नेहाल्लवणव्यंजनादयः ॥
दातारं नाधितिष्ठंति भोक्ता भुंक्ते तु किल्बिषम् ॥ 23 ॥
1.184.m: Salt, condiments, and the like that are given by hand out of affection / do not benefit the giver, and the eater eats sin.

1.184.s:
āyasena tu pātreṇa yadannamupadīyate ..
bhoktā viṣṭhāśanaṃ bhuṃkte dātā tu narakaṃ vrajet .. 24 ..
1.184.d:
आयसेन तु पात्रेण यदन्नमुपदीयते ॥
भोक्ता विष्ठाशनं भुंक्ते दाता तु नरकं व्रजेत् ॥ 24 ॥
1.184.m: Food that is served from an iron vessel: / the eater eats an eating of excrement, and the giver goes to hell.

1.184.s:
aṃgulyā daṃtakāṣṭhaṃ yatpratyakṣalavaṇaṃ ca yat ..
mṛttikābhakṣaṇaṃ caiva tulyaṃ gomāṃsabhakṣaṇaiḥ .. 25 ..
1.184.d:
अंगुल्या दंतकाष्ठं यत्प्रत्यक्षलवणं च यत् ॥
मृत्तिकाभक्षणं चैव तुल्यं गोमांसभक्षणैः ॥ 25 ॥
1.184.m: Cleaning the teeth with a finger, raw salt directly [eaten], / and eating earth are equal to eating beef.

1.184.s:
mukhe paryuṣite nityaṃ bhavatyaprayato dvijaḥ ..
tasmācchuṣkamathārdraṃ vā bhakṣayeddaṃtadhāvanam .. 26 ..
1.184.d:
मुखे पर्युषिते नित्यं भवत्यप्रयतो द्विजः ॥
तस्माच्छुष्कमथार्द्रं वा भक्षयेद्दंतधावनम् ॥ 26 ॥
1.184.m: When his mouth has spent the night stale, a twice-born is always impure; / therefore, dry or moist, he should chew a tooth-cleaning stick.

1.184.s:
puṣpālaṃkāravastrāṇi gaṃdha mālyānulepanam..
upavāse na duṣyaṃti daṃtadhāvanamaṃjanam ..27..
1.184.d:
पुष्पालंकारवस्त्राणि गंध माल्यानुलेपनम्॥
उपवासे न दुष्यंति दंतधावनमंजनम् ॥27॥
1.184.m: Flowers, ornaments, garments, perfumes, garlands, unguents, / the tooth-cleaning stick, and collyrium do not corrupt a fast.

1.184.s:
gṛhāṃte vasate mūrkho dūre cāsya guṇānvitaḥ ..
guṇanvite ca dātavyaṃ nāsti mūrkhavya tikramaḥ .. 28 ..
1.184.d:
गृहांते वसते मूर्खो दूरे चास्य गुणान्वितः ॥
गुणन्विते च दातव्यं नास्ति मूर्खव्य तिक्रमः ॥ 28 ॥
1.184.m: If a fool lives close to one's house, and a virtuous man far from it, / one should give to the virtuous man; there is no wrong in bypassing the fool.

1.184.s:
brāhmaṇātikramo nāsti vipre vedavivarjite ..
jvalaṃtamagnimutsṛjya na hi bhasmani hūyate .. 29 ..
1.184.d:
ब्राह्मणातिक्रमो नास्ति विप्रे वेदविवर्जिते ॥
ज्वलंतमग्निमुत्सृज्य न हि भस्मनि हूयते ॥ 29 ॥
1.184.m: There is no offense in passing over a brāhmaṇa when the priest is devoid of the Vedas; / having abandoned a blazing fire, one does not make offerings in ashes.

1.184.s:
sannikṛṣṭamadhīyānaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ yo vyatikramet..
bhojanenaiva dānena dahatyāsaptamaṃ kulam .. 1.184.30 ..
1.184.d:
सन्निकृष्टमधीयानं ब्राह्मणं यो व्यतिक्रमेत्॥
भोजनेनैव दानेन दहत्यासप्तमं कुलम् ॥ 1.184.30 ॥
1.184.m: He who bypasses a learned brāhmaṇa living nearby / with food or gifts burns his family up to the seventh generation.

1.184.s:
.. anūruruvāca .. ..
evameva jagannātha devadeva jagatpate ..
kiṃ tu yatte purā deva śrutaṃ vākyaṃ mahātmanaḥ .. 31 ..
1.184.d:
॥ अनूरुरुवाच ॥ ॥
एवमेव जगन्नाथ देवदेव जगत्पते ॥
किं तु यत्ते पुरा देव श्रुतं वाक्यं महात्मनः ॥ 31 ॥
1.184.m: Anūru said: / So it is indeed, Lord of the world, God of gods, Master of the universe. / But the word of the great-souled one which was heard by you formerly, O god,

1.184.s:
gadato nāradasyaiva śṛṇu tvaṃ vibudhādhipa ..
gadato me suraśreṣṭha dharmyamarthaṃ sukhāvaham .. 32 ..
1.184.d:
गदतो नारदस्यैव शृणु त्वं विबुधाधिप ॥
गदतो मे सुरश्रेष्ठ धर्म्यमर्थं सुखावहम् ॥ 32 ॥
1.184.m: spoken by Nārada himself, hear, O ruler of the gods, / as I declare it, O best of the gods, [a word] righteous, purposeful, and bringing happiness.

1.184.s:
satyaniṣṭhaṃ dvijaṃ yastu śuklajātiṃ priyaṃvadam ..
mūrkhaṃ pākhaṃḍinaṃ vāpi vṛttihīnamathāpi vā .. 33 ..
1.184.d:
सत्यनिष्ठं द्विजं यस्तु शुक्लजातिं प्रियंवदम् ॥
मूर्खं पाखंडिनं वापि वृत्तिहीनमथापि वा ॥ 33 ॥
1.184.m: A man who bypasses a twice-born fixed in truth, of pure birth, who speaks kindly, / or [even] one who is a fool, a hypocrite, or without a livelihood,

1.184.s:
atikramya naro ghoraṃ narakaṃ pātayetkhaga..
sapta parānsapta pūrvānpuruṣānātmanā saha .. 34 ..
1.184.d:
अतिक्रम्य नरो घोरं नरकं पातयेत्खग॥
सप्त परान्सप्त पूर्वान्पुरुषानात्मना सह ॥ 34 ॥
1.184.m: plunges, O bird, into a terrible hell, / together with himself, seven succeeding and seven preceding men [of his lineage].

1.184.s:
tasmānnātikramedrājā brāhmaṇaṃ prātiveśikam ..
saṃbandhatastathāsannaṃ dauhitraṃ vidyate tathā .. 35 ..
1.184.d:
तस्मान्नातिक्रमेद्राजा ब्राह्मणं प्रातिवेशिकम् ॥
संबन्धतस्तथासन्नं दौहित्रं विद्यते तथा ॥ 35 ॥
1.184.m: Therefore a king should not pass over a neighboring brāhmaṇa; / likewise a daughter's son who is near by kinship is acknowledged,

1.184.s:
bhāgineyaṃ viśeṣeṇa tathā baṃdhuṃ grahādhipa ..
nātikramennarastvetānsumūrkhānapi gopate ..
atikramya mahadraudraṃ rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet .. 36 ..
1.184.d:
भागिनेयं विशेषेण तथा बंधुं ग्रहाधिप ॥
नातिक्रमेन्नरस्त्वेतान्सुमूर्खानपि गोपते ॥
अतिक्रम्य महद्रौद्रं रौरवं नरकं व्रजेत् ॥ 36 ॥
1.184.m: and especially a sister's son, and likewise a kinsman, O lord of planets. / A man should not pass over these, even if they are utter fools, O protector of cows; / by passing them over, he goes to the dread, terrible Raurava hell.

1.184.s:
.. āditya uvāca .. ..
evametanna saṃdeho yathā vadasi khecara ..
mamāpyavagataṃ vīra brāhmaṇaṃ na parīkṣayet .. 37 ..
1.184.d:
॥ आदित्य उवाच ॥ ॥
एवमेतन्न संदेहो यथा वदसि खेचर ॥
ममाप्यवगतं वीर ब्राह्मणं न परीक्षयेत् ॥ 37 ॥
1.184.m: The Sun said: / It is so; there is no doubt, just as you say, O sky-goer. / It is also understood by me, O hero, that one should not test a brāhmaṇa.

1.184.s:
sarvadevamayaṃ vipraṃ sarvalokamayaṃ tathā ..
tasmātsaṃpūjayedenaṃ na guṇāṃstasya ciṃtayet .. 38 ..
1.184.d:
सर्वदेवमयं विप्रं सर्वलोकमयं तथा ॥
तस्मात्संपूजयेदेनं न गुणांस्तस्य चिंतयेत् ॥ 38 ॥
1.184.m: A priest embodies all the gods and embodies all the worlds; / therefore one should honor him and not consider his qualities.

1.184.s:
kevalaṃ ciṃtayejjātiṃ na guṇānvinatātmaja ..
tasmādāmaṃtrayetpūrvamāsannaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ budhaḥ .. 39 ..
1.184.d:
केवलं चिंतयेज्जातिं न गुणान्विनतात्मज ॥
तस्मादामंत्रयेत्पूर्वमासन्नं ब्राह्मणं बुधः ॥ 39 ॥
1.184.m: One should consider only his birth, not his qualities, O son of Vinatā; / therefore a wise man should first invite a nearby brāhmaṇa.

1.184.s:
yastvāsannamatikramya brāhmaṇaṃ patitādṛte ..
dūrasthānpūjayenmūḍho guṇāḍhyānnarakaṃ vrajet .. 1.184.40 ..
1.184.d:
यस्त्वासन्नमतिक्रम्य ब्राह्मणं पतितादृते ॥
दूरस्थान्पूजयेन्मूढो गुणाढ्यान्नरकं व्रजेत् ॥ 1.184.40 ॥
1.184.m: He who, having bypassed a nearby brāhmaṇa—except for an outcaste—, / foolishly honors those living far away who are rich in qualities goes to hell.

1.184.s:
devakarmavināśena brahmasvaharaṇena ca ..
devadravyaṃ dvijānnaṃ ca brahmasvaṃ brāhmaṇārjitam ..
viyonyāṃ kṣipate yastu viyonimadhigacchati .. 41 ..
1.184.d:
देवकर्मविनाशेन ब्रह्मस्वहरणेन च ॥
देवद्रव्यं द्विजान्नं च ब्रह्मस्वं ब्राह्मणार्जितम् ॥
वियोन्यां क्षिपते यस्तु वियोनिमधिगच्छति ॥ 41 ॥
1.184.m: By destroying the rites for the gods and by seizing a brāhmaṇa's property— / divine property, food meant for a twice-born, and a brāhmaṇa's property acquired by a brāhmaṇa— / he who casts it into a non-human womb enters a non-human womb.

1.184.s:
mā dadasveti yo brūyādgavāgnibrāhmaṇeṣu vai ..
tiryagyoniśataṃ gatvā cāṃḍā leṣvabhijāyate .. 42 ..
1.184.d:
मा ददस्वेति यो ब्रूयाद्गवाग्निब्राह्मणेषु वै ॥
तिर्यग्योनिशतं गत्वा चांडा लेष्वभिजायते ॥ 42 ॥
1.184.m: He who says, 'Do not give!' when cows, fire, and brāhmaṇas [are concerned], / having gone through a hundred animal wombs, is born among Caṇḍālas.

1.184.s:
yattu vācā pratijñātaṃ karmaṇā nopapāditam ..
tadṛṇaṃ dharmasaṃyuktamiha loke paratra ca .. 43 ..
1.184.d:
यत्तु वाचा प्रतिज्ञातं कर्मणा नोपपादितम् ॥
तदृणं धर्मसंयुक्तमिह लोके परत्र च ॥ 43 ॥
1.184.m: What is promised by word of mouth but not fulfilled by deed / is a debt coupled with righteousness in this world and the next.

1.184.s:
vedavidyāvratasnāte śrotriye gṛhamāgate ..
krīḍaṃtyoṣadhayaḥ sarvā yāsyāmaḥ paramāṃ gatim .. 44 ..
1.184.d:
वेदविद्याव्रतस्नाते श्रोत्रिये गृहमागते ॥
क्रीडंत्योषधयः सर्वा यास्यामः परमां गतिम् ॥ 44 ॥
1.184.m: When a learned priest who has completed the vow of Vedic study arrives at the house, / all the medicinal herbs rejoice, [saying,] 'We shall attain the highest state!'

1.184.s:
madhu māṃsaṃ surāṃ somaṃ lākṣādyaṃ lavaṇaṃ tathā ..
vikrīyānyatamaṃ teṣāṃ dvijaścāṃdrāyaṇaṃ caret .. 45 ..
1.184.d:
मधु मांसं सुरां सोमं लाक्षाद्यं लवणं तथा ॥
विक्रीयान्यतमं तेषां द्विजश्चांद्रायणं चरेत् ॥ 45 ॥
1.184.m: Having sold honey, meat, spirituous liquor, soma, lac and the like, or salt— / any one of these—a twice-born should perform the Cāndrāyaṇa penance.

1.184.s:
guḍaṃ tilaṃ tathā nīlaṃ keśāngodhūmakānyavān ..
vikrīya brāhmaṇo gāṃ ca kṛcchraṃ sāṃtapanaṃ caret .. 46 ..
1.184.d:
गुडं तिलं तथा नीलं केशान्गोधूमकान्यवान् ॥
विक्रीय ब्राह्मणो गां च कृच्छ्रं सांतपनं चरेत् ॥ 46 ॥
1.184.m: Having sold molasses, sesame seeds, indigo, hair, wheat, barley, / or a cow, a brāhmaṇa should perform the painful Sāṃtapana penance.

1.184.s:
auṣṭramāvikadugdhaṃ ca annaṃ mṛtakasūtake ..
caurasyānnaṃ mṛtaśrāddhe bhuktvā cāṃdrāyaṇaṃ caret .. 47 ..
1.184.d:
औष्ट्रमाविकदुग्धं च अन्नं मृतकसूतके ॥
चौरस्यान्नं मृतश्राद्धे भुक्त्वा चांद्रायणं चरेत् ॥ 47 ॥
1.184.m: Having drunk the milk of a camel or sheep, or eaten food during impurity from death or childbirth, / or the food of a thief, or at a funeral offering for the dead, one should perform the Cāndrāyaṇa.

1.184.s:
gavāṃ śṛṃgodake snāto mahānadyāśca saṃgame ..
samudradarśanādvāpi śunā daṣṭaḥ śucirbhavet .. 48 ..
1.184.d:
गवां शृंगोदके स्नातो महानद्याश्च संगमे ॥
समुद्रदर्शनाद्वापि शुना दष्टः शुचिर्भवेत् ॥ 48 ॥
1.184.m: One bitten by a dog becomes pure by bathing in water from the horns of cows, / at the confluence of great rivers, or by the sight of the ocean.

1.184.s:
vedavidyāvratasnātaḥ śunā daṣṭo dvijaḥ khaga ..
hiraṇyodakamiśraṃ tu ghṛtaṃ prāśya viśuddhyati .. 49 ..
1.184.d:
वेदविद्याव्रतस्नातः शुना दष्टो द्विजः खग ॥
हिरण्योदकमिश्रं तु घृतं प्राश्य विशुद्ध्यति ॥ 49 ॥
1.184.m: A twice-born who has bathed upon completing his Vedic study and vow, if bitten by a dog, O bird, / becomes completely pure upon consuming clarified butter mixed with water containing gold.

1.184.s:
tiṣṭhanvāpyatha vā gacchañchunā daṣṭo dvijaḥ khaga ..
vajraṃ prāśya śuciḥ syādvai yathāha bhagavānmanuḥ .. 1.184.50 ..
1.184.d:
तिष्ठन्वाप्यथ वा गच्छञ्छुना दष्टो द्विजः खग ॥
वज्रं प्राश्य शुचिः स्याद्वै यथाह भगवान्मनुः ॥ 1.184.50 ॥
1.184.m: Standing or walking, a twice-born who is bitten by a dog, O bird, / becomes pure by consuming vajra, as the blessed Manu has said.

1.184.s:
vratinaścāpi daṣṭasya trirātraṃ kṣapaṇaṃ smṛtam ..
saghṛtaṃ ca tato bhuktvā vrataśeṣaṃ samācaret .. 51 ..
1.184.d:
व्रतिनश्चापि दष्टस्य त्रिरात्रं क्षपणं स्मृतम् ॥
सघृतं च ततो भुक्त्वा व्रतशेषं समाचरेत् ॥ 51 ॥
1.184.m: For one observing a vow who has been bitten, fasting for three nights is prescribed; / and then, having eaten with clarified butter, he should perform the rest of his vow.

1.184.s:
brāhmaṇī tu śunā daṣṭā some dṛṣṭaṃ samācaret ..
yadā na dṛśyate somaḥ prāyaścittaṃ kathaṃ bhavet .. 52 ..
1.184.d:
ब्राह्मणी तु शुना दष्टा सोमे दृष्टं समाचरेत् ॥
यदा न दृश्यते सोमः प्रायश्चित्तं कथं भवेत् ॥ 52 ॥
1.184.m: A brāhmaṇa woman bitten by a dog should perform [the expiation] when Soma is seen. / When Soma is not seen, how can the expiation take place?

1.184.s:
yāṃ diśaṃ vrajate somastāṃ diśaṃ cāvalokayet ..
somamārgeṇa sā pūrvā pañcapūtena śudhyati .. 53. ..
1.184.d:
यां दिशं व्रजते सोमस्तां दिशं चावलोकयेत् ॥
सोममार्गेण सा पूर्वा पञ्चपूतेन शुध्यति ॥ 53॥।
1.184.m: She should look in that direction in which Soma goes; / by way of Soma's path, she becomes purified first by the five purifying items.

1.184.s:
brāhmaṇasya brahmadvāre pūya śoṇitasaṃbhave ..
krimibhirdaśyate yaśca niṣkṛtiṃ tasya vacmi te .. 54 ..
1.184.d:
ब्राह्मणस्य ब्रह्मद्वारे पूय शोणितसंभवे ॥
क्रिमिभिर्दश्यते यश्च निष्कृतिं तस्य वच्मि ते ॥ 54 ॥
1.184.m: When in the case of a brāhmaṇa pus and blood appear at the Brahmarandhra / and he is bitten by worms, I will tell you his expiation.

1.184.s:
gavāṃ tatra purīṣeṇa trikālaṃ snānamācaret ..
dadhi kṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ pītvā kṛmidaṣṭo viśudhyati .. 55 ..
1.184.d:
गवां तत्र पुरीषेण त्रिकालं स्नानमाचरेत् ॥
दधि क्षीरं घृतं पीत्वा कृमिदष्टो विशुध्यति ॥ 55 ॥
1.184.m: He should take a bath with cow dung at the three junctures of the day; / having drunk curd, milk, and clarified butter, one bitten by worms is purified.

1.184.s:
atha nābhyāḥ pradaṣṭasya āpādādvinatātmaja ..
etadvinirdiśetprājñaḥ prāyaścittaṃ khagādhipa .. 56 ..
1.184.d:
अथ नाभ्याः प्रदष्टस्य आपादाद्विनतात्मज ॥
एतद्विनिर्दिशेत्प्राज्ञः प्रायश्चित्तं खगाधिप ॥ 56 ॥
1.184.m: Now, for one bitten below the navel down to the feet, O son of Vinatā, / a wise man should prescribe this expiation, O lord of birds.

1.184.s:
nābhikaṇṭhāṃtare vīra yadā cotpadyate kṛmiḥ ..
ṣaḍrātraṃ tu tadā proktaṃ prāyaścittaṃ manīṣibhiḥ .. 57 ..
1.184.d:
नाभिकण्ठांतरे वीर यदा चोत्पद्यते कृमिः ॥
षड्रात्रं तु तदा प्रोक्तं प्रायश्चित्तं मनीषिभिः ॥ 57 ॥
1.184.m: When worms appear between the navel and the throat, O hero, / an expiation of six nights is then prescribed by the wise.

1.184.s:
yadā daśaṃti śirasi kṛmayo vinatātmaja ..
kṛcchraṃ tadā caretprājñaḥ śuddhaye kaśyapātmaja .. 58 ..
1.184.d:
यदा दशंति शिरसि कृमयो विनतात्मज ॥
कृच्छ्रं तदा चरेत्प्राज्ञः शुद्धये कश्यपात्मज ॥ 58 ॥
1.184.m: When worms bite upon the head, O son of Vinatā, / a wise man should then perform the Kṛcchra penance for purification, O son of Kaśyapa.

1.184.s:
mṛtānnaṃ madhu māṃsaṃ ca yastu bhuñjīta brāhmaṇaḥ ..
sa trīṇyahānyupavasedekāhaṃ codake vaset .. 59 .. ..
mātṛśrāddhavidhivarṇanam
1.184.d:
मृतान्नं मधु मांसं च यस्तु भुञ्जीत ब्राह्मणः ॥
स त्रीण्यहान्युपवसेदेकाहं चोदके वसेत् ॥ 59 ॥ ॥
मातृश्राद्धविधिवर्णनम्
1.184.m:
A brāhmaṇa who eats food of a dead person, honey, or meat / should fast for three days and live in water for one day.
Description of the Rules for the Rite to the Mothers

1.185.s:
.. .. āditya uvāca .. ..
rātrau śrāddhaṃ na kurvīta rākṣasī kīrtitā hi sā ..
sandhyayorubhayorvīra sūrye caiva tirohite ..1..
1.185.d:
॥ ॥ आदित्य उवाच ॥ ॥
रात्रौ श्राद्धं न कुर्वीत राक्षसी कीर्तिता हि सा ॥
सन्ध्ययोरुभयोर्वीर सूर्ये चैव तिरोहिते ॥1॥
1.185.m: The Sun said: / One should not perform a śrāddha at night, for it is declared to be demonic, / nor at both twilights, O hero, when the sun has disappeared.

1.185.s:
akṛtvā mātṛyajñaṃ tu yaḥ śrāddhaṃ pariveṣayet ..
tātasya krodhasaṃyuktāṃ hiṃsāmicchaṃti dāruṇām ..2..
1.185.d:
अकृत्वा मातृयज्ञं तु यः श्राद्धं परिवेषयेत् ॥
तातस्य क्रोधसंयुक्तां हिंसामिच्छंति दारुणाम् ॥2॥
1.185.m: He who serves a śrāddha without first performing the sacrifice to the Mothers: / filled with anger, they desire dreadful harm for the father.

1.185.s:
.. anūruruvāca .. ..
mātṛśrāddhaṃ kathaṃ kāryaṃ kāśca tā mātaraḥ smṛtāḥ..
nāṃdīmukhāśca pitaraḥ kathaṃ pūjāmavāpnuyuḥ .. 3 ..
1.185.d:
॥ अनूरुरुवाच ॥ ॥
मातृश्राद्धं कथं कार्यं काश्च ता मातरः स्मृताः॥
नांदीमुखाश्च पितरः कथं पूजामवाप्नुयुः ॥ 3 ॥
1.185.m: Anūru said: / How is the śrāddha to the Mothers to be performed, and who are remembered as those Mothers? / And how do the ancestors whose faces are gladdened receive worship?

1.185.s:
.. āditya uvāca .. ..
hanta te sampravakṣyāmi mātṛśrāddhavidhiṃ khaga ..
śṛṇu tvaṃ khagaśārdūla gadato mama kṛtsnaśaḥ ..4..
1.185.d:
॥ आदित्य उवाच ॥ ॥
हन्त ते सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि मातृश्राद्धविधिं खग ॥
शृणु त्वं खगशार्दूल गदतो मम कृत्स्नशः ॥4॥

1.185.s:
pūrvāhṇe bhojayedviprānaṣṭau sarvānpradakṣiṇān ..
tathānyaṃ navamaṃ vipraṃ caturaśca khagādhipa .. 5 ..
1.185.d:
पूर्वाह्णे भोजयेद्विप्रानष्टौ सर्वान्प्रदक्षिणान् ॥
तथान्यं नवमं विप्रं चतुरश्च खगाधिप ॥ 5 ॥
1.185.m:
In the forenoon, one should feed eight brāhmaṇas, all in clockwise order,
and likewise another, ninth brāhmaṇa, and four [others], O lord of birds.

1.185.s:
ṛjūnvai kṛtapāndattvā satyena vidhivatkhaga ..
kṛtvā yavaistilārthaṃ tu dadhimiśraṃ krameṇa ca ..6..
1.185.d:
ऋजून्वै कृतपान्दत्त्वा सत्येन विधिवत्खग ॥
कृत्वा यवैस्तिलार्थं तु दधिमिश्रं क्रमेण च ॥6॥
1.185.m:
Giving [them seats of kuśa grass] straight, properly formed, with truth and according to rule, O bird,
and using barley instead of sesamum, mixed with curd, in due order,

1.185.s:
gandhapuṣpādikaṃ sarvaṃ kuryādviprapradakṣiṇam ..
brāhmaṇebhyastato dadyānmadhuraṃ bhojanaṃ khaga .. 7 ..
1.185.d:
गन्धपुष्पादिकं सर्वं कुर्याद्विप्रप्रदक्षिणम् ॥
ब्राह्मणेभ्यस्ततो दद्यान्मधुरं भोजनं खग ॥ 7 ॥
1.185.m:
one should perform all [offerings of] perfume, flowers, and the like in a clockwise direction around the brāhmaṇas;
then, O bird, one should give sweet food to the brāhmaṇas,

1.185.s:
guḍamiśraṃ khagaśreṣṭha savastramodanaṃ param ..
rasānāṃ modakāṃścaiva na ca tānkaṭukāṃstathā .. 8 ..
1.185.d:
गुडमिश्रं खगश्रेष्ठ सवस्त्रमोदनं परम् ॥
रसानां मोदकांश्चैव न च तान्कटुकांस्तथा ॥ 8 ॥
1.185.m:
mixed with jaggery, O best of birds, along with clothes, boiled rice of supreme quality,
and modakas of various flavours, but never pungent ones.

1.185.s:
evaṃ bhukteṣu vipreṣu dadyātpiṃḍā nsamāhitaḥ ..
dadhyakṣatavimiśrāṃstu badaraiśca khagādhipa .. 9 ..
1.185.d:
एवं भुक्तेषु विप्रेषु दद्यात्पिंडा न्समाहितः ॥
दध्यक्षतविमिश्रांस्तु बदरैश्च खगाधिप ॥ 9 ॥
1.185.m:
When the brāhmaṇas have thus eaten, one should attentively offer the piṇḍas,
mixed with curd and unhusked barley grains, and with badara berries, O lord of birds.

1.185.s:
kṛtvā tu maṃḍapaṃ vīra caturasraṃ pradakṣiṇam ..
pūrvāgrāṃśca kuśāndattvā puṣpāṇāṃ prakaraṃ tathā .. 1.185.10 ..
1.185.d:
कृत्वा तु मंडपं वीर चतुरस्रं प्रदक्षिणम् ॥
पूर्वाग्रांश्च कुशान्दत्त्वा पुष्पाणां प्रकरं तथा ॥ 1.185.10 ॥
1.185.m:
Having prepared a four-sided pavilion, O hero, circumambulating clockwise,
and having strewn kuśa grass pointing east, and likewise a scatter of flowers,

1.185.s:
savyena pāṇinā vīra vidhivatkhagasattama ..
mātre pramātre tanmātre nirvapetpūrvatomukhaḥ .. 11 ..
1.185.d:
सव्येन पाणिना वीर विधिवत्खगसत्तम ॥
मात्रे प्रमात्रे तन्मात्रे निर्वपेत्पूर्वतोमुखः ॥ 11 ॥
1.185.m:
with the right hand, O hero, according to rule, O best of birds,
