facing east, one should offer [piṇḍas] to the mother, maternal grandmother, and maternal great-grandmother.

1.185.s:
piturmātre tu tanmātre nirvapedvidhiva tkhaga ..
vṛddhāyai prapitāmahyai tathānyaṃ nirvapedbudhaḥ .. 12 ..
1.185.d:
पितुर्मात्रे तु तन्मात्रे निर्वपेद्विधिव त्खग ॥
वृद्धायै प्रपितामह्यै तथान्यं निर्वपेद्बुधः ॥ 12 ॥
1.185.m:
According to rule, one should offer [piṇḍas] to the father's mother and to her mother, O bird;
and the wise man should offer another to the ancient paternal great-grandmother.

1.185.s:
evamuddiśya vai mātṝḥ ṣaṭ piṃḍānnirvapetkhaga ..
aṣṭāśayeddvijānvīra mātṛśrāddhe khagā dhipa ..
navamaṃ sarvadaivatyaṃ bhojayedvidhivatkhaga .. 13 ..
1.185.d:
एवमुद्दिश्य वै मातॄः षट् पिंडान्निर्वपेत्खग ॥
अष्टाशयेद्द्विजान्वीर मातृश्राद्धे खगा धिप ॥
नवमं सर्वदैवत्यं भोजयेद्विधिवत्खग ॥ 13 ॥

1.185.s:
nāṃdīmukhāṃstānuddiśya pitṝnpaṃca dvijottamān ..
bhojayedvidhicchrāddhe vṛddhiśrāddhe pradakṣiṇam .. 14 ..
1.185.d:
नांदीमुखांस्तानुद्दिश्य पितॄन्पंच द्विजोत्तमान् ॥
भोजयेद्विधिच्छ्राद्धे वृद्धिश्राद्धे प्रदक्षिणम् ॥ 14 ॥
1.185.m:
Intending them for the Nāndīmukha ancestors, one should feed five excellent twice-born men
clockwise in the prescribed śrāddha, the vṛddhi-śrāddha.

1.185.s:
itthaṃ śrāddhadvayaṃ kuyādvṛddhau kaśyapanaṃdana ..
tathānyamapi te vacmi paraṃ śrāddhavidhiṃ tava .. 15 ..
1.185.d:
इत्थं श्राद्धद्वयं कुयाद्वृद्धौ कश्यपनंदन ॥
तथान्यमपि ते वच्मि परं श्राद्धविधिं तव ॥ 15 ॥
1.185.m:
In this way one should perform the two śrāddhas at a prosperity-rite, O son of Kaśyapa;
and I shall tell you another supreme rule for the śrāddha.

1.185.s:
athaivaṃ bhojayecchrāddhe tatpūrvaṃ tu pravartayet..
anyathā tatra luṃpaṃti sadevāsuramānuṣāḥ ..16..
1.185.d:
अथैवं भोजयेच्छ्राद्धे तत्पूर्वं तु प्रवर्तयेत्॥
अन्यथा तत्र लुंपंति सदेवासुरमानुषाः ॥16॥
1.185.m:
Then, one should thus feed them at a śrāddha, but should set it forth prior to that;
otherwise, gods, asuras, and humans disrupt it there.

1.185.s:
agnyabhāve tu viprasya pāṇāvevopapādayet..
yo hyagniḥ sa dvijo vīnda maṃtradarśibhirucyate.. .. 17 ..
1.185.d:
अग्न्यभावे तु विप्रस्य पाणावेवोपपादयेत्॥
यो ह्यग्निः स द्विजो वीन्द मंत्रदर्शिभिरुच्यते॥ ॥ 17 ॥
1.185.m:
In the absence of a sacrificial fire, one should place [the offering] right in the hand of a brāhmaṇa;
for that twice-born man is indeed the fire, O eagle, as is stated by seers of mantras.

1.185.s:
pūrva pātre yadannaṃ ca yaccānnamupakalpitam ..
tenaiva saha bhoktavyaṃ pṛthagbhāvo na vidyate ..18..
1.185.d:
पूर्व पात्रे यदन्नं च यच्चान्नमुपकल्पितम् ॥
तेनैव सह भोक्तव्यं पृथग्भावो न विद्यते ॥18॥
1.185.m:
Whatever food was in the first vessel, and whatever food has been prepared,
should be eaten together with it; no separateness is recognised.

1.185.s:
dvau daive'tharvaṇau viprau prāṅmukhāvupaveśayet..
pitrye trīnudagāsyāṃśca vṛddhau cādhvaryusaṃgamān .. 19 ..
1.185.d:
द्वौ दैवेऽथर्वणौ विप्रौ प्राङ्मुखावुपवेशयेत्॥
पित्र्ये त्रीनुदगास्यांश्च वृद्धौ चाध्वर्युसंगमान् ॥ 19 ॥
1.185.m:
One should seat two brāhmaṇas facing east for the gods, skilled in the Atharvaveda,
three facing north for the ancestors, and in the vṛddhi-śrāddha those who know the Adhvaryu [rites].

1.185.s:
trīṇi śrāddhe pavitrāṇi dauhitraḥ kutupāstilāḥ ..
trīṇi cātra praśaṃsaṃti śaucamakrodhamatvaram .. 1.185.20 ..
1.185.d:
त्रीणि श्राद्धे पवित्राणि दौहित्रः कुतुपास्तिलाः ॥
त्रीणि चात्र प्रशंसंति शौचमक्रोधमत्वरम् ॥ 1.185.20 ॥
1.185.m:
Three things are purifying at a śrāddha: a daughter's son, a kutapa blanket, and sesamum seeds;
and three things they praise here: purity, freedom from anger, and lack of haste.

1.185.s:
dauhitraṃ khaṃḍamityuktaṃ lalāṭāya prajāpate ..
tatra śṛṃgasya yatpātraṃ taddauhitramiti smṛtam .. 21 ..
1.185.d:
दौहित्रं खंडमित्युक्तं ललाटाय प्रजापते ॥
तत्र शृंगस्य यत्पात्रं तद्दौहित्रमिति स्मृतम् ॥ 21 ॥
1.185.m:
A rhinoceros horn is called 'dauhitra' for Prajāpati's forehead;
a vessel made of that horn is known as 'dauhitra'.

1.185.s:
savyādaṃsātparibhraṣṭaṃ nābhideśe vyavasthitam ..
ekavastraṃ tu taṃ vidyāddaive pitrye ca varjayet .. 22 ..
1.185.d:
सव्यादंसात्परिभ्रष्टं नाभिदेशे व्यवस्थितम् ॥
एकवस्त्रं तु तं विद्याद्दैवे पित्र्ये च वर्जयेत् ॥ 22 ॥
1.185.m:
If it has slipped from the left shoulder and rests at the region of the navel,
one should know him to have a single garment, and one should avoid [him] in rites for the gods and ancestors.

1.185.s:
pitṛdevamanuṣyāṇāṃ pūjanaṃ bhojanaṃ tathā ..
nottarīyaṃ vinā kāryaṃ kṛtaṃ syānniṣphalaṃ yataḥ .. 23 ..
1.185.d:
पितृदेवमनुष्याणां पूजनं भोजनं तथा ॥
नोत्तरीयं विना कार्यं कृतं स्यान्निष्फलं यतः ॥ 23 ॥
1.185.m:
Worship of the ancestors, gods, and men, as well as feeding [them],
should not be done without an upper garment, since what is done [without it] would be fruitless.

1.185.s:
paridhānakṛte skaṃdhe gṛhastho yo'rcayetpitṝn ..
na sa tatphalamāpnoti yathā yogapaṭāvṛtaḥ .. 24 ..
1.185.d:
परिधानकृते स्कंधे गृहस्थो योऽर्चयेत्पितॄन् ॥
न स तत्फलमाप्नोति यथा योगपटावृतः ॥ 24 ॥
1.185.m:
A householder who, with his lower cloth thrown over his shoulder, worships the ancestors,
does not attain that fruit, just as one wrapped in an ascetic's yoga-cloth [does not].

1.185.s:
vanasthānāṃ khagaśreṣṭha yatīnāṃ ca mahāmate ..
siddhaye karmaṇāṃ vīra yogapaṭṭakamucyate .. 25 ..
1.185.d:
वनस्थानां खगश्रेष्ठ यतीनां च महामते ॥
सिद्धये कर्मणां वीर योगपट्टकमुच्यते ॥ 25 ॥
1.185.m:
For forest-dwellers, O best of birds, and for ascetics, O broad-minded one,
the yoga-cloth is prescribed for the success of their rites, O hero.

1.185.s:
hastau prakṣālya gaṃḍūṣaṃ yaḥ pibedavicakṣaṇaḥ ..
sa tu daivaṃ ca pitryaṃ ca ātmānaṃ copaghā tayet .. 26 ..
1.185.d:
हस्तौ प्रक्षाल्य गंडूषं यः पिबेदविचक्षणः ॥
स तु दैवं च पित्र्यं च आत्मानं चोपघा तयेत् ॥ 26 ॥
1.185.m:
The unwise man who, having washed his hands, drinks a mouthful of water [for rinsing],
destroys the rite for the gods, that for the ancestors, and himself.

1.185.s:
bhojaneṣveva tiṣṭhaṃti svasti kurvaṃti ye dvijāḥ ..
āsuraṃ tadbhavecchrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ nopatiṣṭhate .. 27 ..
1.185.d:
भोजनेष्वेव तिष्ठंति स्वस्ति कुर्वंति ये द्विजाः ॥
आसुरं तद्भवेच्छ्राद्धं पितॄणां नोपतिष्ठते ॥ 27 ॥
1.185.m:
If twice-born men utter 'svasti' while still eating,
that śrāddha becomes demonic and does not reach the ancestors.

1.185.s:
dātāro nobhivardhaṃtā vedāḥ saṃta tireva ca..
śraddhā ca no mā vyagamadbahudeyaṃ ca no'stviti ..28.. ..
śuddhiprakaraṇavarṇanam
1.185.d:
दातारो नोभिवर्धंता वेदाः संत तिरेव च॥
श्रद्धा च नो मा व्यगमद्बहुदेयं च नोऽस्त्विति ॥28॥ ॥
शुद्धिप्रकरणवर्णनम्
1.185.m:
[They should say:] 'May our donors prosper, and our Vedas, and our progeny!
May faith not depart from us, and may we have much to give!'
Description of the section on purification
